reviews.title: AVOID
reviews.text: My original review was deleted. Dirty hotel. Rooms are gross and very outdated, all the dressers, cabinets and lamps were broken. We called to have our room cleaned again and no one came with any urgency, we packed up after an hour and left to another hotel. Everything about the room and hotel felt and looked dirty. Location is trash too

reviews.title: Amazing service from Sara the bartender!
reviews.text: Sara the bartender was the best - she took such great care of us at the Rojo bar and lounge.  Her recommendations were spot on, the food and drinks she made were amazing. Thank you for the incredible experience, Sara! We will absolutely be coming back again  and again while we are here. Love, Sam and Angela

reviews.title: Palms Place - Quit, Relaxing, Private Feeling
reviews.text: Alberto provided excellent service with a wonderful attitude. The assigned room offered a magnificent view of the strip. However, the sliding door to the balcony was locked, and I did not have the key, likely for safety reasons.Please note that there are two separate Palms properties: one for the hotels and another for the Palms Place, which is generally quieter, more tranquil, and offers a relaxing atmosphere away from the strip's commotion.Overall, it was a great experience, and certainly a wonderful place to spend the night.

reviews.title: Best
reviews.text: Went in for F1 weekend palms place was amazing Natasha at the front was more than amazing! Amazing great stay great place can’t wait to be back

reviews.title: Rude and unsanitary
reviews.text: The rooms were dirty. The hotel is kinda dirty itself not a lot of the features in the room work or outlets. On top of that staff at the front desk are really rude especially the men who check to see if you have a room key by the elevators they are so rude and they yell at everybody coming in. No one ever says hello. No one is ever in a good mood. Just a very unwelcoming hotel. It’s like they don’t want you there.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Since I Left Vegas In 23 When I Visit I Stay Here and Even When I Lived In Vegas I Stayed Here A Few Times and It's Always Pleasant but This Time Was Even Better bcuz Of The Young Lady at The Front Desk Was So Helpful and Made Sure I Got Exactly What I Needed 4 My Stay... Her Name Was Natasha and 2 Be The Prettiest Woman In The World She Had The Best Attitude and Went The Extra Mile 4 Me! I Appreciate Her and Next Time I Come She's Getting Flower's From Me and Respectfully She Deserves A Raise!!! These Companies Must Understand That The People Who Greet Customers Make The Company and Not The Other Way Around and She Makes The Company Better... Thanks Again Tasha

reviews.title: Quite simply the worst hotel I have ever stayed in.
reviews.text: Where do I start? The staff were rude and surly from the outset with no form of welcome.They took $500 at the beginning of our stay for incidentals when we were never going to spend this amount.The pool that was advertised was closed resulting in us having to buy a pool pass at another hotel.The restaurants were poor quality and had only basic decor; they were also located at the other side of the casino in the main Palms complex.The hotel did not provide any form of room service, so no rubbish collection, clean towels, toilet rolls or fresh bedding. When questioned they said they would only do it if we paid a further $100.The whole experience was an absolute joke and despite emailing the owners they have just ignored any messages.

reviews.title: Felt Unsafe and Ignored by Hotel Staff
reviews.text: I stayed at Palms Place on Oct 18, 2025, and had an alarming experience I would never expect from a hotel of this standard. I was traveling alone. About 15 minutes after a man with a cart knocked on my door (unannounced), someone tried to enter my room using a keycard. Thankfully the bolt lock stopped them.I called the front desk immediately and was told security was on the way but no one came for 2 hours. When security finally showed up, they were rude and dismissive. I filed a written statement, and no one followed up. I was not moved or contacted, and I felt unsafe the rest of my stay.I hope the hotel takes guest safety more seriously in the future. This was unacceptable.– Alia V.

reviews.title: AVOID - False advertising, misleading pictures,  NO POOL or DINING, unprofessional staff
reviews.text: I want to warn other travellers to AVOID this. I checked in and within a few hours, checked OUT to change hotels. Problems as follows:1.Room: dark, poor lighting, confusing set up, could be cleaner, air quality POOR very STUFFY. Okay fine, not thrilled but it's fine.... then.....2. We found a typed but undated letter on the desk: "sorry we're turning off the water tomorrow from 11am-3pm on floors X-Y." I immediately went downstairs to ask to change rooms because we'd need the shower that day before going to our events!... 3. Interaction with front desk staff: "I found this note", "Oh that can't be true we don't do that we did that last month I don't think it's true we've never heard anything." "Well can you ask your manager to confirm?" *Comes back* "Oh yeah sorry it is true". Bad news and bad communication. It gets worse.. 4. I overhear the clerk telling the guest next to me "Our pool and dining are closed for the season" (!!!) Well, you can imagine my reaction - I wasn't told this about an hour earlier when  I checked in. I said "what?? that's not advertised on the website". Clerk: "I dunno we don't manage the website" (!!!)Oh no no no. It was also an uncomfortable atmosphere. Guests appeared to be young people in their 20s having parties. No warm welcome or greeting from any front desk or room staff, there being only 4 people there when we arrived, it was a large empty lobby. To check in, one person stepped slightly forward of the "wait here" sign, yet nowhere remotely close to the front desk/other people/transactions being made. An angry ?security/attendant staff barked at the guest "STEP BACK". I was horrified.All this culminating to generally not feel safe, helped, able to trust the future and wanting out asap.I spoke with the manager and front desk staff to let them know I was very disappointed, frustrated and stressed out to have to find new lodgings that night. Because of their FALSE ADVERTISING. Their reaction was along the lines of "sorry that sucks, you can leave". Zero consideration for guests, for booking a lengthy (2 week) stay on site.

reviews.title: Alberto & Aretha Are Super Stars of Palms Place Hotel
reviews.text: The initial Check-in Rep I submitted my ID to at check-in was unhelpful.  His attitude and unwillingness to help was off-putting, after 3 attempts to check-in I was at a loss, until  Alberto came to the rescue.  He was investigative, asked the right questions and ultimately determined what the issue was, and I was able to finally get checked in.  The issue was minor, but I truly appreciated Alberto’s efforts.  Unfortunately,  I did not get the name of the other Rep, but he is the reason the rating was downgraded from Excellent.  Everyone else we encountered was very nice and accommodating.  Aretha was dutiful and made it a point to make our dining experience enjoyable.  I can tell she has a high standard of service & ethics and should be commended.  As for the Palms Place Hotel, it is a great place to stay.  I loved our room.

reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: 2nd time staying at Palms Place-upon check in at 3pm the lobby was full-however check in process was seamless and quick with service from Alberto. He was uber professional and pleasant. The attendant at the bell desk (Hawaiian gentleman) was equally friendly and helpful--we enjoyed meeting him as well. We were staying overnight for a fundraiser next door. We will definitely return next year!

reviews.title: Servers at pool are LOVELY
reviews.text: Was mainly here for the classy residential pool and it was so nice and relaxing. Pool is perfect temp and they hot tub is so nice to sit in after.It's clean out here and all the servers are so nice and friendly to you no matter what! (It came get a little windy up here since it's 6 stories, but the servers and lifeguards do an amazing job remaining professional.)Jaleeia (or Jaleea I believe) was my server. I was with my family, and she checked up on us multiple times, and brought out the best drinks! She made us laugh a ton too!

reviews.title: Awesome Condo
reviews.text: Want to shout out to South who greeted us and was very professional and helpful. The condo and pool were amazing.  There is only two things that was not mentioned when making reservations.  1.  If you are making reservations  for a one bedroom suite facing the strip, what they fail to advise is the doors are locked to the balcony. You do not have access. This was one of the main reasons why we selected this reservation was to sit out on the balcony at night to take pictures or sit and have a drink or eat.  2.  You have to call to get any utensils or kitchen amenities to cook with.I would suggest this be mentioned with the reservations.

reviews.title: Felt at home at Palms Place 😍
reviews.text: Went for the Backstreet Boys concert and couldnt be happier with our stay. We booked the one bedroom suite and the place is HUGE! We went to the pools, casino and buffet and absolutely loved our stay. Shout out to Ruthy R. At the frontdesk who made us feel so welcome on the get go and made for the best vacaction ever! We are thinking on returning soon for more concerts so we will absolutely book here again and are recommending it to all our BSB Army friends here in Mexico.

reviews.title: Laguna Pool House & Kitchen
reviews.text: I took my family of 8 to Palms Place last month and we loved the Laguna Pool House and Kitchen! The atmosphere was nice and calm and overlooked the pool outside. The food was amazing and our server, Aretha, was AMAZING!!!! Sweet, so fun to chat with and definitely took care of the whole family! I actually remembered her from a previous trip to Palms Place and LPH earlier this year and was so happy to have her take care of us. She was so great I wanted to make sure I made the effort to leave a great review- because I don’t do it often. Thanks, Aretha!

reviews.title: Great time with friends and our server Jaleesa
reviews.text: Had an amazing time at the pool today with my friends. Jaleesa was our server and she was so awesome. Very attentive. Always made sure out drinks were full and kept the food coming right on time. Thank you for taking such great care of us.

reviews.title: Check in issues
reviews.text: When I arrived for my stay there was unfortunately a hiccup with my room and I was unable to check in. Understandably this is very frustrating as I was tired from traveling; however Lexi was very empathetic and understanding to our situation and ensured that she would get the problem resolved. As more groups were coming over to check in she continued to check on my group and made sure to give us updates and continued to keep us comfortable until our room was ready. She kept a light positive attitude throughout all of it and joked around with us and did everything she could to help expedite the process. I was so happy to have someone who was so willing to help us and prioritize our comfort. She really helped turn around a potentially frustrating situation.

reviews.title: Great service and personality!!
reviews.text: Davion the Bartender was great, professional and knowledgeable. We will definitely be back. Thank you for your great hospitality.

reviews.title: VIOLENT FOOD POISONING
reviews.text: The hotel itself is fine and the presence of staff is helpful for quick asks, however, that is where all average enjoyment stops. We planned an anniversary stay with the expressed desire to go to AYCE for their acclaimed Lobster Dinner followed by Cirque O. The service at the buffet was sub optimal-even with a reservation the hostess was unwelcoming and curt-boarding in dismissive. Within 30 minutes of eating a plate of lobster my husband became seriously physically uncomfortable. We finished our meal about 30 minutes later and my husband was immediately violently ill with food poisoning. The violence of his food poisoning cannot be understated and caused us to miss the Cirque O show. He was so ill dehydration set in and he is still not recovered after 23hrs despite care.The hotel front desk made us file a security incident report and said they “might” follow up in 7-10 business days. We cannot believe that they haven’t even offered a refund for, at minimum,  our dinner. The genuine lack of care or awareness is as horrendous as their lack of food safety adherence. The combination of uncaring staff and the loss of $700 ($200 dinner that caused explosive illness and $500 in show tickets) will keep us from ever returning nor will we recommend Palms to or fellow travelers.

reviews.title: Memorable vacation
reviews.text: This is such a convenient location, i had an amazing stay. The pool is the best part great music my waitress Jaleesa was super helpful with tips for places to visit outstanding service and stunning outfits

reviews.title: Food and Drinks, Hospitality
reviews.text: Went to the Mabel in the Palms Hotel and the service was below standard. The Palms Place where we stayed The Laguna lounge was AMAZING!! Casey at the bar was super nice and made sure to check on us and offer drink options.

reviews.title: Staycation
reviews.text: Great place for locals or if you’re traveling. Jaleesa was great! Definitely enjoyed her personality! Prices were very reasonable as well.

reviews.title: Wonderful family day at Laguna pool
reviews.text: My family and I enjoyed our time at Laguna pool! The vibe was good, and the food and drinks were amazing! Jaleesa was GREAT! She was very knowledgeable and helpful with all the questions and or concerns we had. We will definitely be back! Thanks for such a great experience!!

reviews.title: Above and beyond services from Jaleesa drinks was Great and food was delicious 🔥
reviews.text: Had a wonderful time at Laguna pool house and kitchen with the family and friends. Jalessa made us forget how hot it was and always checking on us. Money well spent we will be back soon

reviews.title: Laguna Pool House & Kitchen "5 Star Experience"
reviews.text: Had a great experience at the Laguna Pool House & Kitchen - Casey the bartender is awesome, he gave great cocktail suggestions and the drinks were excellent.  The whole staff including Sarah brought a great energy and even the chef came out to make sure everything we ordered was to our liking - which it was. Overall, great ambience, great view of the pool, but like anything it really was the people working there who put a lot of effort to make sure my friend and I had a great time that made the experience wonderful and a place I will definitely return to!

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Went and ate at the Laguna pool inside Palms Place and the service was amazing. First night I went, I met Casey and he’s an awesome bartender. His drinks were very well balanced and the food there is also great. I met Sara the next night and both of them together make a great team. Definitely a place to go and hang out. Very chill and both Casey and Sara will definitely take care of you.

reviews.title: Palms Place - Laguna Pool House and Kitchen
reviews.text: Each time I come to Las Vegas the Palms Place  Laguna Pool House and Kitchen are my much looked forward to places to visit during my trip. The staff, most recently Jaleesa, Sara, Melissa, Tye and  Casey do the Palms Place Complex  justice with their warm welcomes and their attentiveness. They deliver just the right blend of professional service that is hoped for at such a venue. Namely, friendliness, light hearted, gentle humour, good conversation and a healthy splash of “Can’t do enough to help you.” The impressive aspect for me to experience each year when visiting is that these levels of service are not just achieved as a product of training, yet primarily because it s a by product of who they are as people. Thank you folks for not only making my stay always a great memory but also for being the people you are. Looking forward to seeing you next time. Meanwhile, keep being fantastic!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: My waitress was freaking amazing and beautiful to boot love every minute of her service jaleeja was the best and I love her

reviews.title: Easy, vibey, beautiful
reviews.text: We had such a great time! Definitely more vibey than the resort pool. Great music, great service. Daphne, our server, made it such a great experience. She was super attentive and super sweet. :)

Kendall was amazing at the front desk! He explained everything and made this a day for my son to remember at the Palms Place. We ate at the Laguna Resturant and stayed the night for a mini staycation. We will return again.

reviews.title: Would not return
reviews.text: Room itself was pretty dated with an odd design. Unable to use the balcony at all - totally locked to guests. 3 fridges, but no . . . robes? The bathroom faucet handle kept falling off. The lighting was dim and purple in places - so it was like entering a club, not a bedroom. Very limited towels and paper products and good luck getting any from housekeeping or the front desk. Took us 4 series of phone calls to get any, and that was after INSANELY BAD attitude from Kentrell at the front desk. He was so rude. Avoid him at all costs if you value being treated like a human.

reviews.title: The Hostess with mostest Jaleesa!!!
reviews.text: While visiting Palms Place Resident Pool...I had wonderful encounter with the lovely hostess Jaleesa. She was a delight, helpful, and very nice. 10 out 10 she made my experience ever bit of enjoyable! If you go look for the very vibrant and colorful young lady with beautiful smile!! Thank you Jaleesa 💕
Jaleesa was the only server on the floor and there were no delays. She was on top of everything. Thank you so much! Happy birthday to me!

Jaleesa, thanks a million for the awesome service! You went above and beyond to make everything perfect, and your accommodating spirit made the experience so much better. Love how you kept things fun and friendly! Thank you again.

We had a fantastic experience at Palms Place Hotel! During our stay, we visited the Laguna Pool House, where Jalessa truly made our day special with her wonderful spirit and energy. The pool itself was absolutely amazing, adding to our wonderful family getaway. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Best Service and Great Pool!!
reviews.text: I went to Laguna Pool House to have a girl's day. The atmosphere was inviting and welcoming. Our hostess Jaleesa was so fun and awesome!! She made excellent recommendations and constantly came to check on us. The food and drinks were delicious and reasonable. I will definitely be back and hope to get Jaleesa as our hostess; she was everything!!

reviews.title: Sunday Funday Laguna Pool at the Palms
reviews.text: Sunday Funday.... Hot as Hell In Vegas. We Spent our day at the Laguna pool located at the Palms Hotel  and we had s blast.  Pool attendant Jaleesa was Amazing and a Hoot. She continously checked in on us and made sure we were surviving the heat. Thank you Jaleesa! If your evet get s chance to visit Las vegas you should check out this pool.

reviews.title: Excellent service!! So much fun!
reviews.text: I brought my family to the Laguna Pool House and it was the most wonderful experience. Our host Jalessa was so full of energy and kind to us. She was very resourceful and made sure we had everything we needed. The food and drinks were excellent!! You can tell she enjoys being of service. We will definitely plan to come again!

reviews.title: Jaleesa: The Star of Laguna Pool House & Kitchen
reviews.text: Jaleesa at Laguna Pool House & Kitchen is a fantastic server! She went above and beyond to make the visit memorable. Her recommendations were excellent, and her positive attitude and attentiveness created an enjoyable experience by the pool. Exceptional service is appreciated, and Jaleesa is highly recommended to anyone visiting Palms Place!

reviews.title: Jalessa- the most Amazing host at Laguna Pool and Kitchen
reviews.text: We had the absolute pleasure of being served by Jalessa at Laguna Pool House & Kitchen inside Palms Place, and she was phenomenal from start to finish! Her warm energy, professionalism, and attentiveness truly elevated our entire poolside experience.Jalessa went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable, refreshed, and having a great time. From recommending the best drinks to keeping everything flowing with perfect timing, she was on point the entire day.  We wanted a more fun yet intimate pool experience and she made our pool party experience extra exciting!  Her friendly attitude and genuine care made us feel like VIPs.If you're visiting Laguna Pool House, ask for Jalessa , she’s the definition of top-tier hospitality. Thank you so much for making our day so enjoyable and memorable. I highly recommend her. We’ll definitely be back!

reviews.title: Laguna, kitchen and pool review of a specific server
reviews.text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Shoutout for Daphne Van Daye – Laguna Kitchen/Pool ServiceI’ve had some ups and downs during my stay here, however, this is my favorite hotel in town and I’m here every month for at least two or three nights for this particular review. I want to focus on Daphne Van Daye. She  has been a constant bright spot. She is professional, kind, and truly goes above and beyond to make guests feel welcome.After a personal situation left me heartbroken during my stay in May 2025,  Daphne noticed I was struggling and went out of her way to check on me — something I’ll never forget. Her kindness isn’t just for show — I’ve seen her treat every guest with the same  care. Daphne is an absolute asset to Laguna Kitchen, the pool area, and this hotel.

reviews.title: Palms Place- Rojo Lounge/Bar
reviews.text: Stayed at the Palms. My family and I came to Palms Place for the Rojo Bar. We had an excellent experience with host and mixologist Sara the Bartender. She was so attentive and made the best drinks. Her kindness brought us back the next day with an even better experience. Highly reccommend this place. Happy Hour is a great time to come.

reviews.title: Great vibes and drinks at Rojo Bar!! Ask for Sara the Bartender!
reviews.text: Perfect post-pool hangout spot with the most charismatic mixologist in all of Vegas! Sara the bartender was 10 for 10 with the drink recs, she hooked us up personalized mixed cocktails at Rojo Bar. We enjoyed her drinks and warmth so much we went two days in a row. Sara’s the best, she’s a real one!

reviews.title: A very nice place
reviews.text: The place is very nice and cozy and the staff are very friendly and helpful especially Dennis he was very courteous and helpful

reviews.title: Bummer
reviews.text: The price was great flight great West Jet direct flights great times 550.00 Canadian tax in also included Hotel / Crazy 550 Canadain all in . The hotel was the Link / next door to  Harrahs . For me i considered this best part of strip. After checking in i signed up for a players card.  The cage lady doing the Players card told me to take it over to a machine and swipe for a prize saying you can pick. I picked a show in the Hotel for Wednesday. This was a disco show of some short. Any thing else they were offering was un clear to me so i picked it . This was a sunday i arrived. So I went to enquire about the tickets on tues since show was Wednesday.  funny a room key i had one was advertisong the show . Went to players booth told me after looking it up its too let your ticket should of come out of the machine were they told me to swipe it day i arrived i explained if that is the case nothing came out or maybe when new person comes to sign up explain swipe and your going to receive a print out for your prize. After pushing the matter i gave up.Hotel and others in las vegas nickle diming i found been to Vegas over 15 times never seen it like this

reviews.title: At Pool
reviews.text: I had the most wonderful bartender named Jaleesa at the pool she definitely had really great and beautiful mood always kept a smile and me laughing everytime she checked on me and always made sure I was good on drinks or whatever I needed and plus I’m in a wheelchair so she made sure I was helped whenever I needed and always checked on me

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Great place, much to do in the resort, also close to a lot of food and not too far from the strip. Had a great view and the room looked nice overall.

reviews.title: Jaleesa was amazing!
reviews.text: My girlfriends and I paid a visit to Laguna at the Palms place and had an amazing time. Jaleesa was an amazing server the whole time she made sure we were taken care of which made our time!

reviews.title: Pool Party
reviews.text: My friend had her graduation party/pool party at the Palms Laguna pool and it was an amazing experience, especially due to the amazing service given by the staff, specifically Jaleesa that made sure we had everything and cleaned up our area frequently.

reviews.title: Above and beyond
reviews.text: Lorena was an amazing host, she went above and beyond  to take care of us and made us feel like home. Great food and the service was EXCELLENT, unbelievable fantastic. We will definitely be back for more. Highly recommended. Gracias Lorena🫶🏼

reviews.title: Jaleesa is dope AF
reviews.text: Jaleesa was an amazing host. Very attentive and accommodating to off the menu requests 10/10 🔥🔥🔥 I Will come back for sure. Stayed at the pool for hours and Jaleesa made me feel like I was at home. Give that girl a raise……………………………………………..

reviews.title: Sara the Bartender 👍
reviews.text: Went to the hotel bar/resturant. Sara, the bartender was so sweet and conversational. Not realizing we came in 30 min before closing, she was adamant we stay and enjoy some drinks. Cheers Sara, hope to see you again in the future! “Girls from Utah” *not Utah, Az ha!

reviews.title: Best bar tender
reviews.text: I was a little disappointed that my room wasn’t ready when I got to the hotel, but I stopped into Rojo, the little bar next too reception to wait and had the best experience! Thee Bartender, Sarah was absolutely amazing, super friendly and very professional. I totally forgot my room wasn’t ready! She made me an amazing drink, never had anything like it. I’ll definitely be back :)

reviews.title: Pool side service
reviews.text: Hanging out by the pool was the best because of the service we received from Jaleesa. She made sure we had everything we needed. She was doing such a good job with everybody she was helping.Made our day so much better . Thank you Jaleesa! Definitely would come back to hang out in the pool area.

reviews.title: Jaleessa is amazing
reviews.text: Jaleessa did an amazing job. Love her energy and gave us recommendations. We went to the bar and enjoyed some drinks and food before a show. My wife and I enjoyed talking to he. We came in a little late we were served well. We ate shrimp tacos and I had a whiskey. Will recommend to other.

reviews.title: Sara the Bartender

reviews.title: Best suite, pool, and staff!
reviews.text: Beautiful property! Amazing staff! Shawna Bowman is such a wonderful person! She took care of us and made sure we knew where everything was. Jaleesa served us poolside, and she is unmatched! The beautiful pool, the wonderful hot tub, the amazing food, the superb view from our gorgeous room all made our visit the best ever! We can't wait to return!

From the moment we arrived, Jaleesa made our experience unforgettable. She was incredibly attentive, warm, and welcoming, greeting us with a bright smile and ensuring we were comfortable throughout our time. Her sweet and friendly nature truly stood out, and it felt like she genuinely cared about making our visit as enjoyable as possible. It’s rare to come across someone so dedicated and enthusiastic, and her service went above and beyond anything we expected.Every interaction with Jaleesa felt personal and sincere. She anticipated our needs before we even had to ask and was always nearby without ever being intrusive. Whether it was offering helpful suggestions or simply checking in to see how we were doing, she struck the perfect balance of professionalism and genuine hospitality.We left feeling like we had been treated not just as customers, but as valued guests. Jaleesa is truly a gem, and her presence elevated our entire experience. If you're considering visiting, we wholeheartedly recommend it—especially if you have the chance to be looked after by Jaleesa. 10/10 would recommend. We couldn’t have asked for better service!

reviews.title: Perfect Day at the Pool
reviews.text: We are traveling from Utah and although it’s been windy, we still wanted to capture as much sunshine as we can. Jaleesa was fantastic from cradle to grave! She communicated specials and gave solid suggestions. Excellent service with a positive attitude, I will be returning!

reviews.title: Great customer service from Jaleesa
reviews.text: We stay at the penthouse suite at palms place I fell in love with the pool at palms place the customer service pool side was outstanding our server Jaleesa made our experience there amazing she provided prompt service drinks was good and food was fresh she also suggested we get cabanna we had and amazing time can't wait to come back

reviews.title: Davis Anniversary 2025
reviews.text: The Palms Place was a great choice, the room was nice and spacious we spent time at the pool and Jaleesa catered to our ever need, her customer service was top notch, she made our Anniversary special.We will be back to celebrate ever year from now on.

reviews.title: Vegas
reviews.text: Visited las vegas for my birthday with my sister.  What an amazing time! After days of shows,  ATV Rentals and experiences, we decided to hang at the Laguna Pool at the palms place.  Daphne Vandaele was our host for a cabana at the pool. Great energy, took great care of us, and very professional. You can tell she's been doing this for awhile. She made sure we had a great time and our cabanba was always stocked. Music was right on. Recommend you go see Daphne to complete your trip on vegas.

reviews.title: Pool time, cool time!!
reviews.text: This is a review for the pool.Jaleesa, our server, was amazing. We have owned a condo here for about 11 years. Sadly, we don’t get to the pool very often, since we have family here and lots of errands to run when we visit.Our experience hanging out playing ping-pong and cornhole was fun. But the service from Jaleesa made our day. I highly recommend spending some time poolside. It was a great break for us!

reviews.title: Sara the Bartender
reviews.text: Our bartender was amazing!! 10/10 Drinks were made with fresh fruit and were refreshing. Shoutout to Sara the Bartender!! We had a ranch water as well, normally don’t like them but this one was so good!! We will definitely be going back to see her before we leave! Thank you!!

reviews.title: Laguna and Pool are amazing!
reviews.text: Jelessa is so sweet. She was our pool waitress and made us feel  really comfortable and cared about!Never knew a regular Vegas hotel and pool experience included cocktail servers. Great to have Jelessa!She answered all our questions, and All our orders came out correctly and so quick. Laguna is awesome and their staff will not disappoint.The bartenders indoors were so amazing as well!

reviews.title: Laguna Restaurant
reviews.text: Horrible experience at Laguna restaurant. We had just landed in Vegas so we decided to find a restaurant in our hotel and regretted coming to Laguna. We waited over 15 minutes for our drinks and our server Aretha was very inattentive and took so long in between visits we had to ask other servers for help. Our meal came out with several mistakes, was bland and just not worth the price. Steer clear of this place, if you're looking for a good food spot try going to palms instead, way better options.

reviews.title: Angie Kramer!!!!!
reviews.text: we rented an Airbnb at the palms place. beautiful room would definitely recommend! 50th floor spa suite! It was amazing! The room was gorgeous and the view was breathtaking! My husband and I were coming to Vegas to renew our wedding vows. We had never been there and it was our first time renting a Airbnb. I had a lot of questions about the room and the city so I called the Palms and was so lucky to meet the most amazing person!!! Angie Kramer! OMG can not say enough about this lady! If you are looking for good customer service the Palms has it. I couldn't believe what all this beautiful woman did for us!When we got to our room it was beautifully decorated with Happy Anniversary balloons, rose petals and a "we still do" banner! She wasn't able to decorate herself but had some friends who work there do it. However she bought everything out of her own pocket! I had asked her if she could find me one single yellow rose for our ceremony. She couldn't so she bought the most beautiful bouquet with yellow roses! again out of her own pocket! and these beauties are still going strong in my living room!Talking to her was instantly like talking to an old friend! she is the sweetest person and so sincere! I do believe I found a friend for life in this fabulous soul!if you are thinking about staying at the palms make sure to ask for Angie! she is the absolute best at what she does!

reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text: Loved our stay especially with Daphne V. Best hostess at the pool made our stay feel special. The pool was clean and food was good good music also pool needs to be a little warmer but besides all was great! We had the wrap around patio which was amazing

reviews.title: Great place, great views, great vibes
reviews.text: We stayed at Palms for an extended work trip. We visited Rojo the main lobby bar/lounge. Sara was our bartender and she was INCREDIBLE she gave us great food and drink recommendations. Her personality was also adorable and added to the wonderful vibe that Rojo represented. We definitely recommend staying here and visiting Sara at Robo. Keep being amazing!

reviews.title: Laguna Bar and pool
reviews.text: Our get away from the snow in Mammoth a few times a year to warm up and soak up the sun... Jaleesa and Casey from Laguna Pool and Bar area is an awesome way to pass time in and out of the pool. Always attentive and a kind smile through out the day in the sun.

reviews.title: Be aware!!
reviews.text: Stayed at the Palms Place this weekend for a birthday celebration. I booked my reservations through American Express travel. Unknowingly, my room was reserved with Strip View Suites. The experience was absolutely terrible.From check in to check out. The room was not functional, filthy, and smelled the pungent stench of sewage. Strip View Suites at Palms Place wanted to know about the experience, and it was absolutely awful. Here are pictures!There are plenty more to share. From broken TV's, broken bathroom fixtures, all appliances in the kitchen not working, ripped curtains. The list goes on. Not to mention, Crystal refused to help, hung up on me when I called, then sent my call to voicemail each time I called back. I do not recommend this business or the Palms Place. We should have stayed at the motel 6, as the accommodations would have been much better!The staff at the Palms Place helped as minimally as possible. Awful experience.

reviews.title: My birthday trip stay had me frustrated and disappointed
reviews.text: 1/5This was my first visit to the Palms for my birthday celebration, expecting a luxurious and seamless experience, but unfortunately, it was far from that. I will say the location is great, taxi’s are always available. SEND noodles was great!! the clerk at AYCE was rude and the buffet was 2/5. Everything was cold. First, the one-bedroom suite was disappointing—poorly maintained and not up to the standards expected at this price point.  Black out curtains in the bedroom were torn and ripped from the ceiling. The drawers kept getting stuck so you’d have to almost break the door. The lighting in the bathroom kept flickering on and off. To make matters worse, the dryer didn’t work, making it incredibly inconvenient for us. Maintenance never showed up, but Justin the front desk clerk was notified. The staff was disorganized and lacked communication. Simple requests took forever to be addressed, and it seemed like no one knew what was going on. Every interaction was frustrating, with delays and miscommunication at every turn. Security would you see walk by/greet you and then asked to see your room key card. Management attempted to compensate by waiving resort fees and offering a food credit, but when I checked my bill, the food credit was nowhere to be found. This just added to the overall lack of professionalism and attention to detail.For a hotel that presents itself as high-end, the service was anything but. Broken amenities, unresponsive management, and empty promises made this stay disappointing, especially for a special occasion. There are far better options in Las Vegas that actually value their guests. I celebrated my 35th in Vegas.. I wouldn’t recommend staying here.

reviews.title: The Palms Place Las Vegas
reviews.text: We've stayed at the Palms Place on several occasions in the past year, and continue to return to this location based on their wonderful hospitality, sense of security, and great location.On our most recent trip, we would like to acknowledge Tasha at the check in desk, for making sure we were taken care of.

reviews.title: Front desk service
reviews.text: Natasha at the front desk was beyond helpful today!  We drove in from San Francisco and arrived tired. Natasha was happy to help us check in and provide genuine and excellent service.  Thank yall for your help! Would love to come back and receive service from her. ⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.title: Hidden Gem
reviews.text: We spent 2 days @ the Palms. On Friday afternoon while exploring the property, we stumbled upon the Palm Place restaurant.  The gentlemen who greeted us was extremely warm . Don't know that we had plans to stay, but based on Kevion's focus on our experience,  we ended up sitting at the bar. We had such great service, drinks ,food & conversation we came back on Saturday as well.If you're staying at the Palms, it's worth making the walk to Palms Place, Kevion & team will absolutely take care of you.

reviews.title: Sara the Bartender at Palms Laguna Bar
reviews.text: Sara the Bartender was simply amazing! 👏 👌👌👍👍👏 👏  Her drinks are everything! Her personality is a gem. She has a specialty drink called the Rasberry Kiss, and it's a must get. Thanks for a great night, Sara, the Bartender at Palms Laguna Bar 🤗😊

reviews.title: Great Food Great Drinks Great People
reviews.text: We are in Vegas for my girlfriends birthday. On our first night we checked out the sports bar Laguna on the 6th floor. We had a fun conversation with the Bartender, Davion. Great guy! So much so we came back to watch the big game on Sunday! Same great time, awesome place. Go BIRDS!

reviews.title: The perfect Birthday Brunch
reviews.text: My wife and I enjoyed her birthday brunch at Laguna’s . The chicken and waffles were fire 🔥!!! But above all else the customer service was amazing. Lorena was our waitress . She was very pleasant , great with suggestions and made sure we didn’t have to ask for anything

reviews.title: Palm takes care of their guests
reviews.text: First night here. Outstanding property amd view. At Laguna restaurant, Aretha TOTALLY took care of me and my wife. Thanks for a great start! Looking forward to a cathartic getaway from the eastern time zone. View of Las Vegas is abslutely spectacular.

reviews.title: 20 year anniversary stay didn't disappoint great location to everything we wanted to do
reviews.text: Beautiful mountain views & of the Strip easily accessible to the casino via the Skywalk great tipped valet. Well appointed mini kitchen has a keurig and coffee pot (bring your own pods) Lovely rain shower and amazing jacuzzi tub.  Save yourself some money and book with Air B&B (no resort fees)

reviews.title: Staycation at Palms Place
reviews.text: Room was great and had an awesome Vegas theme. Aretha at the Laguna restaurant on the 6th was wonderful. The valet parking is free as well. They check you in like your at a hotel. They want 200 min characters so I will just say that the rooms are reasonably priced and the staff is great here.

reviews.title: Las Vegas site seeing and show
reviews.text: Unbelievable property. Stayed on the 23rd floor with views of The Sphere and the Vegas Strip. Great room for fantastic price. Food and drinks 24/7. Staff was awesome. Will only stay at this property when visiting Las Vegas. Easy access to all areas and airpot.

reviews.title: Do not recommend
reviews.text: Strip view king bed suite. No views. The fridge was broken. The lights were broken. The tub was leaking. The AC was old and loud. The pillows were stink. We didn’t want to give them a hard time but they have no service and charge additional for resort fees.

reviews.title: Laguna kitchen bar
reviews.text: Penelope and Davion were great! The Chinese chicken salad was excellent!!Also loved the tuna tartare and chicken wings. Fun spot. Penelope’s personality carried the environment. Also in addition our stay at the Palms has been really lovely. I love the SOS buttons.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Casey is an awesome 10 star perfect person leaving the drinks as amazing as ever, you feel like you could be good friends with Casey. An excellent communicator. Simply put.. this is one of the greatest young professionals you will find in Vegas.

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: Great location for an overall view of the Vegas strip. Connected to the Casino.Food was good. Our room had everything we need. Bed was comfortable .Elevator was fast from the 53 floor. Staff very happy and ensure your safety and security..................

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: I just want to say that front desk is amazing specifically Natasha she works day time at front desk . She is amazing always really helpful and really nice... She has great personality and makes everything way easier... She is always on task .... Great customer service . She is the best .....

reviews.title: A welcome oasis in the middle of the desert
reviews.text: Fantastic stay! One of the best attributes and qualities about staying at Palms Place is that you are away from the casinos and the inundation of busyness and the chaotic energy of the Strip.  However, you will be close enough to everything that it's still extremely convenient to get to and from destinations in and around the area. From the concierge to valet, everyone was professional, friendly, polite and very efficient at their jobs. Tom and Jonathan with the valet we're timely with our vehicle and very kind. Will and Breanna at the front desk were incredibly personable and provided top notch service.The rooms were very clean and orderly. The rest of the hotel staff including room service and the cleaning crew were very hospitable and respectful.I highly recommend staying here for your Vegas trip, especially if you're not looking to stay in a casino and searching for something that's away from the nightlife (that can be overwhelming to some) when coming into Vegas for business or something other than gambling.10/10 would recommend and stay here again!

reviews.title: Awesome pool day!
reviews.text: The pool experience was a vibe. Friends and family enjoyed themselves very much. Daph was amazing we all had a great time! The lifeguards were exceptional and very kind. All the staff was very professional with great customer service. Thank you all!

reviews.title: Best service ever
reviews.text: After having a not so good morning, I decided to go down to the pool at Palms Place. The entire staff was amazing, but Melissa outdid herself. She went out of her way to refill my beer and water buckets with ice about 4 times, to keep my beverages cold- gave me amazing recommendations(spicy mango marg is delicious) and was overall so polite. She made my Sunday so much better. Very attentive. If you’re lucky enough to have her as your server, she won’t let you down. Thank you again Melissa. I look forward to my next stay.

reviews.title: 5 stars for Natasha
reviews.text: This review is specifically for Natasha at the front desk. I come here a lot and she is amazing. She is very straight forward and knows Palms Place well. She has a great energy every time I see her. I’ve heard that sometimes she will sing Lady in Red if you’re really nice and dressed well.

reviews.title: Overpriced Airbnb dump
reviews.text: The original review written 2 wks ago is gone. I repeat, Palms Place is NOT a hotel & spa. It needs to be advertised for what it is, a dingy filthy outdated privately owed overpriced airbnb/condo connected by a 2nd floor tunnel & escalator to Palms. The pics are misleading, they must’ve been taken decades ago and they should leave the Palms pics out of it altogether. No paper towels or utensils-only a blender and tea kettle, Both the bathroom sink and shower clogged, rug & towels look like car wash rejects, couch looks like it came from good will, balcony deadbolt locked with a sign prohibiting furniture on the it. Confusing separate elevators for higher floors. The tub jets were noticeably bright sunburst yellow in stark contrast to the tub, venturing into it wasn’t even a thought. The soles of brand new slippers only worn in this room are now black. It needs a full renovation from the studs up or to be totally leveled for additional parking. It should be reported as a health hazard. Save your $$$ and stay on the strip or elsewhere at a lower cost with better accommodations and surroundings.The one and only positive is the staff were nice.

reviews.title: Stay in a private condo
reviews.text: We stayed in a private condo which was spectacular. Unfortunately the service around reception, concierge desk and security let the whole experience down. The staff only seem interested in their own business, chatting with each other and blatantly ignoring any issues around them. The pool staff are fantastic in comparison. Attentive and proactive. We booked a condo one day which was a very nice experience. If you stay in a private condo through the likes of air b n b, you get to use the balconies which offer spectacular views from high floors.

The check in at the front desk with Joseph was easy and fast considering there was a long line. His attitude remained professional and patient. He was very informative, helpful and nice. We’d come here again for the hospitality and comfort.

reviews.title: The service begins before I checked in
reviews.text: I took an early flight into Las Vegas and wondered how I would pass the time to await check in timeMy experience began with the excellent service of the bell staff who kindly secured my bag while I explored the hotel and the area.The  bar ..pool and wait staff ....who lavished wonderful service on myself and other guests..Daphne…Penelope..Davion…Tyvion..the pool staff were amazing Thank you for taking such great care ..give them all a raise

reviews.title: Chill Vegas Vibe
reviews.text: Truly a great Vegas experience!! Beautiful view from our room 34th floor balcony. We spent a day at the pool Daphne was our waitress.  Great service…food was great…limited menu at the pool but delicious…drinks did not disappoint either.  Connects to Palms Casino…approximately 5 min walk.  The food and service there also phenomenal.  And can Uber to the strip for less than $10 depending where you want to go.  The rooms have fridge and microwave.  And the shower/tub setup is great too!!

reviews.title: Palms Place/Suites Room disappointment
reviews.text: After traveling across America, we were excited to reach Las Vegas, our final stop. We chose Palms Place based on online images of the suite room featuring a balcony, a large Jacuzzi and in-room washing facilities. Unfortunately, our experience did not meet expectations. Upon arrival, we found the room lacked cleanliness, with dusty furniture and empty toiletries such as the body wash bottles that were never replenished. The Jacuzzi also malfunctioned, making loud noises throughout the night. A major letdown was the locked balcony doors, which were not disclosed as inaccessible during booking, despite being a key reason for our choice. Additionally, the washing facilities were locked, which was inconvenient given our heavy luggage. We informed the receptionist of these issues upon checkout and suggest these details be clearly communicated online to avoid future disappointments.Very disappointed. Caitlin 🇬🇧

reviews.title: Best experience we had at a Las Vegas restaurant
reviews.text: Thanks to our server Leo for making this a great experience at the palms Leo was very intuitive and also helped us out with some photos. Food was delicious the best we had that week in Vegas I highly recommend this location and hopefully you’ll have Leo as your server

reviews.title: For the Money and Luxury, what a place
reviews.text: Had an absolutely amazing time at the Palms Place. We’ve stayed at about four hotels here in this by far was the nicest, most affordable and most luxurious in a way. Our room had a kitchenette, which helped us cook home-cooked meals versus eating out every single meal. Also, Jesse Mae at the front desk was incredible each time we needed something. She simply was a joy to work with from start to finish. Thank you for the awesome customer service Jesse and to the rest of the staff including valet for 5 star service.

reviews.title: Palms Place - Best weekend getaway!
reviews.text: We had a little issue with our Expedia booking that potentially would’ve tanked our plans. Thank you to Joseph, Palms Place hotel manager, for saving the day! We got to enjoy our plans as intended and thank you to Julissa at the Laguna Pool for the top-notch customer service at the pool the next day. This is a great hotel, with great accommodations and most importantly, the excellent customer service that is expected in Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Unreal Experience!
reviews.text: Staff are lovely and so welcoming! Joseph at reception was a great help and made us Scottish girls feel very welcome when arriving early and just landed. The staff at the pool were great. Thank you! We are looking forward to our stay at Palms Place!

reviews.title: Love This Place!’
reviews.text: This place is the best stay!! From the booking with a lady name Angie K. She was awesome super friendly and really helped me. The conversation alone made me feel like I was speaking with my Mum. The front desk clerk Priscilla was super friendly, went above and beyond to help us, she was great!!! Smiling, great attitude. Stay here trust me.

reviews.title: Disgusting Conditions!
reviews.text: The condos are no well kept and are dirty.There was blood on the couch and walls.We found a used condom in the couch.So many safety hazards ! You pay for a room and the tub doesn’t work the refrigerator is broken and dirty. The water was coming out yellow from the sink!!

reviews.title: Excellent pool service
reviews.text: We came to the Palms to use the pool as it was rated with the best reviews for the use of the Cabana. It was a very beautiful place, very great staff, good drinks, and Daphne VanDaele was exceptional. The water was refreshing, the pool was very clean.

reviews.title: Amazing Girls Day!
reviews.text: My friends and I rented a cabana in the beginning of August 2024. Jaleesa took care of us from the moment we walked in til the moment we were walking out. She constantly checked in on us, even while we were in the pool to make sure we were well accommodated. The food, drinks, and service were all 10/10. The only thing I wish we had were optional curtains to help shade the cabana if it got too hot. Would rent again!

reviews.title: Cabana Amazing
reviews.text: Jaleesa was super helpful and attentive for our cabana. She always came to check up on us and brought us everything!She’s an amazing person and she made everything smooth and stress free. You will be lucky if she is your cabana host! Thank you so much.

reviews.title: Great bartenders
reviews.text: The rooms are very nice and the staff is great. Love the pool area and staff. Cool vibe. Casey and Sarah are amazing bartenders. And Ruthy at the front desk is super sweet and helpful. Best place to stay to get away from the crazy strip but still close enough to jump back into the action.

reviews.title: Good Vibes
reviews.text: Aretha Has To Be One Of The Best Servers I’ve  Have Came Encounter With. I Will Be Back Again Mostly Because Of Her. Thanks For The Good Vibes Helping Is With Our Food Choices And Most Of All Thank You For The Birthday Wishes To My Lady. Have A Blessed Day.

reviews.title: Great time at the Laguna
reviews.text: Aretha was such a great server at the Laguna! Very attentive, kind, and helpful. She made great suggestions and accommodated in any way she could! She even went above and beyond with our meals. Made my birthday dinner a great experience, I’ll definitely be back!

reviews.title: Brunch at Laguna
reviews.text: We are locals and ate at the Laguna Kitchen. Leo was our waiter. Very nice guy who knows the menu, knows the hotel and amenities they provide. There was a DJ spinning vinyl from the 80's. Don't see much vinyl anymore but he was great!  The food was also great and Leo was more than accommodating. We will be back. Can't wait to see the lunch and dinner menus.

reviews.title: Laguna Pool House & Kitchen at Palms Place
reviews.text: I had lunch at the Palms Place Kitchen and have to write a review for our lovely server, Leo!!! He made my colleague’s last day before her flight magical. I am a frequent guest of Palms Place but had no idea how wonderful the Pool House & Kitchen experience would be. Thank you Leo!!!!Love,-JACQ

reviews.title: So much yes
reviews.text: Amazing deep bathtub, fantastic shower! Comfortable bed. Amazing Mountain View. Good sound control neighbors didn't hear us or complain that we were being too loud. Fast service, super friendly staff. I can't say enough good things. If you haven't stayed here you should!

reviews.title: Laguna Pool Review
reviews.text: I want to shout out the host Mary. She was amazing in helping me set up my sister’s birthday celebration. She was personable and answered all my questions. Mary set up our cabana reservation at the Laguna pool. The pool is a roof top pool with beautiful views. It’s all ages (family friendly) and more of a “chill” vibe, compared to the palms pool. Our server was Jaleesa. She was also amazing. Even brought out the birthday girl a special shot. All the food was great, don’t skip on the chicken fingers were my favorite. Thank you to both Mary and Jaleesa for making our experience a great one!

reviews.title: Great quick trip!
reviews.text: Great experience at the Palms place hotel. From the moment Rick took my truck in valet, to Jay with my luggage, and Breanna at the check in counter, everyone was courteous and kind. Breanna was very helpful with checkin, we had a minor issue with the reservation we made via a different website, but she was amazing and got the problem resolved in a timely manner and we were in our room almost immediately. Highly recommended hotel.

reviews.title: Sunday Brunch Smile
reviews.text: Hubby and I went for Sunday brunch. He had been already and wanted me to check it out :)  The ambience was abso beauty.  Restaurant had direct view of pool. Fireplace, tables and everything was very nice.  Even had a private room for additional event space. Best part was the music and DJ. The food was delish!  Suggestion is to offer more of it!  The waiter Gabriel was awesome. Professional and attentive. The other wait staff were great too. Highly recommend for a quiet cozy spot to enjoy food music and company at the pool lol.

reviews.title: Great visit to Palms Place
reviews.text: Good trip & good service from Alena & staff. I use to stay here from time to time while refereeing summer high school basketball tournaments a few years back. And I hadn't been here nor to the Palms hotel since. But I was happy with the price point, amenities & service we received on our long weekend getaway

reviews.title: My New Go To Vegas Hotel
reviews.text: My wife and I visit Vegas at least once a year and have always stayed on the Strip.  We chose to change things up, largely because our interests and dining choices are no no longer strongly strip-centered.  In short, my wife and I ADORED our stay at the Palms Place and we WILL be back.  A few things stood out:  1) Cleanliness (the room was spotless on arrival).  2) Service (every single person we encountered was pleasant and helpful, this included the hotel and the casino/restaurants staff), 3) Room features (from a full fridge with an ice machine, to a dual head-shower and jacuzzi tub for two, Palms Place was a home away from a home) 4) Free parking (and it was directly adjacent to the hotel...no schelp across miles of casino and retail to the parking deck here) 5) Quiet tower away from the Palms Casino floor (its a short walk down a purpose built interior corridor).  We had a mountain view room on a high floor and the view to the west was spectacular and mesmerizing.  Thank you to everyone at the Palms Place.  If I could give you six stars, I would!

reviews.title: Kevion is amazing 👏🏾
reviews.text: My family and I had the pleasure in being hosted by Kevion. He was very attentive in checking on us which was truly appreciated. Kevion customer service was A-1, Palms you have to recognize him for his exceptional customer service. Thanks you again Kevion

reviews.title: If you’re looking for the Palms hotel and casino, you’ve come to the wrong place. Don’t make the same mistake. I did.
reviews.text: If you’re looking for the Palms hotel and casino, you’ve come to the wrong place. Don’t make the same mistake. I did.

reviews.title: Great customer service, Jaleesa
reviews.text: Jaleesa did an amazing job ! So fast always checking up on us and getting our drinks in a timely matter. Thank you so much ! The experience was great! I’d definitely come again, food was amazing- shrimp tacos & fries… let’s not forget the fruit !

reviews.title: Unwanted pest in our room.
reviews.text: Our first stay at the Palms was marred by a significant issue. While the hotel is beautiful and the bathroom impressive, we encountered roaches in our room. My husband saw one early Sunday morning, and I spotted another later that morning, which I killed and photographed. Upon checkout, I reported this to the staff. The response was disappointingly lacking in empathy or concern. The employee merely said she’d inform the cleaning department, offering no apology or compensation until I specifically requested it. Even then, only the resort fees were waived. This experience was deeply unsettling and ruined our stay. I’m sharing this to alert management about both the pest problem and the need for better staff training in handling such situations. A hotel of this caliber should maintain higher standards of cleanliness and customer service. Thank you for allowing me to share my experience. It was room 11-303 on June 8, 2024.

reviews.title: Enjoyed myself!
reviews.text: The aesthetic by the pool is really gorgeous. A beautiful oasis! I went about 3 times during my stay and enjoyed each time. Brunch was my favorite. The DJ was grooving! Lol the food choices are minimal but the food is good. And the drinks are cute and strong. I love this hotel, kinda a hidden gem 💎

reviews.title: Great food & service
reviews.text: Service was amazing thank you to Gabriel. He went above & beyond to make sure we were taken care of. We came back 2 mornings in a row. Food was great. Nice pool side views. I will definitely be coming back here when I visit Las Vegas again. Highly recommended ! 😊

reviews.title: Great spot  for food, drinks ,pool and relaxing
reviews.text: Had a great time with family and friends had got a cabana at the Laguna Pool on the 6th floor with a deal for locals and had a wonderful time! It's a great location if you want a quiet, fun experience with friends without overwhelming crowds. Our server kevlon was very cool and diligent worker , drinks were delicious and Highly recommend for a hot relaxing day!!!!.

reviews.title: Peaceful and enjoyable
reviews.text: The pool staff were very accommodating and attentive to our needs. We will definitely be back as this was a great vacation and brought some peace to us all. We really enjoyed Kevion as he went out of his way to ensure we were being taken care of at all times.

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Penelope campos and Davion Curry are the best bartenders! They were extremely attentive, friendly, great conversationalist,  entire area was clean, food was good, drinks were amazing. The bar area was not overly crowded. Truly a great experience!

reviews.title: Loved
reviews.text: Kevion was amazing with bringing our room service. Super sweet and helpful. Made sure we had everything we needed. Very nice young man and he also complimented our penthouse which was nice lol would recommend palms place to any and everyone

reviews.title: Pool side
reviews.text: I was alone at the pool at the palms and received the best experience from the waiter KEVION. I was able to sit and enjoy the weather in peace. Food was hot and fruit was fresh. I was not bothered the pool was clean as well. Kevion checked on me from time to time and that was very thoughtful

reviews.title: Great experience at all he Laguana!
reviews.text: Kevion was excellent! Very attentive, patient, and accommodating! Kept checking to make sure we were good. Food was excellsteak excellent service excellent shrimp excellent! Five star service!Kevion was excellent! Very attentive, patient, and accommodating! Kept checking to make sure we were good. Food was excellsteak excellent service excellent shrimp excellent! Five star service!

reviews.title: Enjoyable poolside cabana for locals
reviews.text: I recently enjoyed a fantastic time at our poolside cabana at Palms Place, thanks for our outstanding server, Jaleesa. Her friendly demeanor and attentive service truly elevated our day. Jaleesa was not only prompt and efficient, but also went above and beyond to ensure we had everything we needed. Her warm personality and professionalism made our visit memorable. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Great Service,  great drinks, even better staff!
reviews.text: We stayed at The Palms and decidws to walk over to the The Palms Place and site see. We came across The Laguna Kitchen and Bar. The bartender was so kind and very knowledgeable of the area. It was our anniversary and she made us feel very special. Not to mention her hype woman Jaleesa ;)

reviews.title: Great spot for cabana day with friends
reviews.text: We rented a cabana at the Laguna Pool on the 6th floor, and had a wonderful time! It's a great location if you want a quieter, upscale experience with friends without overwhelming crowds. Our server, Daphne, was awesome, drinks were excellent, and they had a locals discount running! Highly recommend for a relaxing day.

reviews.title: Wonderful front desk staff!
reviews.text: My friend and I came to celebrate her birthday and stayed at the Palms Place.  We ran into some issues with a third party company.  Priscilia and Que at the front desk, went out of their way to make sure we were taken care of.  They stepped up when we needed the help.  We can’t thank them enough.  Thank you Priscilla and Que!  You are wonderful and deserve the recognition!

reviews.title: ENGAGED AT THE PALMS
reviews.text: To LEO, an amazing server who is so genuine and thoughtful and the perfect photographer/videographer! To DAVION, an absolute kind hearted, gentleman who serves the perfect shot! To RAFAEL, (sorry if I spelled it wrong) from the eggs to the dessert, you definitely made this the best treat! Manager JOSEPH, thank you for an experience/day I will never forget! I GOT ENGAGED here at the beautiful Laguna pool house restaurant and everyone made it the best experience I could have possibly had! I can not forget the kind lady who stands at the podium right when you walk in and remembered us she’s such a delight! (So sorry your name is skipping my mind) I had an amazing experience and I’m thankful for the staff for helping make that happen!!

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: Leguna was a hit Davion and Penelope was a vibe and a time!!! Go see them!! Redhead Pink! It was such a good time and service was worth while! Theyre friendly and turned our stay around. Letsss goo!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.title: Palms Place spa and pool
reviews.text: I recently visited the pool at Palms Place and had an incredible experience, thanks to the outstanding hospitality of Host Mary and Server Jaleese. The pool itself is stunning, with a pristine layout and a relaxing ambiance perfect for unwinding. Mary greeted us warmly and ensured we were comfortably settled, while Jaleese provided impeccable service throughout our stay. Her attentiveness and friendly demeanor truly enhanced our visit. From the refreshing drinks to the serene atmosphere, everything was top-notch. I highly recommend the Palms Place Pool for anyone seeking a luxurious and enjoyable poolside experience.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: Casey and Penelope were dope!!Your mom stinks, she lives in rock bottom where SpongeBob went when he missed the bus back home. Casey is the bartender of the year and he should be promoted to manager. Palms is a great hotel overall. Thank you and goodnight

reviews.title: Don’t miss a stop at Laguna Pool House & Kitchen
reviews.text: I’m really actually here to rate the Laguna Pool House & Kitchen inside the hotel (6th floor, I believe).If I could give our experience there a 10, I would. The staff was friendly, helpful, fun, and very polite. ***I do NOT want to suggest the precedent that this would or should happen everywhere***However, in our recent stay my sister and I went down for a late brunch. Unfortunately at the time it was not available, and we mentioned to the server that we were hoping for brunch items (we just misread the dates - it’s only on weekends). Our server kindly replied that she would check with the chef and see what he could do to accommodate us. The chef himself came to our table and offered to make us eggs with toast and homefries - from scratch!! Our server brought coffees and the food came shortly after. This was followed up by the most delicious and beautiful French toast - had edible flowers, wasn’t too sugary, was crunchy and fluffy.Oh my goodness. For everything we experienced: the presentation, taste, experience, vibe. It was all there. I know it seems simple but because of how helpful and kind the staff was, this felt like truly one of the most magical dining experiences for us. Not only did the chef and staff go above and BEYOND to meet our requests, but it was literally the most delicious meal we had our entire week in Vegas. It was cooked properly, seasoned perfectly, and really affordable. Thank you to our server Aretha - you light up the room with your positive energy!! Thank you to our chef, Rafa - you ensured that we had a delicious meal and a wonderful experience!!!!We ate there twice (first meal was in our room but outstanding no the less!! Try the Fried chicken sandwich and the passion fruit crème curler) and went back the next day for drinks and again, delicious and perfect.

reviews.title: A Serene Oasis: Palms Place Hotel And Spa
reviews.text: Nestled amidst the vibrant energy of Las Vegas, Palms Place Hotel And Spa offers a tranquil retreat from the bustling Strip. Palms Place Hotel And Spa offers a luxurious escape in the heart of Las Vegas. Whether you're seeking relaxation, excitement, or a bit of both, this hidden gem delivers an unforgettable experience.

reviews.title: Palms Place Pool Cabana
reviews.text: Came to palms place with the family for our anniversary and we got a Cabana by the pool and Jaleesa was our server and she was amazing, she made sure that we were taken care of and constantly checked on us and every order was delivered very prompt. Management is lucky to have an employee like her.

reviews.title: Poolside getaway with the fam
reviews.text: Jaleesa was amazing! She was very attentive and made sure my family and I were fully taken care of. We appreciate the quick and timely accommodations. We will happily return again soon. Thank you for your exceptional service and kindness during our time at Palm Place Pool!

reviews.title: Better than staying on the strip wree parking!
reviews.text: Rooms are luxurious and the stay is much more relaxing than a strip property. The best part is the beautiful pool and exceptional service! Jaleesa at the pool made sure we were always taken care of with the best poolside drinks in Vegas!  I highly recommend a trip to Palms Place. With the $40+ per day you save with no charge for parking, you could be using it at the pool bar. ; )

reviews.title: Amazing service
reviews.text: Went to visit the Laguna Pool house and kitchen, and the food was delicious. We met our server Aretha, and she was such a joy. She recommended the greatest foods and made us feel like apart of the family. She is what made the experience eating here amazing. So shout out to Aretha your awesome and hope everyone appreciates you like we did.

reviews.title: Average at best
reviews.text: No housekeeping on my first day. No hot water on my second day. Average at best … leaning toward poor. Also the blackout curtains didn’t function properly. Probably will not go back. And I paid for a very expensive suite!  Not good folks … not good.

reviews.title: Just to relax and get away
reviews.text: Comfortable, affordable, get away from the hustle and bustle, you don't have to worry about noise, it is quiet and relaxing, and the pool is a great place to relax and unwind.  Grab a bite at Laguna, sip a craft cocktail pool side, soak in a jetted spa tub and recharge!

reviews.title: Dining in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Went to eat at the Luguana at the Palms. I had a great time the scene was very pleasant it had a real nice beach side restaurant vibe. The white tables and fire place gave it a cozy feeling. Our server was Aretha she was very friendly and smiled all the time. She asked if this was our first time and we let her know it was. She put on a full court press when it comes to service. She keep our glasses full made recommendations that were glad we followed. The food was amazing I had  shrimp tacos and a classic burger. Looking forward to going back soon.

reviews.title: Jaleesa is Top!
reviews.text: Jaleesa has always been lovely to myself and the girls I bring to the pool. Im a Las Vegas local native and Ive been coming to the pool for 3 years summer round now, and I got to experience her last summer 2023 and this summer 2024. She always has a smile on her face, first one to greet you at the pool, very attentive in getting you what you want, and makes sure her guests are taken care of. Everything is nice there, the only opinion I have is it sucks that you guys got rid of locals being able to come to the pool for free. Nonetheless, Jaleesa still deserves her flowers and thank you for providing a wonderful experience every time I go.

reviews.title: Relaxing Poolside
reviews.text: In town celebrating an anniversary and attending a couple shows, and Palms Place was a terrific choice to stay.  The sixth floor pool was incredibly relaxing, and Melissa provided outstanding poolside service with a smile and personality to behold…thank you Melissa!

reviews.title: Top notch service
reviews.text: Visited here to celebrate. We received amazing service from Casey at Laguna bar! The drinks were amazing the food was really good and he is great company. Informed us of many things to get out and do around the city. We will definitely be returning and you should definitely see him if you decide to stay here!

reviews.title: Great Pool Area - Awesome staff
reviews.text: The pool area was really nice! Way less crowded than the other pool and the staff was very kind and funny. Kailah kept me and my daughter laughing and was very sweet and professional. We will definitely stay here again. Thanks for the Aloha Kailah!

reviews.title: Terrible Hospitality
reviews.text: The Palms Place is just ok, in terms of looks and atmosphere. There was no way to walk from public parking to the lobby.....or at least I was not told where. I wasn't told because the Front Desk staff chose to ignore me as I stood at the desk......the only person in the whole lobby, waiting to ask my question. A minute goes by, two minutes, three, no acknowledgement.  When I noticed the clerk start to acknowledge a man walking up to her. I decided I was done there,  put my keys down at her station, and said I was checking out. She decided to tell me I could have dropped them off elsewhere. "I had question", I replied. She then saw me off with a snarky, contrived "You have good day". So I decided to let her know, loudly in the lobby, "You acknowledge somebody, say hello, I'll be with you in a minute. It's not hard." And it's not. She's just terrible at her job in hospitality. I won't be back. This happened between 10:30 - 11am, May 9th. She was wearing a black blazer, magenta shirt, black hair pulled back.

reviews.title: perfect day
reviews.text: i actually have lived in palms place for 7 years but now they offered owners free cabanas.  so i grabbed one.  my host mary - got me cabana 7, brought me. bucket of ice waters.  checked on me.   also jackie served me.   i had a burger and fries.   it was great.   great day here

reviews.title: Great poolside experience!
reviews.text: Mary and Jackie from the Palms Place Laguna poolside bar were absolutely amazing, the service was great, and the food was delicious! Quick, friendly, and responsive. Mary had our cabana ready when we arrived at the pool and Jackie our server was ready to help us with anything food and beverage related!

reviews.title: Daphne Rocks!
reviews.text: This review is specifically for Daphne Van Daele who served us in the pool area.  Although is was a blustery day and we didn't get the sunshine we were hoping for, Daphne made our experience outstanding through her bright and cheery attitude and her exceptional service.  Please give this girl a raise... she is undeniably an asset to your organization!

reviews.title: 5 stars
reviews.text: Loved this spot! The pool is beautiful and chill. Daphne our pool server made our time there extra enjoyable. She's the best!

reviews.title: First Time At Palms Place and It Was Worth It
reviews.text: My wife and I were in Vegas from 4/15 - 4/18 for the NAB conference. And hands down, all of the staff there made the experience worthwhile. I feel bad because I want to acknowledge them by name, but I didn't write their names down. But just know that the staff there at Palms Place Hotel and Spa will take care of you, are very professional and friendly. And that is EVERYONE from the valet team to the check-in team, cleaning staff and everyone in between.Thank you for making it a memorable experience.

reviews.title: Amazing customer service (Oscar)
reviews.text: First of all front desk worker Oscar was so helpful checking us in, super nice & patient. Awesome customer service. Hotel is beautiful! Very clean & luxurious, so many food options & entertainment. Gambling is a for sure win here! Super recommend

reviews.title: Laguna pool house and kitchen
reviews.text: Kacey did an amazing job and had amazing service at the laguna pool house and kitchen. Couldn’t have had better service and experience!

reviews.title: Great service at the laguna pool
reviews.text: Our server Daphne Van Dyke at the laguna pool was exceptional. She went above and beyond to help us with our childs food allergies. She was sweet attentive and had great energy. I cannot wait to come back and see her again. Thank her for making our experience truly memorable.

reviews.title: Daphne
reviews.text: My day at the Laguna pool was everything I needed.  Daphne VanDaele was my server and she was the best.  So friendly and accommodating.  She was very attentive.  I really enjoyed talking with her about the menu and what was the best.  Thank you!!!!

reviews.title: 2/10 Stars. DO NOT RECOMMEND!
reviews.text: Very beautiful rooms. Very beautiful atmosphere. The best part as far as the employees went were the vallets. These amazing men and women were always on time and had my car ready and warm for me. Unfortunately the rest of the staff were either very incompetent or very rude! I have never experienced being left by the bellhop.Counter for twenty five minutes waiting for 1 employee To check my bags as they would not let the group check in to the motel due to it not being cleaned yet from a previous resident. (At this time I will mention that they had an hour and a half to clean the room before we were passed our time of check in). When this inconvenience was pointed out, the staff was ballsy enough to tell me that we could be patient!! Every time we left our room and went down to the counter or other in resort locations, Security would stop us and ask for our room key! Even if we had literally walked ten feet away to the convenience store (located on the main level of the resort) and back to our room! And when they said they did this to everyone I can prove them wrong! Save your money, go somewhere else!

reviews.title: Daphne was amazing.
reviews.text: Daphne Van Daele was outstanding at the Laguna pool and spa, others there were rude and condescending.   Seemed employees are burnt out or that's just how locals are, one (male) bartender was rude when he couldn't find my name in system.   Valet was amazing and so was Otis for security.   Front desk girls seemed to be angry and rude.   Daphne, valet, and Otis made it worth the stay.

reviews.title: ROACHES! ROACHES! ROACHES!
reviews.text: ROACHES! ROACHES! ROACHES! Broken plastic/glass in the kitchen sink! Tables/Counter tops not cleaned! Rotten egg smell in the bathroom!I thought this would be a great experience,  but it wasn't. At least not when we're coming home to this. I will most likely not stay at Palms Place again.

reviews.title: No amenities, no spa, no Rojo bar
reviews.text: Used to be nice, went down hill. Spa out of business. Pool closed. Laguna lounge had reduced hours, rojo bar closed, zero amenities in suite, housekeeping was late even when requested earlier (twice). Exorbitant resort fee of $44 per day for nothing.  Finally I had to recheck my bill to see if the resort fees were removed for lack of services and they weren’t, so the nice lady at the front had to run the folio again. Consider relisting the hotel amenities for those that are actually in the Palms Place Tower.  It’s a long walk to the casino for a cup of coffee and a massage.

reviews.title: Great service by the pool! Ask for Daphne
reviews.text: The pool was wonderful. I took my family here for a quick little get away. Pool was modern and atmosphere was fun. I must say the best part was the service.
