Our pool server daphne  went out of her way to accommodate us. The spa had been closed for some reason and it was a stormy day. We noticed it was warm and asked for the spa to be opened back up. Well, Daphne went out of her way to find the proper facilities manager, and ensure that our experience was wonderful. She was able to get them to open the spa back up per our request and we found ourselves having a wonderful time in the midst of so so weather! Will definitely be coming back and looking forward to ordering more drinks and food by the pool from our new favorite pool host!

reviews.title: Needs some work
reviews.text: The room was great. Be sure to specify with the cab that you are at Palms Place not just the Palms. If you don't you will have to walk all the way through the casino to the other side to check in. The room was big and the views were pretty cool, but they could do a more thorough job cleaning. There were grease smears on the wall and food/etc stuck around on the stove. Anything we used I washed first. Also we could not get the hot water to work for the tub.

reviews.title: Christopher FIgs
reviews.text: Penelope and Daphne are amazing bartenders and servers. I would definitely be back. Great drinks/food and conversation. The pool is amazing and the restaurant space is very luxurious. Visit here it you want good food and drinks. Make sure you tip your bartenders.

reviews.title: A Review for Palms Place Owners
reviews.text: I want to do a special shout out to Jazz and her co worker Q at the Inner Circle! This review is for the Palms Place Owners. My family calls Jazz the firemen she puts out every issue that our guests run into. They always make everyone feel special and the chat with them always makes you leave with a smile on your face.!

reviews.title: Price performance still ok
reviews.text: I had a room in the Palms Tower for 2 nights, which is probably the oldest of the 3 towers that make up the Palms Casino complex. The room on the 10th floor was very large but the furnishings, whether it was the kitchenette, bed or TV, had seen better days. The cleanliness also left a lot to be desired. The complex is quite a distance from the Strip. One positive thing was that valet parking was free.

reviews.title: STAYCATION 💕 VACATION
reviews.text: I was greeted very nicely by a lady named ruthie on a friday morning. She was very fast and explained the rates thoroughly. I would highly recommend coming in for a small vacation or a one night to get away. There are no other options for this bang for your buck!

reviews.title: Very good customer service
reviews.text: I come to Vegas for business I choose to stay at palms place as I know the employees are polite and professional! I use all services especially valet, I’d like to say a special mention for Erick in valet who is always professional, curteous and always goes above and beyond to make my stay better!

reviews.title: Palms place and Valet were amazing!
reviews.text: Stayed this last week at the Plams Place Hotel for the second time! I love it. Did valet for thr first time and it was an extremely good experience.  Erick, Tom & Ricky took great care of my Rolls Royce and Bentley Supercars. Was worried about valet handling them. These guys were excellent and I felt at ease the whole time. Top notch 5 star VIP service!!! Tip them well, they deserve it!! I'll be back soon!

reviews.title: Good Times
reviews.text: I loved my hotel! Plenty of activities in the hotel to keep busy! Staff was super friendly! Close to the the strip as well! Dispensaries literally right across the street! It was on the bus line you can ride route 202 which ran maybe every 30 minutes back and forth to strip for I think $2! Will be back!

reviews.title: PALMS PLACE FOR EXCELLENCE OF SERVICE
reviews.text: I have been traveling to Vegas for the last 10 years and I always stay at the Palms Place… it is located off the strip on Flamingo which I like, because I don’t like staying on the strip - it’s too congested, and it’s too difficult to get in and out of the properties. When I go to the Palms, I am always greeted by the valet team, which always address me by my name , welcome me to the property and take excellent care of me and my vehicle.  ONE  of the longtime employees,  Erick ,  has been helping me for years. He is so professional and pleasant and makes me feel very comfortable and my car I feel is very secure. The entire entire valet team is so professional. I hope that you can acknowledge them when you go to the Palms.  The rooms are very clean and the strip view is very exciting to be able to look out every day and in the evening it’s a stunning view. I enjoy walking over to the casino in the evening and having a nice meal as well.

reviews.title: Cool place!
reviews.text: Our suite was huge! With an amazing view of both the mountains and part of the strip.  Front desk service - Ruthy R was so kind and accommodating.   Thank you Ruthy R!!  😊  Restaurant staff were also super friendly.  We'll definitely be coming back!

reviews.title: Most awful hotel we’ve stayed at. Never again.
reviews.text: Rooms 15320-15322 Let’s start at the beginning where my family and I decided to go to Palms Place early to see if our rooms would be ready a little earlier than the 3 pm actual check-in time. We got there at 10 am and asked the lady at the front desk for early check-in. This isn’t our first go around with Vegas suites and penthouses so we know normally rooms are not always ready by 3 pm and this was fine for us in the beginning. To our surprise though the lady at the front desk said our room should be ready within 30 mins to an hour. We left again for a bit to get some things and have our son, diagnosed with Autism play and exert some energy since he was in the car most of the day. We came back around 2 hrs later (lunch time) and was told our room are not ready but apparently the lady at the desk said she would put a rush order as well. Mind you each time we checked on the status of our room you had to go back in line which was a long one each and EVERY time. Came back after lunch to check on our rooms around 2 pm and they still said it was not ready (okay it’s still not 3 pm so I was still okay at this point) and we decided naively that it’s probably not that long from here, right? We stayed in the lobby for another hour and a half or so. The weird part is we started seeing other people who had come after us getting their rooms as soon as they went to the front desk. So we left AGAIN and didn’t come back until 6:30 pm, got back in that long line of people “checking-in” to see what the status of our room was. To no surprise they said the room was still not ready. My husband was not happy to hear, “I’m sorry and I don’t know when it will be ready,” for the 10th million time. My husband told the front desk this is not okay and how negligent the staff is here for not being prepared. At this point our Autistic son was also not happy with being made to wait all day for a room and it’s not like they didn’t know we asked at 10 am. We said we would wait at the desk until they found out instead of this indefinite answer they were giving us. We asked for the manager who was already at the desk and she even confirmed that a rush order was done at 12 pm but again didn’t know what happened. So it wasn’t just us who were upset while waiting for a room we thought may not ever be ready - another gentlemen in the lobby had the same concerns as us. Before you know it, security is standing 5 ft from me which is hilarious because it really shows me the nerve of this place and how you guys feel about brown people. Trust me, I could’ve gotten rowdier with the level of disrespect I saw from this place and demonstrated restraint. We finally get into our room - it only took getting upset to make it happen. I thought this room is worth the wait right? NOPE. Looks like they weren’t kidding when they said it wasn’t clean because it really was not. The master toilet had yellow stains around it on the floor. One of the doors had collected dust like none other. The thermostats were temperamental and you could never figure out what kind of temp you would get. The balcony doors had no locks on one of them so our son could’ve easily went out on his own and fallen from the 15th floor if we didn’t just block the balcony door with our things. The lights or should I say lack of lights as well as lack of CABLE on the TV. Some staff person even called my parents room to say we had a check at the front desk waiting for us which were like no way…so when my husband called to ask about it (3 different times) he got 3 different answers - what are you talking about? The manger wants to talk to you. Or our phones are broken. Oh and did I mention the WiFi was also not working. Also bring your own toilet paper and towels. They will send it you…for a delivery fee. They advertise a washer and dryer that don’t even work.

reviews.title: Palms of Gold
reviews.text: Great place to be while in Vegas, location was great, not to far from everything, but not to close for more relaxation, elegant suites and great views. Joseph G. At check in was very helpful and professional. Gave us an upgrade we saw fireworks like kings. Thank you staff for a great stay. Definitely would come back. Andrey.

reviews.title: Palms Place needs serious work
reviews.text: 1) Booked a Strip View Studio, was given a Mountain View.2) Room was dated and mattress old and spongy. 3) Dog food Kibble found in closet.4) No maid service was provided for entire stay. I was told I had booked a private condo with no service. This was not noted in reservation.5) Laguna restaurant dark on Monday & Tuesday and never open for breakfast. No breakfast room service either.6) Only coffee in the room decaf. I requested regular and was told it would be sent up by front desk. Regular coffee never delivered.7) Spent 10 minutes checking out on screen only to get error message at the end. Called front desk to finish check out, no one answered. Downstairs on my way out at front desk, 2 employees chatting to each other said the phone didn't ring.8) Overall vibe horrible, will never stay here again. Too bad, this used to be a great property when it first opened 10 years ago.

reviews.title: Stay away!
reviews.text: The front desk is far too busy and unresponsive. The music and bass from the club outside was louder than my TV could get in my room and rattled the walls on the 25th floor until after 2am. I asked for a room on the other side and they told me they were busy and still had people to check in. The casino staff is rude and confronting to new guests who may not understand to exchange chips at the roulette table to cash them in to the point of swearing and violence. The odds at the slots are horrible and most everything is closed. The mini bar is their fridge and you cannot put things inside without a fee and the cleaning staff does not appear even when you page them. Call the front desk for help or questions and you will wait 30 minutes on hold and hang up. Anything in Vegas is a $20 Uber ride away. We told them we came for our wedding and not a bottle of wine or champagne was to be found which is breaking tradition especially of a city demanding and reliant on it. Stay away from this hotel. Go to the strip and enjoy one that understands how to treat its guests. THIS PLACE WAS CLOSED FOR YEARS FOR A REASON!

reviews.title: Filthiest Hotel I have been In
reviews.text: Me and my family paid for a one bedroom two bathroom suite for three nights. When we got there the room was filthy and still had other peoples belongings that were left there. The second night we found baby roaches in both bathrooms which we were on the 21st floor. The hotelOnly offered one night free! Would not recommend completely a filthy hotel and uncomfortably stay!

reviews.title: Not what I expected
reviews.text: Never again...I frequent Vegas and took a  chance booking this spot to avoid the construction and traffic of F1.  I normally stay at Marriott Grand Chateau, Elara,  or TheD if on Fremont. My room at Palms place is not very  clean so I had to go buy supplies to clean for my stay.  The waitresses at casino could are lackluster in service and  seem to frequently go to same people to accommodate, but I sat spending my money for over an hour and couldn't flag one down to get water.  I am stuck here for a week but lessons learned...all that glitters on the internet ain't gold!

reviews.title: No third party apps
reviews.text: It was terrible because we used a app to book it and they didn't give us room service or any towels that's why I recommend booking directly from the site or just going to the many other hotels in las Vegas

reviews.title: Best front desk service
reviews.text: The hotel was fine.  Not what i want to write this review about.  Maria at the front desk was perhaps the kindest hotel employee I’ve encountered in my life.  She went above and beyond to help sort out some issues with our short-notice booking.  She was a blessing to my wife and me.  She is a credit to Palms Place.

reviews.title: Really loved the service I received here.  Ruthy R was extremely helpful and knowledgeable. Amazing! Thank you
reviews.text: Really loved the service I received here.  Ruthy R was extremely helpful and knowledgeable. Amazing! Thank you

reviews.title: Perfect weekend
reviews.text: Stayed at the palm place for my brothers wedding reception, the hotel was very clean, beds were comfortable, and anything I needed I would call the front desk and they were quick to bring it. Front desk was very accommodating. Would come visit this hotel for my future visit to Vegas.

reviews.title: Excellent customer care
reviews.text: Attended a work conference and had last minute changes that were quickly and kindly made for me by a customer care representative named Lorraine.   She expedited my changes and provided me reassurance that my attendees would not have issues checking in.   All turned out smoothly and my stay was great.   Thanks Lorraine.

reviews.title: Great FOH
reviews.text: It's my first time staying there. I got in earlier than my colleague,  and Natasha,  FOH, helped coordinate our reservations.  She was very helpful and tried to make notes for both of our reservations. Only downside were, a guest went to pool and

reviews.title: Amazing restaurants and gambling experience
reviews.text: Amazing accommodations and an excellent place to escape. Our host Erno Mabin went above and beyond to make sure we were well taken cared of. You can find him strolling on the gambling floor interacting with all the players and ensuring his players are having a good time. I highly recommend staying here.

reviews.title: Best hotel
reviews.text: My host Erno Mabini always take care of me when I visit. He is very responsive and beside my host, the hotel is very clean and great staff. I been coming here weekly for a year plus and had never had a bad experience. I highly recommend staying here.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Not as I expected.1. I booked online through the hotel website for the Palm hotel ended up with the room at Palm Place the adjacent “extended stay” hotel next door.2. Had to walk through a through the casino, upstairs (escalators were broke the entire 3 day stay) to a long corridor that has the nerve to have one of those airport walking escalators to another long corridor to get to the Palm Place extended stay. Mind you, you have to do this every day all day to get to the main hotel for casino, food or entertainment.3. You must carry your key card with you EVERYWHERE. There are security checkpoints everywhere in the Palm Place which makes me think was I even safe there. You have to insert your key card on the elevator to get to your floor which made everything frustrating. If people have to hold on to the key card everywhere why not provide a lanyard or a wristlet or even a wristband like on cruise ships.4. It’s pretty much dead at 7 pm that’s when the pool closes also the pool in Palm place is kid friendly so the few times I went to the pool it was kid over load and also the pool side service is extremely slow. Several time I had to ask staff for the check or even to place an order.5. TRASH EVERYWHERE. Trash bags left in elevators, trash left near room doors for days and I had to complain about trash left in the elevator waiting area on a friends floor. You know what happened? The trash was swept to the side instead of being picked up and thrown away. I informed the hotel on my way out for the day and came back to the friends floor later that night and that’s how I found the trash swept to the side.6. There was calcium/lime built up on the shower heads.7. Mold/bacteria in the ice.8. A/C was not cooling - but that was fixed9. Room door does not close shut behind you. Must yank and pull door close.10. Find another place to stay honestly it’s not worth the price.11. Balconies do not open!

reviews.title: Terrible room check in and customer service… they downgrade my room without telling me and could care less.
reviews.text: Terrible room check in and customer service… they downgrade my room without telling me and could care less.

reviews.title: Review for Natasha
reviews.text: Review for Natasha:I stayed at Palms place for my birthday weekend and Natasha was so down to earth and cool and made sure that I had everything I needed for my stay!  Quick and efficient. Will definitely be coming back as long as she still there. ☺️

reviews.title: Palms Place Hotel & Spa (10’s across the board) excellent hotel
reviews.text: Review for Jeanette at Palms Place, Las Vegas:"Staying at the Palms Place was a delight, in no small part due to the exemplary service provided by Jeanette, their hotel desk clerk. From the moment we checked in, her warmth and professionalism shone through. Jeanette went above and beyond to ensure our stay was comfortable and memorable. Her pleasant demeanor and genuine willingness to accommodate our needs made us feel valued and taken care of. In a bustling city like Las Vegas, it's truly refreshing to encounter such outstanding customer service. Kudos to Jeannette for setting the bar high. I definitely will return soon, and we hope to see her friendly face when we do!"And I must add the hotel was absolutely beautiful, the pleasant fragrance when you walked in the hotel lobby is breathtaking, and the rooms was amazing and the spa tub was very relaxing.. I give the hotel 10 across the board. Signed Happy  Customer Tiashawn Ezell

reviews.title: A Hidden Gem
reviews.text: Palms Place Las Vegas provided the perfect setting for my 55th birthday celebration. I booked through Hopper, but some of the pertinent booking information was inaccurate, leading to some initial issues. However, thanks to the exceptional assistance of Mr. Garavi, the manager, everything was promptly resolved, and he displayed professionalism, kindness, and genuine helpfulness.Throughout my six-night stay, every employee I encountered was friendly and eager to assist, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. My room, 51-309, offered a breathtaking view of the mountains and was both clean and spacious. The only drawback was the lack of access to the balcony.Palms Place's serene and tranquil ambiance provided a pleasant contrast to the bustling Vegas scene. Although not directly on the strip, it was conveniently close to all the action.Overall, I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and can't wait to return in the near future. Palms Place Las Vegas left a lasting positive impression, making my birthday celebration truly memorable. Thank you!If you're looking to escape the hustle and bustle of the Las Vegas strip, this is the perfect location.

reviews.title: Pretty good
reviews.text: There were several things that I liked about the hotel. The pool was really nice the suite was big clean and had a great view. There are many places to eat on property that were pretty tasty. I was disappointed with the TV and Internet service. The TV had a black screen or glitched most of my stay which was disappointing when it was time to relax I wanted to watch a few shows.

reviews.title: We will be back again and again!
reviews.text: We took a week staycation as locals and started at our favorite getaway, Palms PLACE for two nights. I was so impressed with the service at the front desk where Yvette upgraded our room. We had an amazing view of the entire length of the Strip. Our only goal that week was to enjoy pool time, great dinners, cocktails and clubs. We stumbled on Rojo, the lobby bar at the front desk! P.J. and I talked marketing and what makes a great bar. Fun guy! We think they should call it P.J.’s and give him carte blanche with his creative marketing ideas and cool cocktail promotions!In the morning, we hung out at the pool where Treena kept our cocktails full with a smile and anticipated our needs with obvious experience! Our teenager had gone across the street to race go karts and when he came to join us he couldn’t get past security - good looking out guys! Our son called us to meet him in the lobby. As I left the pool, I asked if it was possible to call the front security. Better still, the security personnel, Khalil, offered to personally go meet our son and bring him up! Wow! That’s service! I went back to my spot at the pool. Mid-week, just to change it up, we did try another off Strip resort. The room was nice but the pool experience didn’t measure up so we stayed again Friday night at Palms Place. I was hopeful that earlier in the week wasn’t just a lucky stay, but once again, we were pleasantly impressed! Amber got us another great room with a great view and the pool experience was, once again, stellar! Jelessa, who claimed she was in training, but seemed like a pro to us, read our eye contact requests for a refill. At one point she saw us needing help with opening an umbrella for shade and quickly stepped in and handled it with a smile.We have traveled far and wide and have very high expectations for customer service being Las Vegas locals for over 30 years. I asked for a manager because I felt like recognition was due to these employees who went above and beyond the usual expectations. Hotels will all have challenges with as big as our properties are in Vegas. It’s about how they handle any challenges with professionalism, grace and prompt, customer-focused resolution. Palms Place hit the mark in every category! We will be back soon! Thanks for maintaining a great property, Joseph! We are spreading the word!!

reviews.title: Barf Place
reviews.text: I was excited to see my room because I had heard they are spacious and well designed. But my room had dried vomit on the carpet and couch. There was also a ball of hair in the bathroom. The hotel was very reticent to give me a new room. I am not at all impressed. The service recovery was almost as bad as the problem. See photos 🤮

reviews.title: Great hotel and casino BUT
reviews.text: Wonderful hotel, room and casino. Pool was beautiful BUT unless you want to pay 150.00 to reserve a place to sit - it’s very limited availability- even on a Thursday. Food was very good, everyone friendly.

reviews.title: Not the best
reviews.text: We stayed at a studio suite at Palms Place for 3 nights in April 2023.  Upon arriving, the Bell /Valet staff were great. They were very helpful in assisting us in unpacking the vehicle of our belongings, luggage and bags and subsequently getting the items to our room.  The young lady at the front desk who assisted us was very friendly and helpful.  The studio was on 50th floor. Upon entrance, the room was very nice; there was a full kitchenette area with a stove top refrigerator, microwave and dishes, large bathroom, with a huge shower with a sauna tub in the shower area, two televisions mounted on the wall, but that is where the positives ended for me.  Because of the amenities, this is a very expensive room, which is fine except that it is very outdated.  I feel when owners of airbnb's and suites are charging a lot of money to stay in the properties they own, the least they can do is provide some updates, even if minor.  First, the bed was the most uncomfortable bed I have ever "tried" to sleep in. Continuous sleep did not happen as the mattress was so cheap and uncomfortable both me and my significant other woke up frequently with aching backs.  There were two older model tv's mounted to the wall, but only one worked, which is fine if it worked properly. The signal cut out frequently and the television would just go black. There were not many plugs to charge smart devices or sleep machines, on one side of the bed there were no outlets at all. Other hotels now have accomodations to either plug into an outlet in the night stand or USB ports. At the very least provide a cheap alternative  like a power strip.  We never had a person come in the room to clean or even to check and see if we needed anything so we kept the same ONE facecloth and towel, luckily I packed a few of my own. There was ONE roll of toilet paper. i have never stayed at any hotel/suite where there wasn't at least one spare roll of toilet paper for convenience. We valeted for convenience, but the valet staff hours were inconsistent. We came back to the property at 10pm one evening and no one was there to valet and it was closed but when we went back downstairs a little later, there were several valet/bell staff congregating, chit chatting outside, with valet open again. This happened more than one night. OVERALL, it was not worth the money we paid to stay in the suite.

reviews.title: Fantastic 10/10 Hotel and Staff
reviews.text: My stay at the Palms Place was absolutely amazing! Marites was the staff who had helped me check-in and checkout of the hotel and was very helpful and kind throughout my entire stay. It was my first time visiting Vegas so she let me know about all the amazing restaurants within the hotel and recommended popular attractions and shows in Vegas as well! Palms Place and their staff deserve the highest possible ratings in every category!

reviews.title: Great hotel and casino resort off the strip
reviews.text: My family and I stayed in a 38th floor two bed room suite. The Palms Place staff were extremely friendly and helpful during our stay. The attached casino was well equipped and the restaurants were excellent quality and value. As a hotel located off the strip, the area was very quiet and provided for good nights sleep.

reviews.title: DON’T STAY HERE!!
reviews.text: So disappointed in this hotel. I did a lot of research and saw photos. It is nothing like what I saw. I had to change rooms twice (and I’m not one to complain). The first room was so dirty I couldn’t imagine walking barefoot in there. Second room was blazing hot because the air conditioner was broken. Finally settled in a room because it was late. None of the TVs worked. When I complained when I checked out I was told “wow sounds like you had a bad trip”. Because it’s March madness the rates were crazy too. So this made it even worse. Stick to the strip.

reviews.title: The Palms Place is the BEST!!!
reviews.text: My family has stayed in the Palms place since January 16th. It is the best when it comes to location, customer service, amenities, and food. We would like to send a special thanks for Joseph, a manager at the front desk at Palms place, he was most helpful when we extended our stay. He made the chore of checking in and out not a chore at all. Also I'd like to thank the lovely housekeeper Esmeralda for her excellent service.

reviews.title: Great Place to stay
reviews.text: I could not say enough great things about our stay. When we arrived we were greeted by Marites and immediately felt welcomed. She recommended many attractions, restaurants and must do places. She definitely set the tone for a fabulous stay! We arrived earlier than our check in time but were able to be accommodated and got right into our room. We stayed on the 52nd floor annd  our room was clean and beautiful. Our view was amazing. The buffet was delicious with a great variety of food. Every staff member we encountered from front desk to maintenance emptying trash on the way to the casino was friendly and always said hello. Being close enough to everything and yet far enough from the loud night life of the strip was great! If we ever come back to Vegas this is where we will stay again! Thank you for a great visit.

reviews.title: Palms Place Hotel
reviews.text: My partner and I checked in and was helped by Mr. Joseph at the front desk. He was amazing and even got us checked in early. The room is clean and spacious. Wish we could go out on the balcony but other than that it’s beautiful!!! THANK YOU JOSEPH!

reviews.title: Don’t stay
reviews.text: Do yourself a favor and stay on the strip.  Fell short in relaying any information on the property.  Amenities are a joke and don’t ask for any, they wont deliver!  And when you make a complaint, they don’t care.

reviews.title: Never again.
reviews.text: First of all they gave my room away before I arrived and then gave me a similar room where there was a broken  ice maker. Seems like a small thing..but they do not deliver ice and there is no ice maker in the entire hotel.  They kept offering to subtract charges, but money isnt the point, if I couldn't afford the price I wouldnt have booked the hotel. Then balconies are locked. Why book a balcony hotel and then have no access to the balcony.  Rooms are basic ( even the suites, dont fall for the professional photos) and linen had human hair all over it . Not impressed at all. Will never stay here again. And be clear this isn't a luxury hotel. It's not a hotel at all. It's a condo rental business with no or inconsistent amenities.  Stay on the strip!!!

reviews.title: Mostly okay, but it’s the small things that kill it
reviews.text: Comfortable, relatively clean and roomy.  The staff were all very kind and always smiling. BUT, so many little things annoyed us enough that we cannot recommend Palms Place. For example, the is no information in the room about the hotel, spa, room service (there isn’t any, I found out after calling and talking with room service), restaurant times or menus, pools, fire safety, nothing.  Also, the coffee shop in the lobby doesn’t open until 9am. The gift shop dose doesn’t keep regular hours. There doesn’t seem to be a spa menu anywhere except perhaps at the spa itself. We asked for toilet paper twice in 3 hours and eventually just hunted down a cart in a hall and got it ourselves( it was delivered at some point after we had left.) Our suite had an incredible balcony, but no balcony furniture. Security was good when is was present, and nonexistent , of course, when they were not.

reviews.title: Do not book
reviews.text: Terrible service. Room was not ready at check in and the reception seemed to not care at all.Rooms have balcony’s that are LOCKED. Absolutely ridiculous. Stay somewhere else and have a much better experience.

reviews.title: Excellent Environment
reviews.text: Great place to stay. Everything we needed, spacious, and clean. Front desk service made it easy to check in...Natalie was very friendly and super helpful. Would stay here again. Excellent experience all around.

reviews.title: barking dog and disrespectful housekeeping
reviews.text: Palms Place was my usual go-to for an off-strip stay. I've stayed here maybe 6 times in the past couple of years while the Palms was undergoing renovation. Its main charm is how quiet and peaceful it is, how huge the suites are, and the added luxury of their deep soaking tubs. Unfortunately, those charms couldn't make up for the nightmare stay last night.Last night was my 3rd night of a 4 night stay here. Apparently there was a new tenant (?) who checked in last night across the way who had a dog that suffered from major separation anxiety. The hotel policy states that there are NO PETS ALLOWED (aside from service animals), but this pet was barking and scratching at its door from 10pm-4am... I doubt any trained service animal would be left alone in a place for that long, let alone one that suffered from such huge separation anxiety!I went down to complain 3 times, and each time, because the owner wasn't there, security and front desk couldn't help. And trust me -- this dog suffered from HORRIBLE anxiety -- not something anyone could sleep through or ignore. So I had to listen to this poor dog barking and scratching until 4am when the owners finally arrived.Anyhow, earlier that evening (before the dog situation), I went down to the front desk to extend my stay an extra night. Everything went smooth and they told me to come back down again the next morning in order to finalize my reservation. At 10:45AM the next morning, I went to the front desk and went through the whole reservation process again, then headed back to my suite...Not long after that, I get a knock on the door and before I could answer, housekeeping came in. I was stark naked on the bed, about to go back to sleep, and here's a housekeeper staring right at me. She didn't even declare that she was housekeeping and didn't even wait for me to say anything, just barged in! I jumped out of bed and hid behind a corner and told her, "I don't need housekeeping and I have DO NOT DISTURB on". She goes, "we still have a right to go in" and I was like "ma'am, I'm still here, I extended my stay, and if you don't mind..." and she continues arguing that she had a right to be there and asked if I'd even paid (?????)... all while I'm still standing there naked!!This was one of the most embarassing situations I'd ever been in -- and also startled the heck out of me! So I went down to the front desk immediately to complain. The lady (she was so sweet) completely understood what I was going through, between the housekeeper arguing with me while I was naked and dealing with a howling/barking dog all night, offered me a $50 food/beverage credit, which the manager then upped to $75.OK, so while the gesture was sweet, I really don't think $75 credit for food and beverages at the PALMS (not Palms Place, so I have to go across the parking lot for this) really makes up for lost sleep and being visually assaulted by their housekeeper.Tonight might be my last night staying here. While some of the staff are sweet, they could do better. If pets aren't allowed in hotel, this should apply to EVERYONE. And if someone has DND on their door, housekeeping should respect that (or double check with front desk about someone extending their stay instead of arguing with a naked tenant -- completely disrespectful!)Oh -- the other thing that's happening is that the hotel will try to charge you for every little thing. They no longer have free wifi -- was charged $12.99 per day PER DEVICE. And was also told if the bellboy were to accompany me with the luggage trolley to bring things to my door, they would charge me $10 (and no, I was not allowed to use the trolley on my own). They do not offer complimentary water either, as almost all other hotels do.

reviews.title: Penthouse Paradise
reviews.text: I spent 4 great days with my sons in the 56th floor Penthouse and it was Vegas luxury at its finest.  Two bedrooms...three bathrooms...a  theater room...spacious kitchen and living room plus a wonderful outdoor balcony and terrace with a glass enclosed hot tub that juts out over the edge.  The views during the day are great but at night...spectacular.  I've stayed in very nice places in Vegas before but being able to go outside into the sun and fresh air is a real plus.  The suite has a Foosball table...a huge Jacuzzi tub in the main bathroom plus dishes...glasses...cutlery etc. to make your stay perfect.  The decor is very upscale and modern with unique sliding walls so you can open the bedrooms up to the main room or slide them closed for privacy at night.  Lots of big screen Smart TVS and WiFi included for your entertainment needs.  The second bedroom has two Queen beds and a large soaking tub by the balcony glass doors if you want to relax and enjoy the view.  This has become our new favorite place to stay in Vegas.

reviews.title: Best Service in Las Vegas
reviews.text: My family of 5 stayed at the Palms Place and can’t wait for our next visit back. Check in went very smoothly Danica and Joseph at front desk were very nice. Also the bell service attendant Jeff was fast and attentive along with the Valet Jonathan! Jonathan had a conversation with our children and they enjoyed him. After check in we headed to the pool which was beautiful and clean, the bartender Daphne was incredibly sweet and made us a delicious mango margarita pitcher. Our room itself was beautiful and spacious with an breathe taking view of the strip, our bed was so comfy and the shower/bathtub was amazing!! Overall the Palms Place exceeds our expectations with their customer service and amenities and will definitely be returning soon for our next visit.

reviews.title: A very unpleasant stay I do not recommend this place to anyone
reviews.text: I’m very disappointed with this location. The location is advertised as a suite and it is more of an extended stay hotel. The rooms are run down. The bathrooms are dirty and they do not clean the rooms each day. There’s a button to request for housekeeping, but apparently does not work. When we return back to the room the room was the same way as we left it, and housekeeping had not clean the room, I called front desk and I was advised they do not clean the room during the stay unless requested which I did. I advise the represented that request was made by pushing the button by the entrance door and he advised me that the button does not work and I had to call the front desk to have them clean the room. With Covid going around I would think they would clean the rooms each day but unfortunately they do not care for safety and health of customers.

reviews.title: Mr. Jones
reviews.text: Awesome experience! Chanel was excellent and outstanding customer service. I would recommend this hotel. The view and room itself was impressive compared to the other hotels in the area. I loved the connection to the casino and the pools.

reviews.title: Amazing front desk service Jeanette
reviews.text: I’ve been staying here twice a month for about 18 month. It is my go to when working in Las Vegas. Jeanette is amazing as always. Kind, professional, friendly, capable, and helpful.  It’s nice that she remembers me. When you travel as much as I do, a friendly helpful face is always refreshing.

reviews.title: Fa
reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay in Palms place the moment you walk in, it smells amazing and the atmosphere is relaxing. I had the best check-in experience with Chanel she was amazing! All the other staff were very nice as well. I don’t think I have ever been to a place that has it all together like Palms Place.

reviews.title: Nice Vegas room with strip view!
reviews.text: Had the pleasure of checking in with Shanice. She was very helpful with getting us checked in early and picking out a great room with a nice view. Welcoming personality and professional. Very satisfied 😊

reviews.title:
it was okay. but there is definitely room for improvement
but Chanel at the reception was super friendly and helpful
reviews.text:
it was okay. but there is definitely room for improvement
but Chanel at the reception was super friendly and helpful

reviews.title: Racquetball tournament
reviews.text: Great location, great price, clean room, great view, and Chanel (the person who checked me in) was very nice, professional, not to mention very knowledgeable about the area and the property. I plan to visit again.

reviews.title: Great check-in experience
reviews.text: I had the good fortune to have Chanel check me in and she did an amazing job of describing the amenities of the resort.  The pluses are no resort fees, great valet car service, a spacious condo with good views, loved the huge shower with rain head and we also had a washer and dryer in the unit.Things that could be better: The patio doors were locked and we had no access to this huge patio to enjoy the views, the kitchen isn't stocked with anything so there was no way to prepare even a simple snack, the parking fee is $40/night which seemed high.

reviews.title: Front desk
reviews.text: Chanel was amazing!! Very helpful and so kind we had an issue when we got to the hotel, with our room, and she moved us without any problem! Then followed up with us to make sure the new room was all we needed!

reviews.title: Front Desk Service!
reviews.text: Palms place was nice and decent the rooms could be a little bit more cleaner, but it is what it is, very neutral on the room. Overall experience was great because of Chanel who worked in the front desk. Exceptional customer service, very welcoming and knowledgeable. She’s the only reason it was a good experience

reviews.title: CHANEL
reviews.text: After arriving to the luxurious palms hotel during the check-in we are greeted by a fantastic, sophisticated, and professional host named Chanel. From the beginning of the trip this is what set the expectations for the rest of the vacation. We wish every hotel had someone like this to make everyone's day a little bit better

reviews.title: Amazing service!
reviews.text: Best service ever! Chanél was really helpful and made us feel comfortable during our stay! she answered all our questions and gave us great tips! Our room was beautiful and the view was great. Definitely the place to be when coming to Las Vegas!

reviews.title: unprofesional security personel and lack of human skills
reviews.text: left my name and address at security booth. and do not curse the clients.as handicap veteran me finding my car keys  took time until i realized they were in the engine. 6 screaming 3 with sprayer pointing at me and accusation of consuming alcohol . i hired a personal injury attorney ,he will tell you all that happened.

reviews.title: Great Vegas Spot
reviews.text: Excellent space for the four of us and across the street from a dispensary 😉Check in a bit rocky but lovely personalities willing to help.Great views of Vegas and well appointed suite. Huge sectional slept two of us. All in all a nice change from huge Vegas hotel circus!

reviews.title: Won’t go back
reviews.text: Not super impressed.  I travel for a living and although I really did like the rooms (aside from the horribly dirty windows) the staff was not on their game. The pool was supposed to open at 10… it finally opened at 10:40 while staff buzzed around not acknowledging our existence.  Once at the pool… the deposit that I had to pay at the front desk obviously was meaningless as I had to pay cash and couldn’t charge to the room. After going to the front desk to straighten that out (they told me everything was taken care of) I got a phone call later that day telling me I had to return to the pool to sign. Ugh.   The rest of the stay was right along the same path.  I won’t be returning.

reviews.title: Great stay, clean and spacious room!
reviews.text: We had a great stay at Palms Place! We arrived a bit early and the front desk staff, Errie was able to get us in before the check in time, there is a charge for checking in early but we didn't mind as we were tired and wanted to relax already. She was very helpful and informative as what is included or not in our room. We stayed in a suite and it was perfect! Very clean and spacious. The only thing we wished was included is the balcony being open. For some reason that day, the door to the balcony was locked and we can't go out but Errie did tell us about that being close temporarily. Overall, everything was perfect!

reviews.title: I don't condone the disrespect from the front desk
reviews.text: My husband and I enjoyed our stay from StripView Suites. I have left my fair review with them about our stay. Cleansiness is one thing. But the hotel front desk itself, in person I had a easy time but when you're tracking down your secuirty deposit. It is a hassle. I called the day after check out and was told I would get the deposit 5-7 business days (per usual) Understood. I simply called a week later and a respresentative Sandra I believe picked up the phone, I kid you not she already had an attitude, she was sighing all over the place on the phone. Once I mention about my security deposit she sighed LOUDER! She asked me about my last name, first, and last 4 digits to card. I provided the info and she said it was deposited into my bank account May 26th. The first day I called after check out. I told her I haven't recieved anything.. she had the audacity to interupt with a laugh/giggle/chuckle over the phone. I asked her what's so funny? She said "It will take 5-7 business days" I asked, but did you not just admit and told me it was deposited on May 26th? and she laughed again. I asked her again why she's laughing I asked her a simple question and I don't condone the disrespect over the phone it is unprofessional and she hung up the phone. NEVERRRRRRR in my life have I experienced HORRIBLE customer service from a hotel. I work customer service all my life and this was absurd! I am condsidering on not coming back because of this ONE representative that was so rude and unprofessional. DO BETTER!

reviews.title: WREAKS OF MARIJUANA
reviews.text: I highly recommend against staying here.  There are a lot of residents that smoke marijuana regularly and many of the rooms smell terribly because of it.  I booked a room through StripView Suites who refused to cancel the remainder of my stay.  I would highly recommend looking elsewhere.

reviews.title: Lovin it in Vegas
reviews.text: The sfaff was friendly and they had on-site security. The rooms were a bit dated bjt spacious. Our room had a queen-size bed, a sitting area, a d a kitchen with fridge and ice maker. The bathroom was huge including a rain attachment and a very large jet tub for two. The hotel itself was quiet and views impressive as we were on the 19th floor and had views of downtown north to south.  This may be making way for the A's stadium so don't wait to take advantage of its fair rates.

reviews.title: Fully Priced, Half of the Amenities & Services
reviews.text: I had to clean things on my own in order to even feel comfortable. The shower was filthy.   The TVs are outdated, you can't stream anything and you can't connect a Chromecast because the outlet is blocked.  The radio does not have a way to play your music from you phone, it only has iPod connectivity....I haven't seen this in years.  Balconies are closed, I know the reason but due to legal reasons, I won't say; however, it is not disclosed prior to booking.  I wanted this hotel due to the balcony.  The casino is closed!!! Do not go here thinking you will gamble there. The pool was closed for 2 days.  Valet no longer exists.  At this point, I have no clue what I paid for and the resort fees were still on there. I think I paid for the gym that I had no intention to utilize and I didn't.  Prior to booking, you should be warned about the changes that have taken place and amenities that will not be available during your stay.  I paid full price and was not able to enjoy anything.

reviews.title: Not as clean as you would expect.
reviews.text: Had to change rooms 3 times. Not all what I expected. Also seems this is the place to come smoke weed cause the hallways and rooms reeked of it. Finally was moved to a room that wasn't nauseating. Look at the pic i took of the inside of the coffee pot. Yuk!

reviews.title: Half functional, full price
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I stayed at Palms for 3 nights. We arrived a little after 3pm and when we tried to check-in we were notified that the room wasn’t ready. So after twenty minutes we were called to the counter and checked in. It was a bit disappointing to be charged for the full daily resort fee on top of the reservation considering the casino, bars and spas were still closed due to covid. At first glance the room was very nice and matched the photos we saw online. What sold us on this hotel was the jets in the bathtub, but once we settled in the wear on the room became apparent. There was holes in the curtains, tears on the chairs, scratches on the table, tape hanging from the ceiling that was from a previous party, no cups in the drawer and worst of all when we tried out the jets in the tub within seconds the water to smell like a sewer and we immediately got out. During our stay the room wasn’t turned down so we ran out of towels. The first day we had do not disturb until noon but after that we had the housekeeping button on. No sign of them. Overall, the stay was okay but could of been better. We were excited to stay at this hotel but became disappointed very quickly.

reviews.title: Great price, great rooms, no casino.
reviews.text: This place is very clean, including:   The rooms, elevators,  pool, lobby, restrooms, etc..The staff, hands down, excellent.   They were very friendly, professional, courteous,  and helpful. Anything we needed, we had it right away.I didn't  care for the pool, it is very small and closed early.  As of July 1st,  you no longer had access to the balconies.  That was disappointing.  Everything isn't fully functional yet. There is no casino because the Palms casino is closed.  The guests are young and urban. Not my cup of tea. Next visit I will stay at one the resorts I normally frequent on the strip.

reviews.title: Terrible Customer Service
reviews.text: I stayed in a suite for three nights on a business trip. I had extremely rude service while staying here. I went to hang out by the pool to wait for my flight for just a few hours, & the tone of the man running the pool was very disrespectful. After spending my money for an entire week for a suite at that, I figured it would be okay to sit by the pool to have a drink for a few hours until my flight. I was told I could pay $45 to store my luggage for two hours or I couldn’t be near the pool. Very disappointed in the customer service or willingness to help as I would’ve paid to store my luggage or have it with me. I wouldn’t recommend anyone staying here. Highly recommend you find new staff for people working by the pool. I personally won’t be staying here ever again.

reviews.title: Great views, beautiful property.
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I decided to stay here as there are few hotels with balconies available that are inexpensive in Vegas. Our favorite is the Cosmopolitan or the polo towers on strip. This was our first stay here. The property is very pretty and clean and not as crowded as the strip. These rooms are condos and not the actual palms hotel. We have stayed off the strip before and this hotel was very easy to get to and leave from. We got a strip view balcony room on the 51st floor. Amazing views from here. The room had more amenities than most rooms on the strip. It even had a dishwasher. The room itself was a little beat up (broken light fixtures, mirror, and several bulbs out, broken fridge) and the bed had a hair in it as well as stained sheets. This is the only reason I didn’t give it 5 stars.. I expect a clean bed at a nice property like this. I also found marijuana in the room (it’s Vegas and it didn’t bother us but still) which makes me question how thorough they actually clean these rooms. I loved the jetted soaker tub and the rainfall shower. Great kitchen and comfortable bedding and furniture. The big balcony could use some furniture but we were spoiled at the Cosmo with a sofa and chair and ashtray on a table. Overall it’s a good value for what you get. They have nice toiletries and they included a loofa and sewing kits. We would definitely stay again.

reviews.title: The View is the BEST!
reviews.text: We stayed only 1 night at The Palms Place but it was a great experience.  Check in was quick and easy.  The room is amazing.  Very large with a King Bed and a sectional sofa.  We also used the sofa bed and it was also remarkably comfortable.  The balcony view from the 52nd floor was spectacular.  The truly best part was the jetted tub.  Large and relaxing.   We would have liked a couple of chairs on the balcony and better signage upon arrival on where to register, but other than that, a great stay.  Clean, comfortable and well decorated.  We will return for a longer stay.

reviews.title: BUYER BEWARE
reviews.text: This hotel is a joke. There is nothing open yet. Not even coffee. The place is dirty and they overcharge for their dirty rooms. The staff is bare and they don't have a manager on site. No services here. Just dirty rooms and a dirty hotel.

reviews.title: Late review aka Amazing Stay!
reviews.text: We stayed at this Hotel in 2018, we were upgraded at check in to an amazing suite with a stunning view. The hotel is a little off strip but still in walking distance of everything. I truly enjoyed the staff & and ambience of this hotel. It was an excellent choice. We will be back!

reviews.title: The owner who sublet this place is a thief
reviews.text: He kept my money after I did not want to stay there due to his dilapidated condo.  Bodily fluids on rundown furniture.  Completely filthy inside and outside on balcony.  Missing handles from outside to be able to get back inside.  Several different people had keys/access.  Dirty laundry in bags still through out condo and kitchen appliances had foul order.  It was unsanitary and unsafe to stay there.  Floor plugs were sticking up and out of floor causing potential trip and fall or potential electrical shock.  Be weary of renting from this property at all as this owner said he has several rooms there.

reviews.title: COVID HAS TAKEN THIS HOTEL DOWN!!!
reviews.text: It was the worst experience I've ever had at the Palms!!! My advice would be to SHUT IT DOWN! Your hotel is NOT up to standard. Your hotel is FILTHY! Your Hotel Service is not even up to Motel 6 standards! I've stayed at the Palms Resort several times and NEVER could I have imagined this beautiful Hotel would turn into a dump.....especially during COVID! 1. No room service (no food, but overpriced liquor is available) No even a pack of freakin crackers) 2. No customer Service - (1 person at front desk, line out the door)3. No housekeeping (WTF! No clean sheets, no clean towels. So due to COVID you can't even leave it for me daily...not even in a bag, at the door, thrown in the room, left at a pickup station, nothing! TRIFLIN!) 4. My room was filthy (Tub with visible dirt ring, clean sheets to cover a dirty stained duvet comforter, hair in bedding, seating (bar stool) stained with what looked like blood, residue of something on countertop, dust EVERYWHERE!5. Room amenities broken (hair dryer BROKEN, makeup led mirror BROKEN6. "Resort services" Pool available NO FOOD but all the alcohol your liver can stand! So you're telling me due to COVID you can't have food but you can serve liquor???? Ridiculous!! oh and no you can't bring outside food cause Palms needs you super drunk to not recognize that they haven't cleaned or sanitized a darn thing since MARCH! 7. No bell service, No luggage carts - Of course.....Due to COVID you can't simply sanitize carts for guest after each use?? So due to COVID, bell service, valet, room service, housekeeping, customer service, concierge, cleanliness, IS ALL UNAVAILABLE! Is COVID also the reason you also can't notify guest BEFORE arrival the your service is crappy too? COVID broke your computers and your fingers so you can't send emails to arriving guest? But......luckily COVID didn't mess with your payment processing system!! Dang COVID even let your company charge me $88 for a resort fee? I just want to know for WHAT resort, cause I was at a freaking SUPER 8! SHUT IT THE HECK DOWN PALMS!!

reviews.title: Great stay.
reviews.text: Though this is not a new hotel, it appears as new.  We rented a condo 18th floor, room 306 through Airbnb and it was spectacular!  It was furnished beautifully and the beds were quite comfortable...it was exactly we advertised. But be aware, because of COVID-19 there are no bellmen and the drive through to the registration area was blocked. Also there is an ice maker in the small fridge but we could not get it to work and the hotel has no ice, so buy ice before you check in. But don’t let the Covid problems stop you. This is a great place to stay...with free parking and an easy walkway access to the Palms casino.  I would absolutely stay again.

reviews.title: Nightmare
reviews.text: The Palms hotel was just ok..IT IS NOT WORTH THE MONEY. The service from the moment I walked in was trash. I was half a** greeted by an employee that was sitting on a chair doing absolutely nothing but running her mouth and laughing with other employees. She told me to check in at the kiosk instead of greeting me properly and taking my information although no-one was in line behind me. The (one) pool was over crowded each time I tried to go out and relax. The initial room they put us in had old ripped furniture and the sheets were dingy. The room also flooded no sooner than we put our bags down. Water leaked from the ceiling all over the floor. We were moved to another room that was exactly the same..Then the hotel charged me an additional $200 for incidentals (aside from the resort fee) that was not at all in the fine print of my agreement. Lastly, the hotel over charged me for the resort fee and it took a week to get someone on the phone from the hotel to correct the error. The representative Josh was not at all apologetic on behalf of the company and simply gave the number for the corporate office to file a complaint about my dissatisfaction.

reviews.title: Epic
reviews.text: I highly recommend this place. This is where it’s at in Vegas! They have some upscale bars and restaurants in there; so many food options even for late night. We had the luxury suite and it was everything. Very relaxing with an amazing view. Comfy beds and a spacious bathroom with a huge tub.

reviews.title: Best view ever
reviews.text: Very nice and clean and the view over the Strip is amazing and the balcony view is lovely, its fully furnished and they have ice maker and cooler it equipped with full kitchen and stove and they valet parking

reviews.title: It’s the principle.
reviews.text: Booked a 1bdrm suite for 2nts for my bfs bday.Only 1 agent so there was a long line each time I came. The kiosks werent helpful. Room wasn’t ready @4, or when I returned @435 but it was being rushed. It was ready the 3rd time I came @630 once we returned after eating. The agent agreed to waive 1nt of resort fees & gave us a free 12PM late check out because we waited so long. I verified with someone that I should get a refund after our 2nd night ended. She confirmed when booking me ANOTHER night that the charge would fall off. At this time I was satisfied w/ the stay, the initial issues had been made up for, or so I thought, and there were only minor issues in the room (old trash and bdrm tv out).10 days later, no $. I called the hotel, spoke to the front desk manager. After explaining this all to him he tells me the cpu shows my room was ready, keys were made & I was called all at 445?! I never received a call or VM. Not even the email, that I requested on the kiosk, telling me my room was clean. I was constantly checking 430-630, even spam.He claimed there was nothing that could be done at this point because there weren’t notes made about the resort fee. Didn’t matter if the young lady recalled telling me all this or not (I felt she would). I feel the young lady forgot to call me at 445. When I returned at 630 her face lit up, I figured she just recognized my face from earlier. Now I believe it was because she remembered she NEVER called me. Which is why she agreed to the FREE late check AND waiving the resort fee. NONE of this mattered to the manager tho. He was adamant that I was notified at 445 and returned to check in at 630 just by choice, something they wouldn’t waive resort fee for. I had already planned to spend the money so it’s not about that. I just really don’t appreciate being told by TWO people I’d get a refund, when obviously it hadn’t even been initiated. Then the manager being absolutely no help, just repeated off procedure as if mistakes don’t happen. Especially knowing they were busy w/ ONE agent. Annoyed but not surprised she forgot but I did MY part by verifying with the second agent that the charge would fall off.

reviews.title: Not a good pool experience - Woman Drill Sargent
reviews.text: My friend and I were enjoying the Palms Place pool yesterday, when this security woman came over to us and advised we couldn't move the lounge chairs to face the sun. Then she went over to a gentleman who was on his computer with headphones likely taking a meeting temporarily sitting in one of the cabanas and yells at him to get out then when he motioned just a minute she turned on the tv in the cabana and threw the remote at his computer. Someone is taking their job way too seriously! We were uncomfortable being at the pool after that and went over to the Palms pool.

reviews.title: The pool bar is just a great place for relaxing after work
reviews.text: The private dining room was awesome for our business meeting.  Excellent service and very quite. I was very pleased with the staff and the attention they paid to our group.The food was very good and the drinks were made to order.

reviews.title: Main palms casino
reviews.text: Nice, clean,  and cool designs. Didn't smell like cigarettes and had some great food places. Only issue that i had was the musky smell of the room when we went in. Since it was still early it wasn't to packed

reviews.title: Great facility and staff
reviews.text: The facility is pristine. The staff was even better. Donna in housekeeping kept our room immaculate and she was incredibly hospitable. Valet was incredible helpful and friendly. We will definitely come and stay again. Security initiated and quickly got my wife a wheelchair since she is disabled and helped her to the restaurant. Must stay!

reviews.title: Affordable luxury
reviews.text: All stainless steel appliances , had a rain shower and jacuzzi soaking tub!  We started on the 35th floor amazing view, especially at night. The skywalk leads you right to the casino and restaurants. Fully equipped gym and amazing pool

reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.text: I loved every second of my stay. The hotel was so luxurious I have literally never felt like I got so much bang for my back ever. The rooms were amazing the restroom was breathtaking and the view was incredible. Definitely staying again next year as long as the price stays somewhat reasonable.

reviews.title: The place is a dump. Overpriced and they charge for TOWELS!!!
reviews.text: I used to stay here all the time when they first opened. The rooms were nice and new and I never had issues. Now I check into a room that's clearly been abused, the lamp is broken, chairs are raggedy, and we called down to get additional towels. They CHARGED US 12 dollars! For 2 extra towels?!?! Are you kidding? Then what is the resort fee they add onto your room for? What am I paying for if I get charged for extra towels! This will be the last time I ever stay here.

reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: Hotel is connected to the Palms casino. Be sure to request the Palm Place or the taxi will take you to the Palms casino. We made that mistake and had to drag our luggage a long way to get to the right place. I will say the desk clerk should have called someone to help us old folk. The suite was fabulous. Full kitchen, sitting area and wonderful bathroom. Would stay there again. Since we were only there one night we didn’t get a player card which was a mistake on our part. Off the strip.

reviews.title: Extremely sub par
reviews.text: Stayed for a 3 day biz trip. Was majorly disappointed with this location. Service, cleanliness etc... all well below Vegas standards. First off, the decor is just plain bizarre, even for Vegas standards. Room was dusty and dirty. Went to lobby around 7 am one morning. Was told to go to 6th floor. Nothing opened, lady could not have been more rude about it. Room was not even cleaned the second day, despite the room clean light being on literally all day. Would never stay at this dump again.

reviews.title: Not worth being so far from the strip
reviews.text: The room was very nice and clean and modern but noisy. We switched our room because the first one had tons of noise from the road. ( it was pretty bad)Second room better- you can still hear traffic but it muffled so it is fine. Each time we went somewhere it was 16$ - 19& cab ride.  Not worth being off the strip since we like to go back to room in between shopping and or gambling to take a break. Not many shops in the hotel and  restaurants  were just ok. Price was pretty good but overall I think we will stay somewhere closer because we dropped $40 on cabs each day but maybe it suits your needs

reviews.title: Great Anniversary Trip!
reviews.text: (Booked this stay on Airbnb)This unit was exactly as pictured. The view was spectacular especially at night.Things like paper towels, coffee maker and dishes are all in the cupboards (FYI)The Palms Place is located about 5 minutes from the strip and is a good change of pace after a day of walking up and down the strip. The building is very cozy and with easy access to the Palms Casino with a sky-walk.The front desk staff was welcoming with truly superb customer service.The host, Jacob, was very easy to communicate with and very accommodating.  We would definitely stay at this unit again if we had the opportunity to do so.

reviews.title: The Palms Place
reviews.text: This accommodation is so nice and relax with reasonable prices. This is a really good and convienince place (close to down town and shops) for families who wish to visit and spend their holiday in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Expensive and bad service
reviews.text: I visited this place last month when my friend and I decided to eat at the coffee shop. There was a loud, intoxicated person yelling and nobody did anything about it. When the food finally arrived, it was cold and the server seemed to not care. It is amazing how Station Casinos acquired this property and constantly bragged how it was going to be a better place with all the new renovations, however, it seems the only change is the attitudes in this place.

reviews.title: Excellent off strip option
reviews.text: First off it’s important to note that this building is mixed use hotel/condos and my wife and I rented from an owner through Airbnb so YMMV in terms of upkeep of the unit and responsiveness of the host to any issues.  Having said that we had an excellent time here and Palms Place has a lot going for it with a few minor drawbacks.The property – Palms Place is part of the Palms complex and is about a mile west of the strip.  It’s not really walking distance, especially since you have to cross the freeway, but an Uber/Lyft is about $10 and will have you to the strip in about 10 minutes.  If you’re renting a car there is ample free parking at Palms Place.  This used to be the case on the strip too but no longer.  We stayed here as a way to avoid the nickel and diming that all the strip hotels now engage in.  Along those lines another major bonus is no obscene resort fee here which can easily add $30-50/night to your stay on the strip.  From the lobby of Palms Place it’s an easy 5 minute walk to the Palms casino which has a variety of great restaurants, a food court, movie theater, show theater, etc.  Palms Place has a little sundries shop in the lobby but of course everything has a high mark up.  There are gas stations and convenience stores within walking distance and Target, Walmart, and grocery stores you could get to via car or rideshare.  There are 2 dispensaries directly across the street from the hotel if you want to partake in some legal (in NV at least) weed or edibles.  I’m not a pool person so I can’t comment on the pool but they do have one.The room – We rented a 1 bedroom suite which has a separate bedroom area that can be closed off by a sliding door.  The bed was comfortable enough but nothing to write home about.  The kitchenette is nice so you can make coffee and eat a simple breakfast in the room without having to trek to the Palms to go to a restaurant.  There’s a fireplace (we didn’t use it) and a deep, jetted tub located by the window which is a great way to relax after a long day and take in the lights of the strip.  The open balcony faced the strip and being a bit to the west it’s cool to be able to see the entire stretch from Mandalay Bay at the south end to Stratosphere and all the way to downtown.  There are 2 bathrooms, great for 2 people to get ready for the night at the same time.  Our unit was starting to show its age a little, some scuffs on the furniture, worn carpet, etc but it was very clean so this was certainly no deal breaker.  The only real annoyance was the lack of outlets near the bed for charging your phone at night.  I ended up pulling the night stands away from the wall a bit and unplugging the alarm clock to have access to an outlet.Service – Check in was quick and easy at the front desk.  Overall we didn’t have much interaction with staff but those we did were friendly.  Since we went through Airbnb the host was upfront that daily housekeeping was optional upon request and we would be charged a fee by the property.  I’m perfectly capable of making my own bed so we never requested this.  We did want to come clean towels to use during a 5 night say but there is a washer dryer in the unit so we just bought a travel size laundry detergent and did a load of towels during our down time in the room.Miscellaneous – If you like BBQ you should go to Mabel’s in the Palms.  The meats and sides were fantastic.  Palms has also been through a major makeover in recent years and the whole property just looks brighter and more inviting than the garish look it had previously.  There are a lot of cool art pieces around the property as well.  As previously mentioned the view at night from the balcony is awesome but the day time view is cool too as we had a great view of the new NFL stadium that the Raiders will move into next season going up.All in all we had a great time here and it will be strong contender to stay at again on our next trip to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Loved It Here!
reviews.text: We rented via Airbnb. Loved this place away from the madness of downtown or the strip. Check in was quick and easy and the staff very pleasant. Stayed on 27th floor in a studio. Great space and had everything we needed. Good balcony space. The bathroom had a huge tub and dual shower heads. We had no issues with noise. Walkway to the Palms Hotel & Casino which allowed us access to bars, restaurants and the food court. Walked to the strip in the morning. A pleasant stroll took 20 minutes. Lyft / Uber was around $8 to $10 depending on where we were going. Highly recommend this place.

reviews.title: Viva las vegas
reviews.text: Check in was delayed first due to lateness with cleaning then a maintenance issue in the room we were assigned however the staff was gracious and fixed it for us. The property and rooms are top notch, a quick 25 min walk to the strip or a 8 minute drive, free parking on site, pool still open in November. 24 hr room service, connected to a casino cineplex and performance theatre. Most king units have a balcony but some do not, make sure to clarify with staff if you want one, strip view rooms highly recommended

reviews.title: Good renovation
reviews.text: I had not been at the hotel since the change in ownership and I think they have done a good job. They have added many very good new restaurants such as a Bobby Flay and Michael Simon locations. The rooms are simple but nicely done. If you want to go to the Strip it is easy and not expensive especially if you use Lyft or Uber, And the parking is free.

reviews.title: Nice room but disappointed
reviews.text: I booked this hotel for November 1st, one night only, because I was coming up for a funeral. I had to leave for Vegas very late because I had an event that night. I arrived very early , about 3or 4am with my husband and 4 month old child. Hours before I called the palms place customer service and explained that I would be traveling very early with an infant and would like to know if early check in was an option for us. I also let the customer service person know that I would be arriving by 3 or 4am and she told me to check with the desk when I arrive and was very rude. If I would have known that their earliest check in was at 12pm, I would have done things differently. Basically, I get there and they say that I can’t check in until 3pm. The lady at the desk never even told me about checking in at 12pm even though I asked. So I ended up paying for a room to stay in for the time we arrived until 11am (a waste of money but I wasn’t going to have my infant sitting in the lobby until 3pm)and had to go back to the front desk to switch keys because we were just going to stay in the same room for our actual reservation time. And that’s when I found out about early check in at 12pm from one of the guys at the front desk.Actual review of the room:Besides that, the room was nice,besides a few stains on the wall. The floor was very quiet , no real complaint about the room. I just wish my experience was better coming in.

reviews.title: Premium room with excellent view - 51st floor booking with Mike (host)
reviews.text: We rented using AirBnB (Host is Mike; description is "PH 51 fl. Best Strip View"). 51st floor room with Eastern exposure => sunrise and an amazing view of the strip lit up at night.Unit was in immaculate condition, and was 5 star calibre.Mike (host) was fantastic at communicating.<10 minute drive to Miracle Mile parking at Planet Hollywood, and easy access to Hwy 15 and 215, so great for day trips (we rented a car so this was great).Front desk was very friendly at check-in/check-out. Parking right in front was easy to get every night. Einstein bagels across the road for great morning coffee, bagels and breakfast sandwiches.Pool is great, though a bit crowded from Thurs-Sat.Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Great Vegas Views and Amenities
reviews.text: Stephanie's place was great...as expected except for very slight wear and tear on furnishings but otherwise it is as exactly as pictured. The views are spectacular! The front desk staff and bellman were helpful and informed. I was hoping for a walking distance grocery or Walgreens but since there wasn't anything closeby we ordered food and supplies easily from Amazon Prime Now and got our delivery within a 3 hr window. Stephanie was very responsive via email and we felt like we made an excellent choice with her condo. If you're a first-timer to Vegas, the city blocks are long so we weren't really walking distance to anything but Uber was a fine way to travel to restaurants and venues. This condo was a great value considering the huge space and fun little extras such as his and hers robes &  slippers. The bathroom is the bomb with dual shower heads in an oversized glass shower and double sinks. Perfect couples getaway with lots of space. We felt pampered and totally in vacation mode.

reviews.title: Resort fee rip off
reviews.text: Massive resort fee even though main pool was closed and we had the pool the size of my uncles  for use.  Food was sub par for massive price.  I’ll stay at the cosmo or Wynn again as we had to go there for the pool party as palms closed theirs already.

reviews.title: The most amazing balcony
reviews.text: Absolutely loved it, really couldn't have asked for a better room / view We were in room 302 on the 50th floor and the balcony was soo huge we could see sunset from one side and sunrise from the other ...Amazing We had a kitchen , living room with amazing fire , massive bedroom with bath tub looking onto the strip , great big bathroom with biggest shower ive ever seen.Loved it and would definitely stay againJust a pity the pool was closed on our stay , would have been nice to have been informed beforehand but would definitely stay again

reviews.title: Good clean hotel
reviews.text: Palms place hotel and spa affordable clean room. Quiet centrally located! No complaints!! The hotel has a pool, gym, casino and restaurants on site. Friendly staff. I stayed in the 1 bedroom with strip view. Room had a kitchenette and fully stocked fridge.

reviews.title: Airbnb is the way to go if you want balcony access.
reviews.text: Palms Place was preferable to me over the Ivory or the Fantasy Tower rooms at Palms. The bathrooms have tubs. There's a kitchenette. It is further removed from the action, but I can live with that. In truth, I value the party being a little off in the distance.Hooray for reviews. I learned via TripAdvisor reviews that balconies don't have access. And that the kitchenettes don't have the niceties to be able to use the kitchen facility: cups etc.Explore your Airbnb options, you can get a better appointed room. I booked the room titled Palms Envy. I was able to enjoy hanging out on a furnished balcony with a view that had friends all taking selfies. I had glassware. And I had a great time. I had the opportunity to visit another couple's room, same room type, booked through the hotel. It's interesting to see the unique touches that owners have put on their condominiums. Even things as simple as some of the furnishings make a difference. Our room was more inviting for hanging with friends.The location absolutely worked for us. We like to kick back and relax. Nearby dispensaries. A chill breakfast at the restaurant by the pool. People watching at the buffet. This absolutely suited our needs.We'll be returning.

reviews.title: Nice building - great stay
reviews.text: We stayed for one week. This building is a luxury condo building.  It was built in 2006 so not the newest and shiniest but very nice.  Units are managed by the hotel or other management companies.  We booked our unit through Air BnB.  There are some high end units in the building and many studios that are rented out.  There were a lot of high end luxury vehicles out front.  Because we were here for a week, we wanted a kitchenette that we could make coffee and breakfast.  There is a restaurant on site that over looks the pool and a bar in the lobby (underwhelming).  There is easy access to the casino and main hotel through a walk way on the second floor.  There is a moving sidewalk.  There is a great casino.  Ate at Mabel’s BBQ - very good.  We would take Lyft up to the strip at night.  Roughly $9-10 depending on where you are going.  We parked in the self park open lot across from the entrance.  Always got a spot.  The building gets busy on the weekend with young people.  There were some partiers on Saturday that were screaming and woke us.  It didn’t last long and was not a big deal.  Great stay.

reviews.title: Double booked !!!!!
reviews.text: So we booked in August for a unit at Palms place for 2 nights and paid £480 that was non refundable so we were planning our trip around this!! We drove 6 hours from Salt Lake City to be told the “uncontactable owner” could not be contacted and may have simply forgotten that we had booked !!! Utter rubbish. I was turned away - do not book here !!  There is no guarantee your booking will be honoured and I’m now trying to get redress through hotels.com. Thoroughly unprofessional !!!

reviews.title: Nice but the suite needs work
