Everything was went not bad, but at 10/6 morning, we were supposed to get a nice rest until noon, but, we were awoken up by some very loud electric drill noise and some construction sound around 6:30AM. I think no one can sleep under that kind of noise, it’s like they drill thing right next to  my ear. I called the front desk at 7:30AM to ask why, the gentleman only answered: I did not aware we have construction on going now.  And then??? He just kept silence. I think this was not a good response. I still asked him to check for me, he sound like unwilling to, and he transferred me to a lady, the lady said they were changing glass balcony upstairs, I asked how long will it be, but she cannot answer. She told me she can check it and call me back, but after 1hour, she never called. I can see the working guys doing the work right above my room from my window, that is why the noises were terribly loud, the work was lasting until 9 or 10AM and I just cannot stay in my room anymore. Is it make any sense to have someone to use electric drill to replace balcony glasses when there were customers staying in underneath room, and the work took place at 6:30AM in the morning???? I really cannot understand. I was about to tell the front desk when I checked out that day noon, but the front desk gentlemen did not even ask how was my stay. It was the most unpleasant stay in Las Vegas .

reviews.title: Rented privately owned condo suite
reviews.text: We rented a 1220 sf condo from an individual owner for a trip with 3 adults and an infant. It was nice being in the Palms Place condos and not having to walk through a smoke filled casino. The parking was very easy/adequate and the facilities were nice enough. The strip shuttle only departs from the Palms Hotel which is a decent walk away, but we had a rental car (which I would highly recommend) so not a big deal to us. If you rent from an individual on AirBnB or VRBO this place is a bargain, if you rent directly from the Palms I believe the price is substantially higher and may not be quite as appealing. Our friends were in a smaller unit that we visited, also nice and clean, modern furnishing etc. The internet was disappointing and not free from what I could tell, so we stuck with cellular internet the whole time.

reviews.title: Good, not great
reviews.text: Truthfully, I did not spend much time in the suite. There is so much more to do around Las Vegas than sit in a hotel room. As a place to sleep, it works. Clean and efficient. I'm a photographer, and we did use the suite as a location twice. Since each room/suite varies, what worked or did not work for me, may not influence you.The floor plan I was shown prior to booking was slightly different than the actual room I received. As a room, this was no trouble, but as a photography studio, it did impact me. User beware.The room was filled with mirrors and reflective surfaces (TV screens). Not ideal for my purposes. The balcony was locked, and the hotel staff could not open it for me. Disappointing for trying to capture the view of the city at night. However, the staff was very helpful with many other services, especially valet parking and checking my luggage on my last day for late leave time. Friendly.

reviews.title: Nice room but exercise options not for the early riser
reviews.text: I booked off the strip based on the photos of the living space and relaxing resort quality exercise options. When I travel to Vegas it is most certainly for work. Being an east coaster I am up by 3 a.m. hoping to swim or at the very least hop on a treadmill.In a nutshell, pool not open until 11 and gym not open until 6. I am upset and frustrated and manager on duty (Chris?) didn't offer a solution or compromise. Not everyone is here for the nightlife or can easily adapt to the time difference. Even working options are limited with the slow "free" internet. I am disappointed and this is going to be a loooong week. I will never stay off the strip again. Even if the price is a bargain it isn't worth the lack of access to facilities or the uber fares...Apparently you are free to roam around in your evening wear after 4 a.m. and stumble around but not work out or swim...

reviews.title: Nannied here for the first time
reviews.text: Nannied here for the first time and they rented the room from Airbnb. The room was a spacious 1 king size bed w a decent sized couch. Also had a fridge, stove and dishwasher. The place wasn’t very clean though… had tile, wood floor and a small carpet area. The couch had tons of stains all over it and the carpet as well. The square glass table didn’t have stoppers under the glass and the glass moved everytime you touched it. The patio was nice with a great view!

reviews.title: Somewhat Disappointed
reviews.text: We booked a 2 night stay at PP/LV September '17. We specifically booked thru the actual hotel to avoid the mishaps I'd previously read about regarding privately rented units. Well let me say it didn't really make a difference..  The 1st room we were given had dinged/chipped furniture, stained pillows on the couch and just an overall "over used" feel.  We were in a hurry so we quickly checked in left our bags in the room and dashed off to an appointment.  All the time I had that feeling that I just wasn't satisfied with the room.  When we returned I went straight to the check-in desk to voice my concern. The staff I agent I spoke with checked with her manager and supposedly gave us a "nicer" suite which turned out to be a little better however still not what I expected.  This was our 1st and last stay at this property.  The lobby had a strange unpleasant odor every time we entered. And in the mornings I could smell exactly and quite clearly what one of the units near us was having for breakfast.  In the 2nd room we were given we had a balcony with a very nice view of the strip which was pretty at night but the door was locked preventing us from actually going outside the room.  The balcony had what looked like glass for the outer railing but it was either scratched or extremely dirty as you couldn't see thru it at all.  Also, this as most of the hotels in the strip area, charges a "resort" fee.  The 1st day we checked in we were alerted that we did not have access to the pool as there was a private event so it was closed.  After we left I thought I really should've asked for a credit since we didn't have the access for that day or at least pro-rated!!! As nice as the rooms are portrayed it just had on overall “overused” feel… not sparkly and clean.  There were only a couple of glasses and 2-3 pots.... no kitchen utensils at all ---cabinets were empty.  The bathroom appeared brighter due to the white marble tile, however the shower not so much.  The shower head looked really bad with hard water damage and what looked like mold and I couldn’t quite get it figured out as water came from both the hand held part and the rain head above from the ceiling. Also something that was just crazy strange is there are 2 TVs in the rooms both of which are merely a few feet away from each other.  Not sure what the attempted concept was but still don’t understand how you are supposed to watch one and someone else watch the other within the same space.  It was just weird.  Overall, it just wasn't the best stay I've had while visiting LV and probably wasn't the worse although thinking back I don't think I've really had a bad stay in all the years I've visited LV.    We had actually considered using this location to accommodate our guests for our upcoming wedding next year in LV.  It seemed a good choice with the listed amenities.  Sorry, PP but aside from the great customer service we received in switching out the rooms, we weren’t impressed with the property.

reviews.title: Feels like home
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I stayed here for our birthday and had a really great time.  Alex was the front desk agent Who checked us in and he was great. When we checked in to our one bedroom suite we were very impressed. There was a jet tub, floor to ceiling panoramic windows, a fire place, a full kitchen, two bathrooms, we couldn't ask for anything else.  The view  at night was beautiful. There were lights everywhere. When we woke  up the next morning and looked out the window, we were very surprised to see that we had both a Mountain View and a view of the strip. This hotel really follows the Forbes standards.  Angie who was one of the pbx agents always addresses me by my last name, housekeeping never failed to service my room when I called and all request were taken care of in 15 minutes or less.  The showers were pretty darn awesome.  This hotel is HUGE there is a movie theater, you can take the skywall to the casino which is pretty cool.  You can also take the skywalk to alize where my boyfriend and I had dinner. Beautiful views great food and great service.  Now the salon is beautiful, service is good but the lady who did my makeup did a horrible job. I paid her, ran to my room and washed out my face and ended up doing my own make up. However, that didn't ruin the experience for the rest of the night was seamless. please make this your go to hotel if you are in Vegas. I know I will.  This place feels like home.

reviews.title: Amazing stay
reviews.text: We stayed at Palms Place for 3 days. It was an amazing stay. Valet gents as well as front desk staff were very kind and helpful. Hotel and rooms are very nice. Everything was clean - hotel itself, lobby, room... Our room was spacious and very comfortable with beautiful bathroom. It was on 31st floor so view was great, especially night one. Maybe one thing I was pretty shocked about - check out is 11am and at around 9am housekeeping knocked on our door and also rang the bell asking what time we will check out. It was so noisy I woke up wondering what's going on. But other than this, everything was great about our stay and I would definitely recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: Spacious and Clean Room
reviews.text: Rooms were clean, spacious and quiet.  If you stay at Palms Place, you'll need to walk to the tower building for the casino, food, transportation bus to the strip and registration.  Less than a 5 minute walk and all indoors.  They provide a bus to Caesars Palace every 30 min from 11 am to 8 pm.

reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text: First stay at Palms Place and they did not impress! Lobby staff is not paying any attention to you or your needs, just getting the job done. I've stayed at hotels in 35+ countries, thousands of nights altogether. This morning, checking out at Palms Place, was the first time ever when no one asked if everything had gone well - they must have known what the answer would have been. Room itself is nice and spacious but some of the lights were out, tv remote didn't work etc. These are sort of a usual things - but balcony glass is not... Highly advertised view of the strip doesn't really impress when balcony glasses are so dirty that you hardly see through. Damn, plywood might look better!Finally, renovation of Palms Casino and service areas is killing everything! Most of the restaurants are closed, the ones open are poorly staffed and even navigating through the construction sites can be a challenge. In a town with most astonishing alternatives, there's no reason for one to choose Palms Place.

reviews.title: Upscale and modern hotel!
reviews.text: Hotel was very clean and classy. Likewise for the rooms. We stayed on the 22nd floor and we can have a great view from there. Hotel is located off the strip so there's not too much traffic nearby. Free parking is provided and this is something which you can seldom find on the hotels on strip as most of the hotels there are charging people for self parking.Nonetheless, there's a travalator on the 2nd floor which leads you to the nearby palm's resort and casino if you are keen for some gambling! I mean, who doesn't gamble when in vegas?!  Bathroom came with showerhead and a bathtub/jacuzzi. it's especially good to know after a long walk on the strip and you can relax yourself in your own space's jacuzzi. there's even a mini lcd tv in the bathroom! I mean, this is the 1st time i had a mini tv in the bathroom! How class is that! You can relax in your bathtub while watching your tv programs!However, price might be on the higher end but i managed to snag a good deal by staying on a weekday. Will definitely be back!

reviews.title: Big Room & Great View
reviews.text: Just stayed here for 11 nights. We had a big well appointed room with a great view of Vegas. Having a fridge and ice in the room is great for making up a few cocktails before you go out.  The room and hotel was spotless. The pools are great but  pricy for drinks and but there are restaurants, bars and diners to suit any pocket inside the palms and palms place.All good. Would stay again.

reviews.title: ANOTHER FLAWLESS STAY, RELAXING BEYOND MEASURE...
reviews.text: This property remains my absolute favorite in all of Las Vegas. The entire staff is phenomenal, and works tirelessly to provide the best in customer service. All the while, they remain perfectly attired and professionally presentable! It is truly refreshing to enter the property and see the smiling faces behind the front desk as they welcome guests from around the globe. Everyone here is exceptional, and truly versed in the finer details of the hospitality industry. They understand the intricacies and complexities of the business, and maneuver around obstacles and adversity like finely tuned experts! Annisse White, Brandon Evans, and the rest of the entire front desk deserve accolades and more! The Bellman, Valet (Brooke, Tom, etc) are exceedingly skilled, and are constantly working. The housekeeping department is phenomenal, and will attend to every request promptly and kindly. The Concierge (Christine) desk team is amazing, and always remembers me by name. The drift Spa team is superb, and I recently posted a kudo for them as well. I cannot say enough about this property. It is managed with excellence under the direction of Mr. Anthony Faranca. The standard is most assuredly five star, as I'd confirm a reservation here before I'd contact the Four Seasons or the Ritz any day! It remains a fact that the people employed under this roof make up one outstanding team, inimitable and unsurpassable. Such continuity in the hotel industry is rare, and is the foundation of any truly successful enterprise. I love your property, but truly return for the "people" working to ensure your future. Thanks to everyone, for one memorable adventure after another.

reviews.title: Mini Vacay
reviews.text: Palms Place was an amazing stay. The rooms are clean, quiet and updated. The pool was also very nice.. and pricing was a great deal on Hotwire. Justin at the front desk had exceptional customer service and he was able to offer a great view on floor 16. The only thing different that I would change was the fact that you can't access the balcony. I'm a sunrise lover but I still experienced an awesome view.

reviews.title: Music Video shoot
reviews.text: This was one of the best lodging investments I've ever made in my life! The view from this place is amazing! Literally incredible. I love everything about staying here. It was extremely dope!I would definitely stay there again!

reviews.title: Great view, and nice staff
reviews.text: We booked a room on the 51st floor according to the hotel, but its more lik thirtysomething floor because they just skipped the floors with number 4.The pool is well maintained, and nice, the staff is really nice and helpfull.

reviews.title: great stay
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I loved this resort. It is not on the strip and there is no casino in the hotel which means way less traffic and a more relaxing atmosphere. We loved it. The room was super clean and beautiful with one of the best hotel bathrooms I have ever seen. The pool is nice, the spa is amazing (they also have a tanning and fitness center in the spa area). We had no complaints except the balcony was not accessible (you have to book with someone who owns a room to have balcony access).The Casino at the Palms is connected through a sky bridge or you can just walk through the parking lot, the RIO is right across the street, the Orleans is right up the street, and the strip is only a 7 min drive from Palms Place....just a side note there is also a marijuana dispensary across the street for all my pot smoking friends.

reviews.title: 2nd Home
reviews.text: My husband and I first stayed at the Palms Place in 2012 for our anniversary which always falls during March Madness and St. Patrick's day. Our first stay was purely based on a deal but every other stay after has been great if not better. We've stayed twice in 6 months once for my birthday and to attend a Lakers preseason game in Oct of 2016 and again during March madness this year. The front desk staff is always accommodating, we arrived early both recent times and was able to check in. The views from the 52nd and 53rd floors facing the strip were amazing. We frequent the bar at the casino Tonic and Omar and the staff always takes great care of us while we play games and watch them also at the bar. We were able to have massages and refresh in the coed Hammam room at Drift Spa. We love to stay here because of the closeness to the strip and freeways and also because you can have fun but relax at the same time. We will be back very soon.

reviews.title: Nice but could be cleaner
reviews.text: Stayed 3 nights got a good deal on Vegas.com $330 for 3 nights (flight + hotel bundle). When I arrived I got randomly upgraded to a better room which was amazing. The interior of the room was really fancy and nicely decorated with modern furniture, a huge refrigerator, kitchen with stove top, and island/bar area. We had a big king size bed and the couch was a pull-out so there was plenty of room for me, my girlfriend and her daughter, and there was even a Jacuzzi tub facing the city in the living room area! My only negative comment of the room was that you could see smudges and fingerprints on the laminate/mirrored surface of the tables/walls. They should have windex'd it a bit more, it was a minor thing but for how fancy the Palms Place Hotel and Spa is I would have expected better. Also, there were some long hairs on the carpet, so another pass with the vacuum would have help. These are minor issues, but hindered to experience of staying at such a fancy hotel. The bar area was great, very friendly and attentive staff, I think there was only one pool table so we had to wait for the couple ahead of us to play a game. The location wasn't bad, we thought it was on the strip but found out when we got there that it was one block away which was fine.In order to save money the first night we walked to the strip and I think this a Las Vegas issue and not a hotel issue but as soon as we got to the side walk from the parking lot there were quite a few cockroaches roaming the sidewalks near the rocks and plants looking for food. It freaked my gf and her daughter out, that was their first time seeing a roach in real life lol Luckily we did not see any roaches in the hotel or in our room, but the girls were hyper vigilant after seeing them close to the sidewalk/parking lot area. Just minor things the hotel could do make the customer experience better: double check room cleanliness. Umm, that's it. That was my only complaint, which wasn't that big of a deal. The city of Las Vegas on the other hand, they have a pretty big roach problem but that cant be fixed unless everyone throws their trash in the appropriate containers or something. In conclusion, this was our first stay in Vegas as a couple and the hotel and staff were very helpful, accommodating and amazing. I would 100% stay here again, just hope the price is lowered lol

reviews.title: Renewing our wedding vows
reviews.text: We pulled up to the palms casino and informed we need to go to Palms place. Pulled up to valet parking. Informed the parking attendant we are dropping our luggage & my husband off to check-in but I will return. We arrive at 1130 and allowed to check-in. Our room is on floor 30 room 312. Phone did not work and balcony door does not open. I immediately went downstairs to address the issues and told they will fix the phone problem but the balcony door remains close per policy.  I saw the other people out in the balcony. I went outside to get my car from the parking attendant. He brought my car around he got out and immediately turned around to talk to another employee then walked away not closing my car door. Poor customer service. Throughout our stay the phone did not work and their was a message from the beginning of our stay. Place was quiet but the issue we had is it appeared like majority of people were smoking weed. The smell was extremely overwhelming at time from walking out the room, in the hallway, elevator and the second you are in the valet area. We got home all my stuff needing washing just seemed that smell was all over the place.

reviews.title: Nice One-night Stay
reviews.text: Very nice, off-the-strip property.  Like that there's a real parking lot so you can park right out front with no valet, parking garage hassles. Check-in was quick, room was very nice and comfortable--and quiet. 53rd floor had a nice view of the mountains to the west. Only one downer--no MSNBC on cable....

reviews.title: Very nice place!
reviews.text: I have been to Vegas a lot, but had never stayed at the Palms property. So I figured this time I would give it a shot. After looking at the Palms 3 diff hotels to stay at, the Palms Place looked the nicest! The only drawback is it's not right on the strip but it is a 5 min cab ride to Ceasers or Bellagio! Hotel was very clean, the rooms were great! Basically a full kitchen! The bathroom very fancy with a jetted tub! Thing is, in Vegas these days I'm noticing hotels not even having microwaves or refrigerators in their rooms! Not cool! You need at least one or the other!

reviews.title: Not likely to stay here again - bad room experience
reviews.text: I decided to stay at the Palms Place during July 4th for a few days. Palms Place is an apt. building/condos they rent.  Loooong walk from the Palms Casino Hotel area to Palms Place Rooms. The GO  airport shuttle wouldn't pick up or drop at Palms Place bldg front.   Upon arriving at my suite which was a corner room - overpowered by smell of pot. I also had maintenance issues such as: faucet in sink came off in my hand and jetted tub would turn on by itself at times. Would not stay here.After relaying my issues -- the Palms did refund my daily fee.. So kudos! for that to the Palms Management - was much appreciated.

reviews.title: Better than Expected
reviews.text: Stayed for the weekend and loved it. The suite had spectacular views of the strip. The suite was modern with all the newest amenities and appliances. I loved the free parking so I can come and go as I please without having to spend the extra on pay parking or valet. The location is also close to many great local restaurants for cheap dining.

reviews.title: Best hotel EVER!
reviews.text: We have stayed at a lot of luxury resorts but the suites at this place are the nicest hands down!  So much space, great views, luxury furnishings.  We won't stay anywhere else again in Vegas!  The only downside was it was quite a walk to the food and casino but room service was very affordable.

reviews.title: State of the Art
reviews.text: I absolutely love it here, the spa is state of the art.The workout facility is amazing with all the necessary equipment.We stayed on the 21st floor with amazing views.The pool is very nice offering shaded areas and cabanas for rent.I will stay here again!

reviews.title: Value for money
reviews.text: Great place to be. I will surely recommend. Well situated. Clean rooms and very spacious,bedroom, large bathroom and American cuisine, balcony viewing the strips. Casino, bar and lounge on the first level and staff members very friendly. If you are staying In Vegas check out ;"the palms "B&Jc

reviews.title: Super clean
reviews.text: Stayed one night at Palms Place just to get away.  The room was decked out with a super view of the city.   The walk to the Pals Casino was quick, easy and totally worth it!  On the way back, there is a people mover to help get you back to the room a little faster.  Back at the tower, you will be greeted by a a security guard who will check your room key to make sure you have a reason to access the Palms Place tower. In the room, all stainless steel appliances along with a electric stove top was a nice added touch.  The shower head was a overhead rainfall with great pressure.  The room also had a very clean jacuzzi tub.  The bed was top of the line with soft sheets and comfy oversized pillows.  We will be staying here next time for sure!

reviews.title: Not a place to stay if your focus isn't casinos
reviews.text: We stayed here with our son's basketball team during a Vegas tournament.  Not a good idea.  Both us and at least one room of players had great difficulty getting utensils and basic cookware in order to use the kitchenette (or just eat breakfast cereal).  Over the week we asked 3 times for a knife and a cutting board, and never received anything.  Both pools in the hotel are not open in the evenings (which is actually typical in Vegas, I think), BUT they were both closed one afternoon for simultaneous 'private functions'.  We were bummed out - families with small children were devastated.   Other weird stuff happened:  I had to take a small tote bag back to my room as 'backpacks were not allowed in the pool area'.   Meanwhile other people were walking in with big beach bags.  Just weird.  And you can't take any drinks into the pool area - not horrendous as you can ask for a class of tap water or spend quite a few dollars on a bottle of water.      The room rate was decent and room service was good.  But we wouldn't ever base ourselves here again for a similar trip or family vacation.

reviews.title: Pretty good for the price.
reviews.text: The room reasonably priced, as i stayed there on a weekday.  The room looks just like the images provided on the website. Modern-ish, spacious little studio. I requested a strip view on a high floor and that is what I received. Early check was no problem for this Amazing little place off the strip with an even better view. The only downside(s) was that the air conditioning did not get cold, so it was a little warm, even after I called downstairs to have someone come and check it out. Luckily the sun went down so it became a little more manageable at night. We did not have access to the patio, but I am assuming that is a liability thing. The shower head was a little crusty, so I was a little turned off by that.  I worked for years in customer service so I am a little picky, but the customer service could use a little improvement as a whole, not that it was bad, it just was something that would make me want to come back. The facility itself was nice and I will probably stay again and give them a second chance on the customer service and bathroom cleanliness piece.

reviews.title: Worse than Bed Bugs
reviews.text: This used to be my go-to Vegas hotel that I would recommend to all my LA friends. Well, that is no longer the case after my Aug 3 stay. I had a last-minute family emergency with my sweet nephew in ICU and was flying through Las Vegas to get back faster to see him before it was too late. I checked in at 1am and was out by 5:30am to head to airport. I explained the situation in near tears to the front desk person, Perla, who checked with her manager Elaine Gutierrez, about whether they could not charge the resort fee given the circumstances and the fact that we couldn't possibly have used any of the amenities during that time. Both employees cold as ice unapologetically said it was mandatory fee. Truth be told, the only reason I thought to ask was because my ex-boyfriend had had the resort fee waived a couple times for what I had always thought were pretty insignificant reasons. I knew it was actually very possible, which is what makes this situation all the more disgusting. I simply can't recommend a place that doesn't have compassion or human decency. This is not the place for me any longer. And it should not be for you either.

reviews.title: Staycation
reviews.text: The room was absolutely beautiful! The only drawback was that we didn't have access to the patio, but the view was stunning! The valet was free, and they were very nice. There is self parking as well, with casinos and restaurants within walking distance.

reviews.title: Nice to visit although wouldn't want to live there
reviews.text: This is right next-door to the Palms casino. We stayed thru Airbnb. Very easy to get to. Like the convenience of getting to your car and easy to check out and in. Parking is free and valet is free. Most of the workers and staff were pretty nice just a few who seemed like they didn't want to be there. There is a walkway inside to go to the Palms Casino. It takes you to a really good food court. About 10 minutes to walk through. Had a very nice pool area. You can also use the pool at the Palms Casino which is also very nice and not crowded since it was the weekdays. If you are using the pools you're not allowed to take any drinks or food to any pool area and that includes water! They check. Did not like that. Our room had a lovely view of the Rio and the strip in the distance. Rooms were very modern looking, stainless steel kitchenette.

reviews.title: Horrible experience
reviews.text: If I could give a 1/2 circle, I would. This has to be one of the worst hotels I've ever stayed in. The rooms are totally outdated, most of the showers are broken, and they are overall dirty. I couldn't wait to leave. Getting a suite in Vegas was impossible, everything sold out, so we took what we could get. We even got a room at the Bellagio just to use the pool and facilities because it's SOOOOO much nicer. Overall the Palms can only offer one thing....a lot of space for your money, and a washer and dryer, which I used daily. Other than that, it's a piece of crap.

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: We had initially booked at the other Palms hotel and were graciously upgraded to the Palms Place with no extra charge. I've never stayed off the strip before, but I think this will be my new go to. The bed was insanely comfortable, nice big rooms, jacuzzi tubs and all staff we encountered were very hospitable. The pool on this side as well is a lot quieter, made for an older crowd. Although we did not spend much of any time in it, its still very nice. Only time I did not have the best experience was coming back late at night, they have security checking to make sure you are the hotel guest. That alone is fine, however the security staff were very very rude. Would recommend a stay here to anyone!

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: I booked this place through Airbnb so my review might not exactly be true for the entire hotel. The room looked great, there was a tub in the bedroom and the view was great. I stayed on the 10th floor room 322. The issue I had was the cleaningness. The room looked like the cleaners rushed to get the place clean without doing a through job of cleaning it. The stove had vegetable oil dropping from its sides. The floors looked dusty. The ice compartment had dirt in it, the bath tub had dirt smudges. I wouldn't really have cared but I was pissed because I was charged a "cleaning fee" of over $100 bucks and when I asked what the cleaning fee was for it was basically to clean the room after checkout. Apart from the unclean aspects of the room everything else was great. The pool staff were really nice.

reviews.title: I almost always stay at the Palms Place Hotel and Spa when in Las Vegas
reviews.text: I come to Las Vegas 8 or 9 times a year to teach a class that is near Palms Place.  I could also stay at the Gold Coast or the Rio and still be within walking distance of the training center.  The Gold Coast is too smoky and the Rio is a distance away.  But, I like the quiet atmosphere of the Palms Place, the restaurant and the lounge available.  Try it out!

reviews.title: Horrible service, nasty staff and condition of rooms is unbelievable...in fact disgusting.
reviews.text: Seats torn to shreds on chairs and staff refused to fix. Security is nasty, pushy and act like animals. Managers put you on hold and leave you there. This is the worst of Vegas at it's worst. Stay away....you were warned. SEE PHOTOS!

reviews.title: Wow like staying home but being in vegas
reviews.text: Great lace for a bit more homey quiet place off strip. Lots of parking.  Spa is ????the pool was off limits because it is on 3rd floor and too windy. We are in L.v what were they thinking. Of course it was windy as often the case. The pool next door at casino is available but you schlep there thru tunnel skywalk. Haha. Not sure gonna check it now. The buffet was crazy at casino. Sunday brunch 17.99 a lot of different type of food. Good for maybe 3 or 4 pm breakfast pricey for breakfast fixings. But food court coffee bean nathans mcdonald choices. So basically nice quiet no tumult but the pool is ???

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: It's located not far from the Strip, it's good rooms and has good location and you can have a shuttle service to the Bellagio. But unfortunately not geniune staff and the service is low. Have stayed her twice.

reviews.title: Last minute
reviews.text: Too bad I don't have the picture of the room but it's exactly how you see it online. We stood here 2 night because we had to help our friend at The Magic Convention. Even though we were off the strip it was still perfect and we weren't far away from the Convention Center. I highly recommend this place they'll take care of you

reviews.title: Nice stay off the strip
reviews.text: First time staying at Palms Place Suites. We had a studio suite which was very roomy for the two of us, nicely appointed, nice view. We were there on a Sunday and Monday night, so Sunday night was very quite in the casino, so we walked over to the Rio. Monday we took an inexpensive Uber to the Las Vegas north premium outlets, and later in the evenig an inexpensive Uber to the strip.The pool is very nice at Palms Place, a fun place to hang out, This is a great choice if you are looking for a more chill stay compared to a large, busy place on the strip. You still can enjoy all the action on the strip, but come back to your own suite without the crowds. I would imagine if you were plannnig a bachelor or bachelorette weekend, I would opt for the Aria, but if you wanted to balance the wekend with crowds and a few hours of r and r without the crazy massive crowds, the Palms Place is a nice choice. The kitchen allows for preparing meals if you choose to do that on vacation.

reviews.title: Beautiful but falling apart
reviews.text: Had a good trip with my bridesmaids in May. Arrived early in the day and got frustrated the valet entrance was not staffed with anyone directing traffic. When we pulled in they wrong lane they got upset at us. Yes I know there are signs at the top of the entrance but when the lanes are backed up and all cars and taxis are in every lane it's hard to follow signs without other direction.  Fortunately storing luggage was easy since we weren't checking immediately. Checking in late at night was thankfully quick. Used a third party to get the best rate available. We had two rooms right across from each other. Beautiful rooms and amenities including rain shower, floor to ceiling windows, fridge, stove, microwave and dishwasher. Down side not enough plug outlets by the bedside, no dishes to actually use, the beautiful shower was open to the whole bathroom and water would leak across the whole floor. The day we arrived my friend got locked in the bathroom. We got her out before maintenance arrived. The handle and lock came off both sides of the sliding door. When the engineer came I pointed out two other things that were broken in the room and they were not resolved during our stay.  The door handle/lock was not fixed until the second day of our stay and when it was, it was horribly fixed with thick glue and taped in place to allow the glue to dry. Looked like a child hot glued the handle back. One thing I did like was the doorbell and indicator lights for housekeeping service or privacy requested. A note about housekeeping: Who ever serviced the room prior to arrival did a poor job of making the bed. The flat sheet did not wrap the bed and the sheets were wrinkled underneath the down blanket and were not tucked properly. Very sloppy job. Lastly, we were picked up by a shuttle tour driver at the main entrance of the Palms casino around 9 am and part of the metal door bracket covering fell near us as we opened the door.  Engineering/maintenance department need to step up their game and preventative maintenance schedules.  Imagine what would have happened if that metal piece hit any of us.

reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: Loved this hotel, really! Room is large! Nice decoration, big fridge, microwave and much more! Quiet hotel (casino is in the next building). Wifi was good also. Big free parking lot. Strip few kilometres away. Easily 5/5!

reviews.title: Goddaughters 21st Birthday Celebration
reviews.text: We chose this hotel with the reviews of TripAdvisor and was not disappointed.The location is only a short distance to the strip,The hotel offers a shuttle bus service that runs from 11am till 8pm every half hour taxi to and from the strip only cost 10 dollars.We stayed on the 26th floor with amazing view of the strip the room was very modern decor large and clean with friendly staff.We visited the Ghost Bar one night with amazing views of the strip great for photos.We made great use of our hotel pool to chill out during the afternoons you are not allowed to take drinks from outside.Drink prices for a bottle of water 10 dollars.Thank you to all the friendly staff for making our stay amazing.D J  on reception desk for all your help.

reviews.title: Unfriendly Stay!!!!!
reviews.text: The staff was unfriendly, and unaccommodating. I made a few requests and the manager at Palms Place was unwilling to help me. This USED to be the place to be, but not anymore. I'll never stay here again, well maybe, if there's newer management. Palms and Palms Place management needs a revamping. Until then, I'll be staying on the strip where the LUXURY hotels are, and where guests are appreciated.

reviews.title: Nice and comfortable
reviews.text: The Palm is a Nice Hotel outside the strip. The rooms were big and the bathroom was really big. The got a room on the 30th floor and a had a amazing view. The palms have a to pools, noe big one and one which was smaller but a lot more quiet. They have a small bus that can take you to the stip which was Nice, but remember to go a few minutes before, because the bus is small.

reviews.title: Has Been ...
reviews.text: Nice room, large, stylish, good layout BUTRoom smelled like someone had consumed tons of marijuana and TVs did not function neither two of the room lamps. Hotel is not cheap and you should expect a clean smelling room and working appliances. Not here. BE CAREFUL!!

reviews.title: Modern design, great views
reviews.text: This hotel had an amazing modern entranceway and lobby. The security was good, they checked room keys at the lifts after 8pm. The room was a very generous size, again with modern decor. When we checked in we were asked if we wanted a higher or lower floor, and if we would prefer a desert or strip view - great that we got to choose. Some of the stools in the room were a little bit tatty but everything was very clean and comfortable. We didn't have time to explore the pool/outdoor lounge area. The location is a little bit away from the strip so it's quite a long walk - we had a car so were able to drive everywhere. It is also quite close to the chinatown area so we had a look around there too - lots of good places to eat! For breakfast there's a bagel place next door as well as a sandwich shop. Unfortunately there was no free wifi, this was probably the biggest down-side. I would certainly stay here again.

reviews.title: Warehouse Manager
reviews.text: Palms place and Spa A awesome hotel a pefect hotel if you looking for the extra very excellent staff but minus level to the supervisor for front desk he should look out for another jobhe was very unpleasant  and had very bad attitude. Me and my daughter has stay there 2 times but no more  stay there so long that supervisor works there  we are comming back to Vegas in October -17But proably not to Palm's this time.

reviews.title: Love It!
reviews.text: Definitely would recommend the palms to anyone. I loved the hotel and the staff is extremely friendly. Nice and quite also. Has free self and valet parking which is a plus and my room was clean and beautiful! I enjoyed my stay!

reviews.title: Overall good experience
reviews.text: We booked this room through Expedia in order to expand the number of Hotels we've stayed at in Las Vegas. This is the 19th so far and we're pretty impressed based on the price we paid for the room. We booked one of studio suites with a strip view. Check in was smooth and the front desk staff was professional, knowledgeable,  and courteous. The check in process was expedient and infomative. We were given a general once over of amenities and locations of restaurants and such. We got our keys and got to our room. The bell person, Ian, was a consummate professional. What a sharp guy. He gave us the run down of the room, layout of the Palms as well as Palms Place. He showed us where everything was in the room. The layout of the room is pretty neat. The bathroom has a rainfall shower, regular shower, jetted larger tub, partitioned dump area (without a door) and a TV. The kitchen has a regular fridge with ice maker, a wet bar fridge with ridiculously priced snacks and beverages ($5.71 for a diet coke). The layout of suite was nice with an L shaped sofa and king size bed. There are 2 TV's, oddly enough side by side and a foot and half from each other. Next to the couch an inaccessible balcony. Ian informed us that due to the nature of people often times dealing with incredible monetary losses and 20 something year old drunkards ejecting various items from the balconies,  they are now locked and off limits. The complete view of the strip was amazing and a great backdrop while sleeping. Being on the 51st floor we had a spectacular view. The couch, to be honest, was stiff and uncomfortable. The bed wasn't bad as far as comfort goes, I've slept on worse and better. The dining table bar stool type chars were absolutely uncomfortable and reminiscent of medieval torture devices. The bar running across the seat of the chair acted as a vice for my nether region. I'd recommemd not even sitting in them. The entertainment/movie rental system didn't work. That being said, still, I really like this place,  it has a good vibe. If you're not a cheapo who doesn't like paying for taxis or an uber in order to get to the strip or Fremomt, stay somewhere else if you're going to pinch pennies. The cleaning staff didn't seem to understand that the little red light indicating "do not disturb" literally means "do not disturb." Aftet a night of drinking and gambling we were woken up with repetitive knocks from the maid at nine in the morning,  three short hours after we retired from our night/morning of alcohol consumption and gambling. Had it not been for the maids insistance of getting us to acknowledge her, it would have been a PERFECT stay. There was a walkway that conveniently connected Palms Place to the Palms Casino, Restaurants,  and food court. The casino was fun but getting a drink was impossible so I bit the bullet and went to the food court. Overall it was a great stay with the exception of the maid. I'd say do it. The suites are pretty fun and give the feel of staying in a luxury condo.

reviews.title: Beautiful Rooms with a View!
reviews.text: We stayed in one of the larger suite rooms with full kitchen and living room. Room was really large and is nicer than most average hotels on the strip. The views were amazing as the windows surrounded two sides of the room and we faced the strip. Downside is it's not right on the strip so there is a bit less energy here. If you're looking for good views at a good price, this is the place to stay.

reviews.title: Poor Customer Service
reviews.text: I reached out to the hotel in March and again recently, regarding the below concern. Surprisingly, I've never received a response. I also shared my concern with a rep at the check-in desk during our stay, was told a manager would follow-up with me, and nothing came of it. We couldn't have enjoyed our stay more and the below situation was but a minor issue in an otherwise terrific weekend. But a failure to simply acknowledge our poor experience in any way...even just a simple "thank you for your feedback "...has made me never want to give the Palms My business again.- - - - - - - -Hello,I'm currently staying at Palms Place and wanted to share feedback regarding an event that took place today. One of the primary reasons I booked our stay at the Palms Place was to enjoy the pool. We had planned to spend this afternoon there but arrived and were told that it was closed for a private event. While that's certainly understandable, it would have been appreciated had the check-in staff informed us when we arrived so we could plan accordingly and go at a different time or visit another hotel's pool. Additionally, there was no hotel staff member there to intercept hotel guests. We had to pop into the spa to confirm what the situation was.A spa staff member told us we could we use the Palms pool by showing our guest card; however, when we arrived there, we were informed we also needed photo id. This required a trip back across the property to our rooms, which again would not have been frustrating had we known about the situation in advance and if I didn't currently have a foot injury.

reviews.title: Coackroach!
reviews.text: It was rated as a 4 1/2 star hotel. When we checked in -the room was a bit dusty and an old used tea cup was in the refrigerator. Most surprising when using the bathroom to get ready for bed a large cockroach climbing up the wall. We were only staying one night.  When we checked out I mentioned I felt the condition of our room was not up to standard- front desk said we should have called to be moved. We checked in late, and I expect a clean room- when there is one cockroach there are many more to follow. The dinner in the spa cafe was very nice for a quick bite.

reviews.title: Weekend Getaway
reviews.text: We made a reservation at this hotel on Expedia for a one night weekend getaway.When we arrived at check in and told the reservations person that this was our first time staying this hotel we were upgraded to a larger room on the 37th floor.  The room was awesome with floor to ceiling windows, full kitchen, jetted tub, gas fireplace and large bathroom. Great views of the Las Vegas valley The bed was comfortable. The was room was very quiet, very little hallway noise. The sliding doors to the balcony were locked, we were told that they could only be opened for the owner of the suite.  The room was very nice overall but could have been a cleaner (windows and carpeting). We would stay here again.

reviews.title: Wish I could give 0 stars
reviews.text: Here for work first off. I requested this side for a reason, it has a " working kitchen" . So I get here and I need ice, my " ice maker doesn't make Ice" so I called and the guy told me and I quote... " Ice maker works sir, it just takes time ! I said what? It takes time? How long? Been here 5 hours since I checked in all I got is one ice cube? He said yes, but I'll bring you ice! Today I get back from work mind you 24 hours later! No Ice still, called downstairs and Amy said " yeah these are mostly privately owned so there is no ice on the floors" i said so why would they own something if their amenities don't work? She couldn't answer, so I said how long would it take to fix it? She said I don't know, could be 30 min or longer. I said okay, I'll be at work from 8-5! She said no problem I will send an engineer to look at it!" Lol an engineer? It's an ice maker not structural damage to the hotel?! Fine I agreed! I asked for ice, took me 45 min to get, hence I had no problem getting it myself but no place for you to! I had dinner at cafe 6, some " big shot" who walked around claiming he lived here who is a producer or whatever for miss USA had no problem getting services from managers, bartenders and waitresses. Why do other people have such crappy services here specially when they charge you 36 dollars for resort fees yet you park your own car, the wifi sucks and their service sucks? The government needs to do something about these stupid resort fees when casinos already charge enough for rooms!

reviews.title: Awesome place to stay just off the Las Vegas Strip!
reviews.text: Palms Place is a condo/hotel tower next to and connected to The Palms Hotel and Casino.  If you are looking for a very nice place to stay and do not want to be in a casino atmosphere, Palms Place is a great choice.  We stayed in a studio suite which is 615 square feet which is much larger than a traditional hotel room.  If you need larger, they also have one-bedroom suites which are double the size.  The suite was nicely designed and equipped with a kitchenette, sitting area, a long desk and two flat screen TV's.  The bathroom is nice with a floor to ceiling glass shower door and a jacuzzi tub within the shower area.  Great for a romantic getaway!  We were only there overnight so did not take advantage of all the amenities,  There is a good restaurant, pool, fitness center and spa at the tower.  If you need more, take a quick walk to The Palms for more restaurants, gaming and nightlife.  We did enjoy the Ghost Bar at the top of The Palms.  It is a lounge with a nice bar, DJ playing music, dance floor and a great outdoor terrace with amazing view of the Strip.  There is no cover charge if you are staying at Palms Place.Looking forward to another staycation at Palms Place!  By the way, the rates are very reasonable!  I definitely recommend booking a stay there.

reviews.title: Smokey rooms
reviews.text: I was surprised there were not more reviews on this situation.  This hotel is rated about 3-4 star for the rooms.  Contemporary style, clean.  Couch and seating not comfortable, but it looks good I guess.  My room had two sliding doors.  You cannot open them they are locked.  You cannot get fresh air.  My first room really smelled smokey and sour.  Asked to be moved.  Although manager on duty was somewhat rude and not a customer-service type of guy, I got a new room.  At first it smelled clean.  Then by the next day the smoke smell was back.  So I believe it just runs through the HVAC.  The restaurants smell like smoke and it really is not healthy.  They are trying to hermetically seal this hotel, and the end result is unhealthy air quality.  Management will tell you this is a non smoking room.  However there are no signs, in the room indicating no smoking and smokers cannot get on the balcony.  So my guess, almost every room has had a smoker in it at one time and it is very hard to clean that out, especially if it was heavy smoke.Also I could not get the wifi to work.  Called front desk and they told me I needed to call Cox cable.  Really?  I have an iPad, just like everyone else.  So it wasn't my electronics.Casino and restaurants are dated.  Like stepping back into the 1980's.  The Italian restaurant however was very nice, and did not smell smokey.Valet, concierge and bell desk people very nice.  Front desk rude when I asked to be moved because of the air problem.  No one cares.

reviews.title: Birthday trip
reviews.text: I was referenced by a friend to stay here and it was so beautiful.  More than what I thought, I love everything about this hotel. Its very classy, lovely staff, outdoor pool with bar, and the casino were amazing. I'm definitely booking here again.

reviews.title: Birthday trip!
reviews.text: This place rox! There are three building on the property. The penthouse suites are on the west end, just so travelers will know. The penthouse was spacious, modern and clean. There is free valet and VIP parking for guests , several restaurants, ghost bar, pool and private cabanas. It's located across the bridge within walking distance of the strip. I'll always stay here while in Vegas.

reviews.title: Always classy
reviews.text: I have stayed here several times as we visit Vegas. And have never been disappointed with the fabulous rooms. Pleasant, clean and nice design. Comfortable beds and plenty of pillows. Even as we try other locations, we hold them to the level of the Palms.Not far from the strip, shuttle runs often (until 8 PM) to the Forum. And the palms has a iMax theater with attending food court.

reviews.title: Large Suite, Worn Details
reviews.text: The room was very large with a kitchenette, desk, and sitting area, as well as a balcony. It felt comfortable and clean, but some elements of the room felt very worn -- from the stripping on the shower door, to scratches on the desk, and fading on the chairs. I also found the check in / check out process a bit of a pain due to limited staff. I'd possibly stay hear again, but only if it was a great deal. Too many options in Vegas.

reviews.title: Palms Place Views!
reviews.text: Privately owned condos mean there are balconies which most if not all strip casinos do not have. For the particular unit we stayed at, access to the balcony provided breathtaking views of the Las Vegas strip/landscape. Free parking along with next door casino/restaurants were a huge plus!

reviews.title: Not even there yet!!
reviews.text: I booked and paid for this hotel back on January 14,2017 thru Hotels.com for a May 2017 arrival (what a mistake!).  Hotels.com,, when booking the venue states "Free Cancellation until May 1, 2017".  I cancelled this reservation on Feb. 10,2017 but was only refunded 50% of the money I paid (I booked 2 rooms for 7 nights).  When I called Hotels.com they told me that they do not charge for cancellations but cannot do anything about what the hotels policies are. I tried to get my total refund from the hotel but they refused to give me my full refund.  When I asked them to allow us to keep 3 nights (reinstate me so I'm not out $1,056.00) they told me no because the hotel was 100% booked for that week!  What poor customer service!!  If the hotel is completely booked then why not fully reimburse me, they are not losing any money???!!!!  Pretty sad!!  I will never book thru Hotel.com OR book a stay at Palms Place!

reviews.title: Last minute upgrade to Palms Place for concert was worth it
reviews.text: We originally booked a King Superior Room but decided at the last minute to upgrade to the Studio Suite at Palms Place.  The upgrade was worth it.  The room was much bigger and had a decent sized balcony that you could use.  Having a fridge separately from the mini bar was the primary reason for the upgrade, so we could walk to the gas station across the street and buy normal priced water, pop, alcohol, etc. and keep any leftover food from restaurants.  The room has a microwave, dishwasher, small mini fridge separate from the mini bar, and a small stovetop with 2 burners.  Note:  The rooms do not have any plates or silverware, but you can request them from the room service.  The room was a good size, it was nice to spread out and not be cramped.  The shower could have been bigger, but it does have a jacuzzi tub.  However the drain on the tub didn't work the best, and we had to figure out how to plug in the TV ourselves.  The Palms hotel and casino has 10+ restaurants including a food court with fast food.  It is a bit of a jaunt from Palms Place to the casino (~5 minutes), but there are two moving sidewalks.  It is close enough walking distance to the Rio casino (~0.6 miles) and the Gold Coast but you do have to cross a pretty busy and wide street.  There are sidewalks but it's not the most pedestrian-friendly.  It is easy to get an Uber from the downstairs of Palms Place to the strip - you don't have to walk to the casino - for ~$8-$12.  There is also a shuttle you can use from the casino to the strip which runs from 11 a.m. to 8 p.m.  However, it is first come first serve and only seats 14 people.  We took the 11 a.m. shuttle on a Saturday and there was ~20 people in line.  When attending a concert at the Pearl, you have to go out into the casino to smoke.  They scan your ticket out and back in, which works out great when buying a poster or merch from the concert that you don't want to hold the whole time.  You cannot bring drinks from the casino into the venue.  Venue drinks are from $10-$20.     The line at check-in on a Friday afternoon was pretty long.  I know a lot of people have complained about the front desk service here.  Everything worked out fine with our reservation, but the people in front of us asked a lot about the amenities/restaurants at the hotel and the front desk gal was not very knowledgeable.  Overall we were really happy with our choice to stay at Palms Place.

reviews.title: Do not stay here!!!
reviews.text: Worst hote experience in my life. Bookes 2 rooms 4 months in advance and requested for them to be close to each other and to have a view if possible and when I arrived they were 32 floors apart and facing what I assume is some sort of an electrical unit.There was a constant noise inside the room which made it impossible to sleep at all. The hotel staff basically told me that if I don't like it I should buy another room and just did not care at all. I had used the cushions from the sofa and pillows from the bed to try and block out the noise, bus sadly with little difference... The room's were dirty, dusty with most light bulbs burned-out and kitchen units have had wires coming out of them.Never ever will consider staying here again!!!

reviews.title: Dishonest, unhelpful, casually racist staff; filthy rooms.
reviews.text: **Stay away**Better deals and values to be had in this city. Rigid and unhelpful staff who do nothing to rectify issues and seem incapable of thinking, perhaps a failure of management. Trying to report issues was in itself another waste of time, passing the buck over and over. Unsure if they even wrote anything down. Bathroom was filthy, took 36 hours for them to clean. The cheap wood floors creak and seem warped, FYI.

reviews.title: Not a good start!!
reviews.text: Just got here and already the worse experience I could imagine.   My company booked this place for me due to my extended 2 week stay.  Got here early so room wasn't ready. I found out that someone else owns the room I booked so I can't upgrade, ask questions or expect housekeeping during my stay.   Apparently we booked an Airbnb type reservation so this outside brokerage or leasing company is renting it to me.  Little did i know that all of the comforts that were advertised on Expedia may or may not be available to me during my stay.  Already know that my room won't be cleaned for the two weeks I'm in it, unbelievable!!All that being said there is still hope, right? No!!  I am still in the lobby waiting for my room to be ready and watching guest after guest walk up with complaints and walking away disappointed.  I watched the manager have a conversation with an upset guest and showed no care or interest in that guest.  It's a good thing that once the counter is clear all 5 of the hotel employees can sat there, laugh and told jokes while I still wait for my room.  At one point one of the girls behind the counter looked at me and laughed as though she was embarrassed.  I don't blame her.  I can't wait to see what's I store for me when I finally get my room.   I am not a fan.

reviews.title: Horrible service. This place is a ripped off!
reviews.text: Pro: Room is huge, and view is pretty (even though it's mountain view)Con: Room floor is dirty. Furniture was teared and old. Sheet was dirty after you pulled out from the side. (Did they changed the sheets at all!?) The construction workers across the street started working at 6am banging hammers and I can't sleep at all! Front desk service is the worse! They did not even tell you you'll be charged for resort fee when you check in, and they charged you anyway, and didn't even tell you what the resort fee includes! Make some phone calls which didn't even patch through, and got charged for $7.75 per minute! (5 less than a minute call for almost $40!!!) And you didn't even know you'll be charged for it because nobody tells you that or not even a warning message when you make the call! We complain to front desk about the charge, and the guy at front desk mock us and said "everything in Vegas is expensive!" We asked to talk to manager, he just went into some mysterious room behind the counter for about 5 minutes, then came out and said the manager is not here (how big is the room that'll take 5 minutes to see the manager is not there!?) He then gave us the manager's business card and said we can call, but the phone never get pick up, and mailbox is full (that tells you how terrible this hotel is that the compliant message flood the mail box!) I will avoid this place and will never stay at this place ever!

reviews.title: Fabulous place off the strip with free  shuttle bus and uber only costing about $6.
reviews.text: This is by far the best alternative if you want to go amd  visit the  crazy but don't want to be immersed  in it every  day. You have access to all the Palms casino stuff but palms place has its own pool and cafe bar which are lovely and quiet . The option to fix yourself a snack and use the gym means you don't have to do all you can eat buffets and be unhealthy if you don't want to. In can be tough to eat well in vegas unless you are spending a fortune but Walmart is a $10 uber away so you can shop healthily if you wish. The apartment itself really is great  spacious light modern . Great balcony if you book through air Bnb rather than direct with palms. It was our 4th time in Vegas.  2 x Mgm, 1x golden nugget but we would definitely use Palms rather than a strip hotel for any future visits. Enjoy the serenity whilst visiting the crazy.

reviews.title: Upscale hotel at low price!
reviews.text: The good about this hotel is big rooms, great views, comfortable beds, very trendy furniture, full kitchen, we had washer/dryer in our room.  Lots of food options-hooters, McDonald's, 10.99 buffet late at night.  Has IMAX theater and regular movie screens. They have 1 table for 5 dollar blackjack as well as many other tables and slots.  Biggest negative is you have to walk long distance in their sky tube to get to palms hotel from palms place.  They do have those flat escalators that move you though.  Gift shop was not that great.  Overall excellent experience, even though you are not on strip, they have free shuttle to caesars or use Uber.

reviews.title: I'll NEVER stay here again!!!
reviews.text: This business uses tools provided by Tripadvisor (or one of its official Review Collection Partners) to encourage and collect guest reviews, including this one.

reviews.title: Dont go there!
reviews.text: Me and my girlfriend visited palms place 2 weeks ago and parked the car at the palms place parking (with palms place security and cameras), when we came back in the morning to the car the window was broken and many of our stuff from the back seat was taken, according to the security of the hotel there should be a patrol there and security camers of the hotel, apperently nobody saw anything during the night, as this is the official parking of the hotel.not only that we have been told that the risk manager of the hotel gonna contact us in few days to tell us what is going on with the case but nobody from palms place hotel ever contacted us about the case, and the phone number that they provided for us to check status is not working and nobody anwsers.will never back there again, if you come to the hotel i recommend not to park at the hotels parking place since nobody will care about your car.

reviews.title: Ghetto
reviews.text: Appearances can be deceiving.      When I arrived, I thought the place turned into "Section 8 Housing".  All sorts of characters hanging out in valet and lobby.   I felt very uncomfortable for my friends to stay at this property.  The hallway smelled of marijuana and cigarettes.    Maybe it was because of spring break?   My friends weren't comfortable about the atmosphere that this property seems to cater too.   The room was dingy, and the furniture badly worn.

reviews.title: Spring Break Road Trip
reviews.text: The Wifi I paid for was not roadrunner speed and if you want fast internet you have to pay 20 more dollars. I was so disappointed for their spa and pool hours. It should be open at least till 12 a.m. The room quality was excellent! It had tons of closet space for your luggage and the kitchen cabinets great for any late night snacks storage. The bed was very comfortable! The jetted tub was great and is ideal to use after walking on the strip. The hotel also provides free self-parking and free transportation to the strip. I would recommend this hotel to anyone who wants to have a calm and relaxing stay in Vegas.I look forward staying at this hotel again.

reviews.title: Great price no resort fee
reviews.text: Great views of the strip, save your money from daily resort fees and use it for uber, buffets, or visit other hotel pools. Beautiful room with balcony, rainshower overhead faucet in shower & Jacuzzi. Great AC, in room kitchen, lounge couch. Search for deals on Air B & B

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Very nice hotel. Recommend but i just don't like how it's a little far from the strip. Loved how our room had a jacuzzi in the bathroom . Really bringing out the spa in the room. Great get away . But just the distance from everything

reviews.title: Amazing as always!!!
reviews.text: We are frequent visitors to Palms Place, especially for special occasions have stayed in the penthouse with the jacuzzi outside that was magical for us and the 1 bedroom suite which has the tub overlooking the strip was awesome as well. Its always a lovely getaway for my wife and I the front desk is always so courteous and hospitable, the house keeps are very nice and polite overall its always a great experience for us when we stay at Palms Place, which is why we stay so often, its my wife birthday coming up and we are def looking to stay here again!!!

reviews.title: Clean rooms
reviews.text: We were given a studio suite at the 21st floor with a King bed and a queen sofa bed. Room was huge and clean. There is also a jacuzzi/tub which we indulged in. Would definitely come back again and highly recommended.

reviews.title: Visit to the Spa in Palms place, so relaxing
reviews.text: We only visited the hotel to use the spa. There was free tea, coffee, water and soft drinks. The Plunge pool is cold and you are provided with frozen cold hand towels. The Haman was steamy but not hot. Great value for money using a voucher from travel zoo. Very friendly staff. You can use the hotel pool just next to the spa which is lovely. Cafe 6 is also right opposite the spa. Went on a Sunday and was very quiet.

reviews.title: Excellent Room!
reviews.text: We were surprised when we walked into our room on the 17th floor of Palms Place! The room was huge and updated and we had a great strip view,  The employee at the check-in desk was extremely nice and the process was fast.  The room was quiet so we didn't hear the usual hallway noise of people coming and going at all hours of the night.  We were going to a concert at the Pearl Theater so the location was perfect.  There is a inside walkway to the Palms Casino next door.  Great room for a great price!

reviews.title: Room was nice, Casino was dead
reviews.text: Room was beautiful, fireplace did not work and the ice maker was not turned on prior to our arrival. This casino has changed a great deal, it is dead now. Came back from the strip at 1am and there was nobody gambling. There were two food options open at 1am, McDonalds and Cronic Tacos, Cronic tocos was delicious. We also went to the ghost bar on a Friday and there were maybe 30 people in there. The music was good if you like 90's early 2000's hip hop.

reviews.title: Wedding party
reviews.text: We were in town for a wedding during Valentine's week. We arrived to the hotel around noon on a Monday and were able to check in right away. We flew in with the bride and groom and the hotel allowed us to be on the same floor as them. We also received a city view, which was very nice. The front desk was very accommodating and friendly. As for the room, we were pleasantly surprised how large it was. The bathroom was very spacious as was the bedroom area. It was nice to have a refrigerator in the room for snacks and drinks. Our room was pretty clean and the best part was our balcony was unlocked so we could enjoy the city view from there. Many of the other guest in the wedding party didn't get that luxury. The beds were very comfortable and the water pressure in the shower was amazing! Also, we were right next to the elevator which I was concerned about noise volume from outside the door, however, we heard nothing at all. There were only a few negative points. There wasn't a door on for the toilet portion of the bathroom but it wasn't the worst thing that there could be in a hotel room just more inconvenient than anything. And the room could have could use a deep cleaning. It was more of a surface clean than a deep scrub but it wasn't disgusting by any means. All in all, the Palms place was a good place to stay. I was slightly worried with the other reviews but we lucked out.

reviews.title: Best Stay Ever
reviews.text: This is such a great hotel, I'd really recommend it. The rooms are very big and you can get a beautiful view of Vegas at night if you live on one of the higher floors. The service is incredibly fast, the hotel is quiet and clean, and it's definitely one of the best hotels I've ever been to.

reviews.title: One night but beautiful stay
reviews.text: Great huge rooms ( looks more like one bedroom) with full kitchen, amazing view from the balcony. We stayed on 20th floor. Loved the huge bathroom too. Would definitely stay there again. Only down side when we came for check in there was only one receptionist, and it was quite busy, so you had to be on a big line to be assisted which I found strange at the prime evening time. Anyway hotel is nice and not so far away from the strip.

reviews.title: New Years @ The Palms Place
reviews.text: Starting from check in, the room was not ready but we got there around 11am so we knew and understood the rooms were not going to be available being that check in was at 3p. So we waited in the Lobby.  Frank who was checking us in, told me that he will send a text as soon as a room became available.  He never did.  I finally went to the counter and what a surprise a room was available.  He gave me my room key and didn't explain anything to me about the hotel.  He wasn't as nice as the other lady at the counter who I heard gave the customers who were checking in a more thorough run down of their hotel information (like how to get to the rooms, wifi, etc.) She asked if they had any questions.  Frank wasn't the friendliest and just gave me my room key and asked for the next guest.  Other than my initial experience, my room was nice.  Easy access to the Palms clubs and the shuttle is great to go to the strip.  Drops you off at Ceasars Palace.  There is also a food court in-between the palms place and the palms.  I like this hotel would definitely stay here again.  Just need to work on friendlier staff or maybe he was just one bad apple.

reviews.title: Super suite
reviews.text: Second time at Palms place we chose to get the  ungrade for a suite. Jacuzzi in the room, large living room 4 seats side kitchenette table, large fridge, oven, dishwasher, washer/dryer. One large bathroom and a second small one. Lots of spaces for your clothes. What a view of the strip from the 52th floor.....The hotel is of the strip but very closes by car or bus.In the Palm casino you can find anyting from food to théâtre. Good service, smile and your in good hand.

reviews.title: Nice trip with my daughter and visit with Family in Town
reviews.text: The hotel is far off of the strip, but provides shuttle service from morning until about 8pm to Caesar's Forum. Valet Parking is free and they were easy and fast (tips only). The rate was good, room spacious and clean and the check in desk accommodated my request for a lower floor room. We were in the Ivory Tower. Downside of this is that the smoke smell others noted from the Casino does seem to make it to the room. Also, the area outside of our room smelled heavily of weed for the last couple of days of our stay. My understanding is that weed is legal, but smoking in hotels is not. Gross, Stinky weed, next time pay more.  We used the Spa facilities (part of a Travelzoo deal) for a full day and really enjoyed them. Also the onsite Salon is really nice. The Spa is quite a distance from the Ivory tower, but it was our workout for the day. Breakfast was included in the room rate at the buffet and it was pretty standard LV stuff. All of the service personal we encountered were terrific. Couple of negs: Shower was backing up, had to call maint at 1030pm. They did come though. No towels or service of the room on a couple of days. Overall good value and nice people.

reviews.title: Worst Customer Service
reviews.text: I had an absolutely terrible experience during our recent stay with the front desk.  The gentleman I dealt with had no interest in helping us resolve our situation.  We requested a new mattress for the pull out bed after discovering how incredibly filthy it was in addition to being completely saggy.  It's a pull out bed, so we knew it wasn't going to be perfect.  When housekeeping tried to come and fluff the mattress, they discovered the absolute filthy condition of the mattress and called for a new one immediately.  The front desk did nothing to help us.  Thanks to housekeeping, particularly, John, the problem was fixed.  The rest of the unit was was just as unkept.  I would never recommend staying here.

reviews.title: I guess we paid for what we get!
reviews.text: This hotel is about 2 miles from Bellagio, which is not that far. It offers great view and reasonable pricing. I booked three rooms for a one night stay. However, 2 of 3 rooms has drainage problems. RM10115 and 10117. The sink in these two room takes hours to drain after wash hands. There were hair in the shower, some black spots in the shower caulking and the handle on the bathroom doors are rusted.

reviews.title: Do Your Research
reviews.text: I've read some terrible one or two star reviews (I focus on reading them as they are much more critical and specific about potential issues you may experience) about Palms Place and it has become obvious that if you do your research ahead of time, you can limit most of the likelihood of having a negative experience. Pay attention to "who" owns and manages the suite you plan on booking because there is a mixture of privately held properties along side of the Palms Place rooms. You can see examples in the Trip Advisor reviews of people who got stuck with suites that hadn't been renovated or refreshed in years vs. those who got to experience the wonderful luxury of a newly appointed property. I booked my suite through Air BnB for an excellent 50th floor newly renovated privately owned property with a remarkable view of the Strip. In addition, I was also able to access my balcony through the working sliding glass door whereas the rooms operated by Palms Place have balconies with locked doors due to liability issues. My decision to make a reservation was based on the numerous and unanimous five star ratings in the Air BnB feedback section for this suite and the great reviews were well-deserved. Also, since it was privately owned, we didn't have to pay a ridiculous resort fee. Do your homework and you won't be disappointed.

reviews.title: Used AirBnB, AWESOME!
reviews.text: Got a corner suite for 2 nights during our stay in Vegas for the Shot Show. Was pleasantly surprised with everything about this place: the parking area, check in, and the room itself. Although it was managed by an owner it was nice and we were happy with our choice. We had another couple stay with us and it was nice having 2 bathrooms, a HUGE master bathroom and a great view. Would certainly stay here again.

reviews.title: Outstnanding stay
reviews.text: We went to the Rick Astley concert.  First, the Pearl Theater was very nice, and we had awesome seats.  Not a bad seat in the house, what a wonderful place to watch a concert.  Second, the Palms Place Suite was just outstanding.  We had a wonderful suite room with a window looking out onto the Strip of Las Vegas.  The shower and bath facility was spacious, and dual shower heads.  The staff was extremely friendly in checking us in.  The room was immaculate.  The elevators were fast.  The buffet was affordable and also well stocked.  I would gladly stay at this hotel again, it was affordable and had everything we needed.  You do have to pay for wi-fi access, unfortunately.

reviews.title: Clean and comfortable
reviews.text: The hotel lobby, rooms, and casino area were all very clean and enjoyable. The room was bigger than any two people needed but it was comfortable and relaxing. This is the first hotel room I've wanted to stay in. The shower and jacuzzi combo was luxurious and made for an enjoyable stay!

reviews.title: BEST STAY EVER!
reviews.text: I stayed at the Palms Place Hotel and SPA from January 10th through 14th. I was there to celebrate my 50th birthday. Truly, I have never been in a better hotel complex EVER in Vegas. I've literally been going to Vegas since I was 10 years old. So, I've stayed everywhere.  Both concierge ladies: Christine Smith and Paige Davis were STELLAR.  Frank, the gentleman that checked me in and put me on the 50th floor was SUPERB! And, Ricky and Derrick in the SPA were EXCELLENT!  I found a new home for my Vegas stays.  I'll be returning in late February!

reviews.title: The best!
reviews.text: Our stay usually costs $39 a night. We always stay in the same suite of available. The valets are amazing and when we tipped. $20 our car was alway out front! Now when we visit the actually remember us we appreciate that. We will always stay here for the hospitality, value, and we can see the strip from our room. The food is great and the casino doesn't disappoint. We simply love The Palms Place...not to be confused with the original Palms Hotel nextdoor!

reviews.title: Just fabulous
reviews.text: It may be off the strip but I was impressed with the apartment and high specification  of it, having just been in New York where the rooms are tiny I was happy to have some space. The bathroom was nothing short of fabulous with a large jacuzzi  bath that could easily fit two, to the marble throughout, beautiful.
