In total there were 3 tvs, a fully stocked kitchen with self filling ice machine, I need one of these and a balcony with great views.The pool area was open even though the  weather wasn't  great this had another hot jacuzzi & would be a great summer hang out with cabanas to  hire.To get to the apartments there is a walk through the casino & so called Sky ride which is a flat moving walk way followed by a lift but after all the over indulgence we needed the exercise. The only down side is how far it is from the strip but the hotel runs a shuttle service from 11am til 8pm this takes you to the Forum shopping centre at Caesars Palce, I personally think it should run later but taxis are available all the time.A tip for the 1st shuttle is to arrive early as when it's full you will need to wait until the next one 30 minutes later.

reviews.title: Concierge
reviews.text: Prior to our arrival in Las Vegas, Christine- one of the Palms Place concierge- who helped with many of the details of the trip was total rockstar!! The customer service she provided  was over the top. Her attention to details and follow up was much appreciated and rarely realized in the travel business I believe. She  played a huge role in making this trip a home run for both myself and my wife. No question- the reason I would stay at Palms Place in the future.

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: Fabulous rooms, stayed in a studio suite which was big and roomy with the most comfortable bed I've ever slept in! Was staying over new year so didn't want to stay on the strip, but it's easy to walk/get bus or the free shuttle bus to the strip. the peace of palms place was far enough away from the crowds and parties at the palms but only a 2 minute stagger home. Staff are lovely and very helpful too. Absolutely perfect. Will be booking again.

reviews.title: Great views of The Strip, laid back
reviews.text: Stayed at the Palms Place and had an amazing stay. Unlike the Strip casinos, it was never overrun with people and it was a very chill place to hang out when we were looking for a less crowded option. Of course we did all the normal Las Vegas attractions, but this was our 6th trip to Vegas in 8 years and it was time to be off strip! The pools are great and the casino is very clean. The rooms are phenomenal and the view of the strip was nothing short of amazing from our room. The furnishings are perfect and very up to date. The bathroom was huge and the shower was bigger than the one in my house! Our room had lots of closet and drawer space, a kitchenette,  king size bed and a huge couch. There were no chairs on the balcony but we just pulled the chairs out there at night and watched the Strip and drank beer! Very relaxing! The Palms has a shuttle to the Strip every day and while it always sucks to have to adjust your schedule to get picked up, it was worth it to be able to walk around, have a few drinks, gamble, and then have a free ride back to your hotel! Overall a great place to stay!

reviews.title: Mixed bag
reviews.text: Stayed at Palms Place during a recent work meeting. Overall thoughts:1. Room was extremely comfortable for sleeping, bathing and relaxing. It lacked proper wifi capabilities to support business a/v equipment. There is no real "workstation" or desk for getting work done and the lighting is not supportive. Bathroom was very comfortable but I think women would have difficulty getting ready as lighting wasn't great.2. Casino amenities are average. Alize was hit and miss with the items I tried.  Service was excellent.  Hooters was an absolute joke. I tried to get a simple chicken sandwich on a quick break from meetings. Sat at the bar for 20 minutes before being greeted. At that point, it was too late. Requested pickup on 3 items for dry cleaning, didn't get them back in time to actually wear to events they were needed for. Still was charged 34.50.3. I enjoy that they offer low limit tables. I'm not much of a gambler and it allowed me to try different games without feeling I was tossing money away.  4. The average guest here was older than other places I visited on my trip. Both pros and cons to that personally.5. Do not walk to/from the strip to the Palms. It's a 30 minute walk through areas that I wouldn't feel comfortable walking alone (and I'm a pretty big guy)Overall, I would stay here again gladly but with tempered expectations. I think this is easily a 4* establishment if I hadn't had some of the simple issues I expereinced.

reviews.title: Family Friendly
reviews.text: My family and I stayed on the 36th floor for 2 nights here. We had a corner suite with double balcony views. The main bathroom is luxurious. It was covered in marble with 3 head showers, double vanity and a separate room for the toilet, it was amazing! However the TV in the bathroom didn't work. Another issue was one of the down lights had fallen through and my partner had to push the bulb back in.The kitchen was fantastic, the lounge room had full views of Las Vegas that covered the north and south side. Our children ages 5 & 6 felt very comfortable in this room.The staff were very friendly and there was easy access to the casino. We would definitely come back here again.

reviews.title: Greatly Satisfied!
reviews.text: Arriving to Las Vegas was a birthday surprise, as well as a 2 night stay at the Palms Place Hotel! We were upgraded to the 19th floor and our King Studio Suite had an incredible view of the Las Vegas Strip! The room and bed was comfortable, and the jets in the large bathtub, and waterfall shower were icing on the cake!My partner and I wanted to go see several shows while we were in town. We had already seen two, with Zumanity being one of them. We really wanted to see 'Love' but the theater is dark on Tuesday's and Wednesday's.  We wanted to see another popular Cirque du Soleil show but needed assistance on which one, sp we decided to consult with the concierge team on the first floor of the hotel. Paige and Christine greeted us both (separately), and were incredibly helpful. They were very knowledgeable about the shows being offered, the availability, and assisted us with the reservations, and getting us 4th row seats to see Cirque du Soleil's  'La Reve' performed in the round with an aqua stage! My partner and I both have backgrounds of working within the hotel and hospitality industry, and it was clear that their conversations and demeanor with us came from the heart. We felt that they genuinely wanted us to experience Las Vegas as much as possible, and to make our trip memorable. We just wanted to reach out to these two women to let them know that they are doing an incredible job! and that we both left extremely satisfied with the services they provided for us! The show was INCREDIBLE! Thanks again!Troy and Ewen

reviews.title: Great rooms let down by service
reviews.text: The Palms Place is a great place to stay. I like that you enter via a separate entrance and so can avoid the Casino giving you a little sanctuary from the craziness. My suite was really nicely decorated with a large separate lounge/kitchen area including large fridge, oven and washer/dryer. The bathroom is large with an overlay elaborate 3 head shower system. My minor issues with the suite are as follows:-1) Having a full kitchen is great but without even a small selection of plates and utensils completely useless. 2) The lounge area is very dark with only dim table lamps making it hard to work in. 3) The chairs at the bench were very poor condition and heavily worn making them very uncomfortable. It's the service that lets the place down. I reported two issues (a broken handle and lamp) and while acknowledged neither was resolved during my week long stay. The concierge service is not well staffed and just to store some cases was a bit of a wait. Having said that I would definitely stay here  again. The location makes it easy to get taxis to different parts of the strip without hitting the traffic you get if you stay on the strip itself.

reviews.title: Beautiful room
reviews.text: We visited in between Christmas and New Year's.  The lobby is a little dark and it was a cold walk from the parking lot to the front door, but the room was amazing. Got a suite with one and a half bathrooms, a kitchen and a fireplace. It was a wonderful stay and the staff was helpful and friendly. This is a condo tower with units for sale but it didn't change our stay. It did feel more like an apartment than a hotel but that's a good thing.

reviews.title: Needs to update the WiFi policy
reviews.text: The room was pretty clean and decent.  I am not sure if its because the room didn't get used more frequently.  The bath room was a bit musky.  I love the fact, you are less then 5 minute from the car to your room.  Their WiFi policy needs to be updated to 2017 standards.  You can't be charging me $30 for resort fees and limit my WiFi usage to 1 device.  FYI Palms, no one plugs a cable into the laptop to get WiFI anymore!  Ironically, in January I did end up needing the heater.  The heater never worked right, it was hot or cold.  I called the maintenance to come down.  He changed the air filter and got it going for a bit.  But, the thing never really worked properly.

reviews.title: "You should be honored to have the privilege of staying in our hotel."
reviews.text: This is my third stay at the Palms in general (first at Place) and I wanted so much for this to be better than the last two stays. I went into it with hope. In the end, I was left extremely disappointed. First, upon arrival, the room I was given literally smelled like a bathroom, as if someone didn't properly clean the room. The second room was fine initially, and then I unpacked and found some serious issues. The knobs on the sink fell off. The knobs in the shower fell off. Not with force, just light use. Then, the sink - had a twisted knob that only emitted hot water. The dishwasher was also malfunctioning. I contacted executives at the hotel over email who did not fix the problem until about 27 hours after my first email. This, like many Vegas hotels, do not emit any true service, it's more about making the customer feel they should be the ones honored to be in their presence, in their hotel. I truly will never stay at the Palms again. Absolutely not.

reviews.title: Wedding Trip
reviews.text: I have lost the energy to write a detailed review as when i think about it, it upsets me.I would warn everyone off this hotel, especially if you are a regular 4/5* hotelguest as this hotels staff and customer services are far from 4* they lack any compassion, warmth or people skills.The rooms are nice IF you get the room you pay for if they haven't double booked you and then tried to put you in a worse room! Other than that there is nothing good that comes from staying here. Ruined our wedding trip by dampening our arrival and ghostbar killed the wedding day vibes.I have been to holiday inns better than this.Never again.I saw bad reviews before we arrived but hoped the good ones would out weigh it, hoping they would learn from them but they haven'tWhat you read in the other bad reviews is true.Don't risk it, spend the extra and go elsewhere

reviews.title: Palms Place for New Years
reviews.text: We had a trip planned for the New Years weekend in Vegas.  We thought that we would be staying 3 nights at Palms Place. We were excited as the rooms looked very nice! The day before we arrived to check in, we made a phone call to Palms Place to confirm our reservations. Were told that due to the method that we had booked (though a travel club) that our reservation had been moved to Westgate. The person on the phone said that Palms Place was overbooked (which I don't really believe). Anyhow... the reason for this review is Perla. When we arrived at the front desk to check in, she admitted, that yes, there was an issue with our reservation. We said that we really didn't want to stay at the Westgate, we had stayed there before and it was AWEFUL. She worked away on the computer for a few minutes, went into a back room and came back and said that we wouldn't have to go there. We would be able to stay at the Palms Casino for one night, and  then to Palms Place for 2 nights. We weren't thrilled about having to change rooms, but in our opinion it was better than the Westgate. Perla told us that for our inconvenience she would take care of us. We were given a 35th floor strip view room at the Palms Casino for the first night. We could see off toward Mandalay Bay and the Luxor. We were thrilled! Now here is  where she really took care of us. When we switched room, we were put on the 30th floor. We walked into the room (which was awesome itself) and our jaw dropped at the view. Perla was able to get us into a room with the best view in Vegas....mind you... for New Years Eve. We could see from the Stratosphere all the way to Mandalay Bay. We were able to sit in front our our floor to ceiling windows with a glass of wine and watch the firework on the strip. A few bumps in the road, but thanks to Perla, we were able to make the most of it and have a great time in Vegas! Thanks!

reviews.title: The Palms in Vegas
reviews.text: The Palms is off-strip on Flamingo Road, just down the street from the Rio Hotel & Casino.   The view from the roof-top bar is awesome.  The accommodations are very modern and roomy, we had a corner room and was very happy with it.   The Pool area is very modern and somewhat pricey if you want a cabana or pool couch, which looked very comfortable.  The service they provide is generally "bottle service", so the cost to obtain a cabana or pool couch includes the bottle service, which we did not take advantage because there was only the two of us.  We did see quite a "party groups" taking advantage of the service, which makes more sense on an economic scale.  The Casino was good, all the basic games and tables.  Restaurants were also good.

reviews.title: グランドサークルツアーの前泊に
reviews.text: タイトル通り、前泊に使いました。なのでカジノなども必要なし。ストリップから離れているため安く宿泊することができました。この値段でこの価格？？というくらいに綺麗で広い室内。キングサイズベッドにキッチン、大きな冷蔵庫、バスタブはジェットバス付き！しかしWi-Fiは別料金だったので繋ぎませんでした。ストリップからはUberを利用し10分程。ツアーもベラージオでピックアップだったので程よく近くてよかったです。静かで夜景が綺麗な部屋だったので、次回はのんびり過ごしたいです。Great hotel!Bit far from strip butreasonable and clean and gorgeous.I liked it.

reviews.title: It was worth the upgrade
reviews.text: My friend and I were in vegas for New years and I had booked the a room in the palms casino.  When we arrived we were offered an upgrade for 100 a night, we decided to do it.  The room in the palms place is the most amazing room I've stayed in. We were on the 22nd floor had 180 degree view of the mountains and the city. Large sliding glass doors and floor to ceiling windows,  the room was 1200 square feet with two bathrooms a double sided fireplace and stainless steel appliances.  Truly amazing.  Since we were off the strip we utilized uber for the 10 min ride to the strip. Uber was very fast, and had specific locations where they are allowed to pick up. We celebrated new years eve at Moon night club which was very convenient party location.... no driving involved. I'd recommend staying here at least once!

reviews.title: Good value
reviews.text: Stayed in lots of hotels on the strip.  And often stay in large multi room suites.The palms place suites are great value for money. I was a little concerned about the location using uber was great for getting around between the hotels back on the stripThere are a few minor shortcomings.The lighting in the rooms is all separate lamps and even with them all on it is dark.Great for a romantic evening awful for working.The service from the staff isn't upto Aria or Wynn ect.I would return as the suites are good value for money

reviews.title: Excellent Time
reviews.text: Loved this hotel so much! Great room, great bed, wifi internet, room service was amazing. Our room was provided with a full kitchen, big bathroom, king size bed and a sitting area. Although only downfall is the hotel is not right on the strip, however, the hotel has a free shuttle that takes you to Caesars Palace, or ubers are readily available. Staff was very friendly, and did excellent job at cleaning the room daily. The pool was a great place to relax and drink, I found not as crowded as compared to hotel pools on the strip. Overall, I would definitely stay at this hotel again!

reviews.title: Roof Top Bar
reviews.text: It's a must, the roof top bar simply has the best views of Vegas....great cocktails too :) We always make a point of going here at least once regardless of where we are staying in VegasAs is common in the USA make sure you have ID, I'm a 46 year old Brit, not used to getting asked my age in a pub and still got ID'd, very complimentary, but a tad annoying if you leave your ID at your Hotel

reviews.title: Good off strip hotel
reviews.text: I have nothing bad to say about this hotel.  The price is great, the rooms are large.  We heard that new management was taking over the hotel at the time we were there but there was no evidence of it.  I was there for business and it worked out great for me and minus the hassle of being on the strip.

reviews.title: Worst service in Vegas
reviews.text: Before booking we didn't know that this place has rooms which are owned by someone else and are rented out. This should not be a problem generally, but when we entered the room, one of the cupboard was locked because owner's stuff was inside it - Kind of weird!We called hotel for an early check-in as we were already in vegas 3 hrs early then planned, and they just plainly refused - bad first impression!During our stay we noticed that furniture in room was kind of old and worn out like the leather on chairs was torn and had marks. Bathroom sink was clogged every time I washed my hands. Biggest bummer was their Valet. Their valet was always full, even if we were staying with them. Their casino is separate from this property, still the valet was always full. First day we got valet, we took our car in evening and when we came back in night, they refused to park our car.Hence, not a good experience altogether.

reviews.title: Pre-owned rooms, rented out as normal hotel rooms!
reviews.text: Here are few of the bad things and experiences we had with Palm place hotel stay:- Pre-owned rooms rented as hotel rooms! - These are pre-owned rooms not normal hotel rooms, few closets were closed as the owner had kept their stuff in there.- Hotel didn't recognized our VIP+ status and didn't gave us any features.- Valet was always full and we had to park our car daily in self parking.- Bathroom sink was blocked!- Bathtub dirty with hair lying in it.- Room was not serviced, had to call!- Everyone day hotel staff were trying to get into our room to check if we had used paid refreshments in the room.They rang bell twice and then just opened the door, while I was trying to come to open the door- The chairs in the room were ripped off at many places.- Dirty closed balcony obstruct the view outside- Shower only gave out hot water, very bad experience in taking shower there- Hotel was pretty far off from the strip with nothing much to do around it.And few of the good things!- Room service was quick and good when asked! We asked them for plates and towels and room service!- Hotel room was good size.- Bathtub was nice and deep if only it was clean as well.

reviews.title: New Year's Eve Rooms Going to the Highest Bidder!
reviews.text: As frequent visitors of the two Palms properties, my wife and I had yet to spend a New Year's Eve in Las Vegas (our wedding anniversary by the way) and so we looked forward to our reservations at each of the properties starting last week. We were scheduled for a two night stay at the Palms Casino followed by a three night stay at Palms Place. Having stayed at both properties in the past, we are fully aware of the amenities that rooms at each location have and we consider Palms Place rooms to be superior to those at the regular Palms location considering that Palms Place studios come equipped with three TVs, a bathtub in addition to a shower, and a kitchen.  Our initial two night stay at the Palms Casino was uneventful and concluded with no issues. We checked out and looked forward to beginning our stay at Palms Place. However, as we attempted to check in, we were informed by the Assistant Manager, Nathan Hammett, that the hotel was sold out and our reservation and rate could not be honored. How is this even possible?? It's not like we booked the room at the last minute. We had reserved and prepaid our entire stay back in September after finding a great rate through our credit card provider. Apparently, Palms Place decided as it got closer to New Year's Eve that it could get a much higher rate for our room than what we paid and gave it away to someone else. Unbelievable!! Since we already paid in full, Nathan gave us two options: a full refund or go back to the Palms with a resort fee credit. We found both of these options unacceptable as they should never have given away our room in the first place. If the reservation and rate could not be honored, why we were not informed in advance, or at the very least, during our initial two night stay at the Palms? A full refund would have left us scrambling to book at another property at the last minute in a city where price gouging for New Year's Eve seems to be the norm. Going back to the Palms would mean that we would be paying for a lesser quality room than what we intended to stay in. Not to say that Palms Casino rooms are bad, because they are not, but comparing them to Palms Place rooms is like apples and oranges. After finding Nathan's solutions unsatisfactory, he directed us to speak with his manager, Joe D'Amico, at the Palms Casino. We went back over there to speak with him but apparently he was unavailable. We instead spoke with a Front Desk Representative named Trevor who informed us of the Palms ridiculous policy of overbooking hotel rooms (there was a specific name he gave it which is escaping me at this time). First of all, why would you need to overbook rooms during New Year's Eve which is historically a time of high demand for Las Vegas? Second, why should we be victims of this policy when we have prepaid the entire stay, not just the standard first night's room and tax? Trevor was unable to do anything for us so he contacted his manager, Joshua Boren, to come out to speak with us. Prior to speaking with Joshua, my wife and I were frustrated with the situation. After speaking with him however, and having some extra time to think it over, my wife and I have decided not to return to the Palms properties ever again.Joshua was especially smug and condescending while speaking to us and offered to relocate us to the Westin if we were unwilling to stay at the Palms. For those who have not stayed at the Westin (we have), that is a step down from the Palms just as Palms is step down from Palms Place. He finally decided to offer a one-time $25 food and beverage credit for our troubles as he believed we should have been satisfied with Nathan's offer of the resort fee credit. For a couple that has dined at N9ne Steakhouse and planned on having an anniversary dinner at Nove Italiano, that was like a slap in the face. During this time, Joshua and Trevor were both playing up the idea that the room we would be getting at Palms was a corner "suite", when in reality, it is just a slightly larger Premier room. We have stayed in the Palms Ivory Suite before so we know the difference between a suite and a regular room. With no other feasible options for us, we ended up staying at the Palms. However, we canceled our planned anniversary dinner at Nove Italiano and decided not to give the Palms properties any more of our money during our stay. My wife and I have stayed at Palms properties several times over the years, we've dined at all of their establishments, gambled at their tables, and spent pool days inside their cabanas. However, the lack of customer service we received and failure to admit any wrongdoing on their part with not even so much as an "I'm sorry" showed how much they value us and our previous loyalty to them. We will be back in Vegas in February at another property and never look back on these establishments.

reviews.title: Worst Hotel Experience Ever
reviews.text: My husband and I arrived in Las Vegas two days ago and started our stay at The Palms Hotel. Since New Years Eve is our Anniversary we wanted a nicer room so we had reservations from today 12/30 to 1/2. However upon checking into Palms Place we were told that the hotel had over booked and we were forced to either stay at The Palms or they would credit us a full refund. Who does that to people on the busiest weekend of the year?? We had already checked out of our other room, paid for bell service only to get thrown back to our original location. Nathan Hammett the gentleman who assisted us was only willing to offer us a credit for the resort fee, which in my opinion is unacceptable seeing as how the room we booked was a suite with a tub, refrigerator, and full kitchen. We were then told if we were not satisfied to speak with the Manager Mr. D'Amico. We went to speak with him however he never bothered to even speak with us. Instead, we first dealt with Trevor who told us that he could give us our original room at no cost. Honestly where is the customer service? This is a room that is no where near what we had and this character is trying to act as if we won the lottery! Get real! Then he calls out his Manager Joshua Boren who makes it seem as there had been no breach in service and we are getting a remarkable stay in our same room. When we are still not content with the lack of effort on their part, or the fact that they could have avoided this situation by letting us know when we first arrived or prior to checking he states we can either leave with a refund, stay and receive a $25 food/drink credit or we can relocate to the the Westin. With no other feasible options we had to stay at The Palms losing out on our suite. This is the second time we have had a problem with these properties in four months and I honestly recommend staying somewhere else in the future. The hotels I once loved are now the two worst hotels in Vegas due to their poor service.

reviews.title: Amazing Experience
reviews.text: We recently stayed at the Palms Place Hotel for 2 weeks.  I must say I was hesitant about staying here after staying at another hotel/condo for many years while  working the NFR for 2 weeks.  Some of our young employees got a great deal at the Palms Place so we decided to give it a try.  The rooms were beautiful and so comfortable. The beds were amazing.  Big, beautiful bathroom.  Awesome tub.  Very romantic.The staff at the hotel made us feel like we lived there.  The bartenders, valet guys, and bellman were great.  The concierge Christine Smith helped my husband get 40+tickets to a show and then found a great club to hold a company party, all last minute.  She was so helpful.  I can't rave enough about this hotel.  We felt like we were leaving home when we left.  We will be back.

reviews.title: Quiet, basic, dated and not 4 star accommodations
reviews.text: This was just a quick overnight stop for me.  I wanted a modern, clean, quiet hotel that was away from all the fuss of the strip.  The front desk clerk that checked me in wasn't very friendly and wasn't very helpful when I asked about self-parking.  My hotel room was a "premium room" in the ivory tower.  Nothing premium about it.  The tv wouldn't turn on, I think the remote needed batteries.  I asked for a non-smoking room, however someone was smoking in the hallway (maybe that's just Vegas), the smell carried into my room.   My room was cheap, so can't complain much  about the price, but I wouldn't stay here again if I had to pay a higher rate.

reviews.title: Great Hotel For Las Vegas
reviews.text: Don't be afraid of some comments you find on the internet, it's not that far from the strip, of course you'll need a taxi or can take the shuttle, but hey, the hotel is grate. It's the fifth time we stay at this place, studio suite and we really enjoy it. We had the strip view and get to see all lights at night from the balcony. There is a cinema inside the complex, food court, casino, buffette and even the largest hooters restaurant. So you have many amenities in here.

reviews.title: NEVER STAY HERE**********
reviews.text: One night with my gf at Vegas.  We stayed in room 303, 26th floor on 12/28/2016.  First of all, my gf got scared by a COCKROACH.  Then, we discovered they DIDN'T CHANGE BED SHEET!  There were other ppl's hairs when we uncovered the comforter and it's dirty.  We called front desk for changing our bed sheet, and we waited for nearly an hour for house keeping to change our bed sheet.  First front desk staff even said there's nothing she can do with it, have just have to wait. My gf and I were extremely tried (we drove a long way.)  I've to stay even some cheap hotel we stayed few days before is better than this place.  We slept at 1:45AM that night.  Thank you Palms Place Hotel and Spa by giving us this nightmare-like night.

reviews.title: My AirBNB Palms Place Experience
reviews.text: We booked this Suite through AirBNB for 11 nights. Our AirBNB service was phenomenal our hosts were attentive. Unfortunately we cannot say the same for the Palms Place staff at all! In fact we cannot believe that the staff of the actual hotel was so poor. We arrived at 11 am on a flight from New York, we were told at check-in the room was not ready but they would call when it was (which was fine with us we expected that) , our dates of stay was wrong and the front desk check in girl was rude and told me it is what it is since i booked through airbnb , i contacted my host who immediately contacted the palms and it was corrected. But why should i receive rude or poor quality service because i booked through airbnb? shouldn't the Palms Hotel staff supply me with the same quality of service as any other guest, maybe it would incline me to book directly through the hotel. But nonetheless this was just the beginning. 3:00 PM came and STILL NO CALL from the Palms. at 3:20 we came to the front desk and the room was not ready the front desk girl said it's not ready and i said the rooms are guaranteed at 3pm, she walks to the back and comes out with keys. The suite was nice, the balcony view is beautiful , the jacuzzi tub is nice however it is has an old style stopper that got stuck on first use and we called 3 times for someone to come and help us let the water out , i contacted my host and even after he called we waited an additional hour to the two we had already been waiting to get someone up there!! ridiculous there was no room service menu in the suite and after calling twice to get one , the menu was average and basic and we ordered twice and nothing served was worth the time . When traveling i set limits and alerts on my cards to help prevent theft and from hotels from over authorizing charges, so at 6:30 am my creditor called me to alert me that the Palms Place Front desk had attempted to authorize a charge and they were calling to confirm it was valid. I wen to the front desk to inquire about the attempted charge seeing as they were already holding incidentals that were sufficient to cover the stay and a male front desk agent , Frank i believe after i walked up to him told me he couldn't help me and kindve shooed me over to another front desk girl who was talking to a coworker not even paying attention . She tells me that she doesn't know what the charge is for and said well we should find out why my card is being ran telling me you don't know is not sufficient. out of irritation i paid the balance on the room then and there. but really? you don't know why you're authorizing someone's card? disgusting and unacceptable! i will never stay there again!

reviews.title: Should have its own postcode is so big.
reviews.text: Classed as 2 hotels (spa or casino)but joined together by a massive area in between with the casino floor, shops, restaurants & even a full sized cinema. We opted to stay in spa side but next time (and I would stay here again) I would stay in casino side. Just as less of a walk to the pool area we liked best (there is 2 but spa one bit small & quiet, depends what looking for) We upgraded room to something could only describe as a massive apartment. Was beautiful with 2 bathrooms, kitchen, living room with touch button log fire & slipper jacuzzi bath. Was trendy elegant & impressive. Bit of a treck to get to Pool area, reception or even ground floor but can't have it all I guess. Had a really nice meal in Italian restaurant & was a bit special. Somewhere to definitely impress your dinner partner or special occasion. Wasn't even too expensive considering. Then on flip side you could eat in the food court by cinema if just want a quick bite in hotel. Hotel has it all here which was good considering a little off the strip & a trip to other big hotels. If want a place where can escape Vegas in luxury without breaking the bank then this is hotel for you.

reviews.title: Good Location off the strip
reviews.text: The rooms are nice, but they don't tell you that the ice machines do not work. Our regular refrigerator did not work either so they had a little bar refrigerator in the room. Very close to the strip and the freeway. Love the location. There is a walking escalator into the Palms Casino. It is about a 5 minute walk. The 24/7 cafe is awful! Service is terrible. They don't get the order correct. Stay away if you can.Also, if you are not out of your room by 12:00 noon, housekeeping will leave a card saying you missed service that day. Really? This is Las Vegas.If you want dishes, silverware or plates in the room, you have to get them from room service. Also, you have to get ice from room service which we weren't told until the day we checked out.Head's up. They do take a 1.5% deposit and put it on your CC when you check in. We were never told about this and it has taken me over a week to get it resolved. I thought someone hacked our credit card. Caused us lots of issues as we weren't prepared for it. It takes 7 days after you check out to get it back. I thought I would stay here again, but after that fiasco with the credit card, probably won't. Figure it is close to another $1,000 they are tying up of your money. We only carry 1 credit card on vacation. Spent the whole morning we were leaving trying to figure this mess out. Make sure you ask questions before you book here. They are not upfront about what they do. They should tell you when you book the room. They just say they are taking one nights deposit. Not True!

reviews.title: Convenient hotel off the strip
reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay tremendously at this hotel. First of all, check-in was a breeze, real quick and easy. Next, was pleasantly surprised by how spacious and modern the room is. I stayed at room 12-320. Roomy bathroom and nice kitchenette which you can use if you choose to prepare your own meals. However, it will not be necessary as there are many reasonable eating options at Palms Casino and near the hotel. Most tour companies have free pick up for Palms Place so not to worry about booking your day tours too. There are 2 TVs, one in front of the bed and one just beside which is directly in front of the couch area. Not really necessary but a nice touch nonetheless. Parking is convenient and there are so many lots to choose from. Check-out was really quick and hassle-free. Highly recommend staying in this hotel though I understand not all rooms are of the same standard.

reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.text: While visiting Las Vegas, I always stay at Palms PLACE or Vdara as these properties give you quick access to your room without having to walk through a casino.  As  I am there for a lot of business trips and the last thing I would like to do is spend a ton of time walking through a casino. The beds are super comfy and the bath tub is unbelievable no matter what room you are in. I would especially like to thank Mohammad at the front desk as he goes above and beyond what defines hospitality. Every time I have a request or an accommodation he always make sure to follow up with the highest standards of customer service.

reviews.title: Rude staff bad wifi
reviews.text: Room was nice and big with a nice view, but you can only connect 1 device at a time to free wifi, when i went to ask about this at reception i was told... it is what it is..  not the answer i was looking for. We stayed at the 4 star palms the year before  with lovely  staff and multiple  wifi,  so didn't expect  this when we upgrade to the 5 star suites. Also had to call room service 3 times to get cutlery as there was coffee etc in room but no cups or spoons??Also when you have a couple  staying,  there is only  1 bathrobe?  Think i will stick to the 4 star palms in future  or a different  hotel.We also had friends with us who also  booked in the same hotel and they had the same problem  with cutlery etc and also bad rips in the furniture. After all this they still charge you a ridiculous  price of $33.54 per night resort fee, we stayed 6 nights so had a bill of just over $200  on top of what we paid for the room.

reviews.title: Rude staff and bad wifi
reviews.text: I would never stay here again or recommend this hotel to anyone. The staff in reception is very rude. When we ask if we could get wifi for a second device in the room we were told not possible and, I quote..it is what it is. In my opinion this is unacceptable for a 5 star. There is is kitchen unit in the room and we had to call 3 times and wait about 1 hour to get a knive and spoons. The room was nice and spacious,  but the charge for the room service is far to high. We are visiting Las Vegas every year and never had a bad experience with a hotel until this one.

reviews.title: There is nothing redeeming about this hotel!
reviews.text: The rooms are so dark that they could have filmed the X Files here.  The first room I was given had a broken TV and the blackout drakes did not close completely.  I called and was told that housekeeping would be right up.  They still didn't come after a second call.  They offered to send engineering.  I asked for a different room and was moved.  My new room was equally as dark as was my fruend's and some people I met in the elevator.  The sleep timer on the TV does not work, but I have gotten the idea that this is par for the course so I did not even bother to complain about that.  The casino is small and unappealing.  We ate our complimentary breakfast this morning.  They clear the breakfast foods and are out of them by 10:45.  My friend did not receive glasses that should have been replaced by housekeeping today.  She phoned and was told to call room service.  She still did not have glasses 45 minutes later.  There us NO sense of urgency in this place.The walk to the casino is way too far and not for older people.For a good time and light in your room, I would not stay here.

reviews.title: Great place without the noise of the casinos
reviews.text: This is a great "normal" hotel in Vegas. By normal, I mean that the lobby is just the front desk, bell desk and some sofas, so there are no stores, casino, etc. If you prefer a quite place instead of the noise of the casinos this is a great option. The room is big with a huge bathroom and it is very clean. The location is perfect. It is just 2.4 km or 1.5 miles of the Strip so you can go there easily.The lady of the front desk is a little rude and a smile to the guests will not hurt, but she was efficient and I checked-in in about 5 minutes.  In the other hand the bell desk service was great. I think that the the room is a little dark so you have to turn on a lot of lights around the room, I suggest placing a big lamp in the middle of the room to illuminate most of the room with a single switch.

reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing Hotel
reviews.text: I was in Vegas for 5 days and had the pleasure of staying at Palms Place. I opted for the One bed room suite and it was well worth it! I felt at home during my stay. There was a full kitchen, washer/dryer combo which made my stay a lot easier(I could cook or wash clothes as needed). The casino is a 5 minute walk to Club Palms. During my stay I attended two parties at Ghost bar and was not disappointed(entry is free). If you're looking for a great hotel 7 minutes off the strip look no further than Palms Place

reviews.title: Bait & Switch. Full of Excuses. Be careful.
reviews.text: The hotel didn't care that they gave away our reservation for the double beds, which we paid extra for! When they tried to resolve the issue they created, they had the audacity to charge more, which is unfair and wrong. Palms place doesn't even compare to the kind of amenities and quality service of the Cosmopolitan and Vdara. The shower had a weird sewage smell, not enough lighting and you have to tell housekeeping to clean the room and provide fresh towels. Room service doesn't even have fresh squeezed orange juice for a 4 star hotel. They offered minute maid. This hotel is more of a 2 or 3 star. My advice is never book a room at Palms Place. If you're going to end up paying extra for their negative bait and switch errors, you might as well spend the money on 5 star hotels.

reviews.title: The worst
reviews.text: So where to begin. Got to the hotel around 12am we were checking in and the lady at the desk was friendly and seemed helpful, we asked her did she have and rooms with a view so that we can have a nice view it is our first trip here to Vegas. As she searched through her computer I guess she did find a room and she put us in my room.as we get to the room the shower floor was wet I didn't think anything of it I just assumed that maybe they cleaned before we got into the room. I also noticed that the mini bar was open and there was drinks missing but we were just trying to go out and have a good time is our first night in Vegas didn't think anything of it.so the next day we start I'm getting ready to go out and we noticed that there's some lighting fixtures that aren't working. So as we left for the day we let the manager know that the lighting fixtures and the jets in the jacuzzi weren't working and they said that they would take care of it and we left for an hour we came back and the lights were not fixed. We go back to our room and as were on the way back to our room we see a young couple they let us know that they stayed in our room the previous night before the night that we checked in and claim that she left her ID and our room and that they were transferred out of that room because of the issues that we were also complaining about. With that being said we went downstairs to the management and brought this issue to them they explained to us that at this time they are booked and that there is nothing that they can do for us but take one of our day of a resort fees off.  At this point we are very unsatisfied we did not receive great customer service so we called the management and she was the night manager and she let us know that tomorrow a room would be ready and that she would let us know when the room is ready but it should be ready by 11 o'clock so that night we packed all of our things we packed everything up so that we can be ready to go and get into our another room and what bothered me the most was that she tried to tell us that we can come to another hotel a different palms why would we move all of our things all of our bags over to another hotel because of the hotel that we paid to stay at is having whatever it is she said they were having. So the next day we come downstairs to talk to the people at the desk to see if I am I'll bring my severity and we get a rude awakening that the message wasn't even relate and they're trying to tell me that they can't do anything until that night manager comes in and I felt like that was an issue so with all that being said we had to go and get higher up manager and all of a sudden they see notes on the account that we are supposed to be moved to a higher room all of a sudden out of nowhere so they move us to the new room after this is our third dayinto our Vegas trip we were only there for five days so for the first three days we had to deal with issues with our hotel room and issues with the staff at this place. I had a very inconvenient stay at the palms please because none of the management talk to each other there was no messages relayed I had a very bad trip just because of my stay.I was sent an email to do a survey I didn't get a chance to do the first day of eighth and they sent me a Reminders survey and I thought that survey out and they did not get back to me and I called and I left a message for the manager and they still haven't got back to me and I've sent multiple emails and I still haven't gotten any feedback from my stay I have had issues with all the employees and with the hotel and I want something done about it. I didn't feel like a priority because Floyd Mayweather with staying there while we were staying there so I guess all their attention went to him and not to any of their guest.

reviews.title: Great luxury hotel off strip
reviews.text: Check in was fast and easy.  Only about 10 minutes from the time we parked our car, checked in and were in our room.  (that won't have with the casino hotels).   The resort fee hadn't been advertised, but knowing vegas hotels it wasn't a surprise.  The $33/day fee is a money grab as the hotel does not have much for a pool area and there isn't much as far as resort benefits.  The room was large with more of a focus on modern than comfort, although the bed was great.  Other than one security event next door, the room was very quite.   We seldom had to wait long for elevators and we could be from our room to our car in less than 5 minutes.  From the parking lot we were only a couple of minutes drive till we were on the I-15 or the strip.  The shuttle to the strip was convenient but not sure why it stops running at 8:00.  The shuttle was always full leaving the hotel, but the one time we took it back there was lots of room.  All in all a great hotel and will do again if the price is right.

reviews.title: The place to stay off the strip
reviews.text: If you want to stay off the strip this is definitely the place. The bed is one of the best hotel beds I've ever slept in!! the end! the rooms that are actually suites are great, spacious and nice decor. Every comment and other reviews about the fixture in the bathroom is similar to our experience. They are often broken :D but for us that didn't matter. It worked with a little adjustment. The cleaning staff are amazing! the sweetest and so attentive. Choose this hotel if you want a "hotel feel" in Vegas which can actually be difficult to find bc all hotels have casino in the lobby - here you have to walk to palms resort across the skywalk to enter the casino. Also a very nice pool at this part of the hotel and an extremely nice gym. Nice spa with great treatments and finally nice service pool site. Depending on the season in walking distance to the strip ( about 25 min) but forget it in spring and summer - it's way to hot so plan  and budget for taking caps back and forth if you want to get to the strip - you can live perfectly fine without visiting the strip the resort has an excellent casino and great restaurants. Only minus was the hotel reception staff. They could be more service minded. but would definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: I spent four nights at the Palms Place in October while attending a convention at another location.  The price was great for a large studio apartment with a full kitchenette.  The furnishings were very comfortable, there was a jacuzzi tub as well as a separate shower.  The only disappointment was not being able to go out on the balcony for security reasons.  Regardless I highly recommend the Palms Place!

reviews.title: Absolutely Wonderful Stay
reviews.text: The Palms Place is a fantastic off strip option for Hotel accommodations.  Check-in was easy and quick - less than 10 minutes.  There was free Valet and Self Parking to utilize.My room situated on the 22nd floor was beautiful, clean, and modern.  The two TV's in the room, not including the one in the restroom were great.  I was able to watch TV and accommodate my son with some cartoons. The only downside from my visit was the Complimentary Wifi (included in the resort fee) was not working.  If I pay a resort fee, I expect the Wifi to work.  Other than that, everyone was kind, helpful and overall just an amazing property.I like that's it's off the strip and no casino - it makes for a much quieter and peaceful stay.

reviews.title: If you dont mind 'off the strip' Palms Place is a great option
reviews.text: I am sure there are plenty of reviews, so this will be short and sweet.  We had a great time at Palms Place with no complaints.  We didnt use the kitchen but it was nice to have.  The Room, floor and hotel were quiet inspite of a young crowd, clean and stylish.  The staff was helpful and quick to get things done.  Transportation to the strip was easy and not too far.  The views were excellent and the bed/pillows were super comfortable!  We will be back.

reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: Easy booking, room was exactly what I asked for and service was amazing. Easy to get to the strip and it would a great idea to go grocery shopping due to the mini kitchen they provide for you, there's even a dishwasher in case you have dishes.

reviews.title: Amazing at first glance, just ok on the second
reviews.text: Palms Place Hotel, the fancier/more upscale sister property to the mainline Palms Hotel and Casino, is at first glance a very attractive alternative to the other 4.5-5 star hotels on the Strip. Built in 2008, it is much more modern and, in my opinion, stylish than the other two Palms towers. Despite coming to Las Vegas regularly for years, I had never ventured over to the hotels west of I-15. I never really felt the need. When we were surprised by a last minute family member's wedding, I saw a good deal and decided to give it a chance.At first glance, I had no idea why I had waited too long. The quiet borderline tranquil lobby was quite a contrast to the party scene reputation the property had in my mind. No casino or smoke to deal with. Check in was smooth. We had a studio room on the 50th floor (which is actually the 40th floor, but for some reason they decided to just skip the 40's for some unknown reason). Up in the room, we were very pleased. Modern design, large marble bathroom with a huge jetted tub, fantastic bed. Everything at first glance put it on par with some of the best hotels we had stayed at in Vegas. It was on the second and subsequent glances that took it down a notch.It is pretty clear that these rooms are showing their age. The inside handle of the doorknob, while functional, was pretty loose. There were broken edges to the marble tile. Scuff marks and tears were on two of the chairs. Someone had bashed in the front of the minibar, which broke the display and super bright LED lights were shining throughout the room before we draped a jacket over it so we could sleep. The jets on the tub would randomly turn on in the middle of the night, which sounded like a giant vacuum cleaner. I am usually pretty accommodating to a little wear and tear, but this seemed to be a little higher than normal. I didnt mind the small distance between the hotel and the Strip. I actually enjoyed it. We had a car and there was almost always parking very close to the doors. The view of the Strip was incredible. Station Casinos purchased the property in May, so I hope they are able to get ahead of these small maintenance issues. Because if they were taken care of, this place would be fantastic.

reviews.title: Studio room smells like pot
reviews.text: When they received the fax order from booking.com they mixed up my last name into their reservation system and it took 1.5 hours back and forth to a successful check-in.We had one of the studio on the 15th floor facing the strip. When we entered it immediately smelt like pot in the room and made a phone call to the room service. They were too busy and asked us to walk to the front desk. We told the front desk and they sprayed the room with deodorant instead of accepting our request for a room exchange. When we came back 1 hour later, my throat hurt by the gas and had to went down the front desk to ask for a room exchange. Finally got a right room after 5 hours after we walked in the hotel.As far as food is concerned, since the station casino bought this hotel they got rid of the seafood buffet and instead have a $12.95 non-seafood dinner buffet. Thus a minus.

reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: Nice hotel, off the strip but close enough to catch a quick Uber ride over. The buffet was good. Sunday brunch includes unlimited mimosas and with the free players card you get money off the buffet. Overall cool hotel!

reviews.title: 5 Star Concierge, Christine Smith!
reviews.text: The Palms Vegas Concierge, Christine Smith, is excellent at her job. She was extremely kind and resourceful, during my sons last minute birthday trip to Vegas and the Palms Hotel. When I called, the evening of my sons birthday, I was stressed; worried that it would be too late to get anything together for him. But, because of Christine's calming demeanor, and positive attitude, my worries disappeared within a matter of seconds. She was a Godsend; patient, a great listener, with many smart suggestions and she knew just who to call. She organized a cake, balloons, and all kinds of goodies for a last minute surprise. I travel an awful lot and I am certain Christine is among the best Concierges' on earth. I hope the Palms management realizes how lucky they are to have her! Thanks a million, Christine!!!

reviews.title: Resort fee gets you hand towels for the pool
reviews.text: I'm still here and from beginning there's been some kinda of daily issue.    I have family that came from Europe so brought them here.   When we got to their room we couldn't get into the room because the room key wasn't working they had to wait in the hallway with their bags like dummies while I went downstairs to get new keys.  Ok no big deal it happens.   I arrived to my room open safe and there is white powder in there that can be anything again no big deal it's  Vegas.   They said house keeping would be there in 15 min took them longer and we didn't want to leave the room without locking our personal stuff and a decent amount of cash in the safe.   So we waited around.  Again no big deal but it's starting to add up.    Now today we come back from lunch and our plan is to go to the pool we get ready then we find out our guest had to wait 15 min to get into their room because their keys wouldn't work and had to wait for someone to let them in.  On the way down to the pool I decided to go to lobby to fix their keys and meet them by the pool after.  When I arrived there was no towels so they were just sitting around not swimming because they don't have towels.  When I told the bartender she just said sorry we are out of towels and that I would have to go back to my room to get towels.  This whole hotel is out of towels for the pool? So what am I paying $34 daily resort fee for?  So I can constantly go up and down the elevator while my guest stand around like idiots.   So I went to my room to get towels all I had was one bath towel and 2 hand towels.   So gave them the bath towel and one hand towel for me and one for my wife.    Awesome! The thing is I told front desk so they are aware there are no towels at the pool and still nothing.   A lot of people just sitting around not able to use the pool because of no towels.   So it's just an empty pool.  It's sad because the rooms and layouts  are nice with good views but you can  get that anywhere in Vegas with towels and working room doors.

reviews.title: Amazing room and view
reviews.text: We wanted to be off the strip since this was simply an overnighter on the way to Palm Springs from Montana, not a party trip, or a sight seeing night in Vegas.  I searched Trip Advisor and found this hotel.  Huge BR, our unit was in the corner of the building so we had two glass walls of view of the city during the day and a light show at night.  And two bathrooms!  Like I said, large.  We wanted to go to the pool (and tried to) after dinner but it was closed...seasonal we were told.  Too bad.  We had happy hour drinks with snack food when we arrived, and later a nice dinner.  Price was very good for our great room.  Nothing bad to say except for no pool.

reviews.title: Excellent Hotel
reviews.text: I found this hotel to be excellent. It is not to far from the strip, but far enough to be quiet at night. I had a suite, which was large and very comfortable. The bed was large. mattress was just right. Lighting was excellent. The bathroom was large and very clean. Huge bathtub, shower was great, lots of hot water. Lots of towels.  AC worked very well. Refrigerator was very well stocked, but a little expensive. The housekeeping was great. The valet parking and concierge were very good. Front desk personnel were friendly and very helpful. Access to the casino and restaurant was through a covered walkway. My only complaint is that I couldn't use he balcony. It was locked for some reason. It would have been nice to be able to open it and get a fresh breeze in the evening.

reviews.title: Beware of this hotel
reviews.text: Management is full of crap.  Don't ever stay on this hotel.  It's really bad.  We are trying to get refund because we did not able to sleep.  A microphone feedback sound every 15 seconds around 6am woke us up.  We got back in our hotel around 4am and trying to sleep.  We called the guest service desk 4-5times to check on that noise and asked them to send someone in our room.  NO ONE CAME.  The manager said they can refund our money but we booked our hotel thru HOTWIRE.  We called HOTWIRE and they are willing to refund us our money as soon as the manager ADELIA give them the go signal.  Well they lied HOTWIRE said they don't want to do a refund. Bad, Bad, Bad service.....

reviews.title: Off strip comfort
reviews.text: This is a huge hotel with adjoining casino complex.  There is a pool, choice of restaurants and fitness room.  Reception is not very personal and always busy.  Late check out was not able to be offered because I visited Thursday-Friday.  The weekends in Vegas see a massive influx of tourists. My room on the 39th floor offered amazing views of the Strip, particularly at sunset and dawn.  The room was comfortable and stylish with a kitchenette, spa bath, rain shower and large bed.  The strip is approximately 10-15 mins away by a relatively cheap taxi.  Taxis are waiting in the lobby day and night.  Overall a comfortable and enjoyable stay.

reviews.title: The Best Kept Secret in Las Vegas
reviews.text: I've stayed all over Las Vegas for annual tech conferences. If you are looking for an escape from the strip after a long day out and around Las Vegas, look no further. The suites are positively excellent, with a very modern / South Beach feel, though they are starting to look a little worn. The views of the strip and mountains are fantastic. If you can convince someone in maintenance to open your balcony doors, the breezes are fantastic also. All the rooms come well-appointed with marble bathrooms, huge walk-in showers,fireplaces (in the suites), and large refrigerators (the suites have full kitchens, others, partial). Additionally, the suites have air-jacuzzi bathtubs in the bedrooms. The best part of this hotel is speed with which you can get from the taxi stand to the elevators for your room. It is literally 15 steps. It's not like most other Vegas hotels that force you to walk through a casino or a huge shopping area to get to your room.

reviews.title: Ultra modern studiosmallshadrest wbaras
reviews.text: The view from 51 st floor was aeatmazing.  Beds were super comfy.   Kitchen was available, but who cooks on vacation in Vegas. Bathroom had a 2 head shower and a 2 person bath tub with jets.The bedroom had a small closet and very little draws for clothes, they had open shelves.Happy hour at the palm casino restaurant was outstanding, but u had to eat in  the bar

reviews.title: So far not good
reviews.text: It is close to midnight and I am trying to check in and there are 20 people in line with 3 clerks working the desk.  Appears to be a 20-25 min line from what I can tell.  At least serve us a complimentary beverage while we have to endure some obnoxious music playing not to far away.  Only here one night so that might be the highlight of my trip.

reviews.title: One of the worst hotel I have stayed in
reviews.text: There are too many things for this hotel to improve on:* Refund money faster* Clean up all the cigarette butts in the swimming pool* Clean up all the disgusting towels in the swimming pool* Make the shower work* Provide enough shower gel, shampoo and tooth paste* If the balcony is not supposed to be used, leave a message there for people to see

reviews.title: Strip adjacent
reviews.text: Very nice hotel, lobby and rooms have very modern decor, chic and clean. Staff are friendly and helpful. This hotel is considered strip adjacent, great view of the strip from our room however it is a 24 min walk or $5 lyft/uber ride to the strip (caesars palace). The room itself was clean and had great ammenities like a beautiful washroom and kitchenette and dishwasher, however no cups, plates or ustensils. Set-up as a condo more than a hotel room. Patio door was locked for safety, very unfortunate since there is no place in the hotel to sit in the sun and get fresh air. The pool area was very nice and clean but only opened at 9am, with a 3 hour time change I was awake at 4am with nothing to do, no where to sit n relax. The Drift spa was amazing, best spa I have ever been to, very clean and classy. The Hammam was incredible, very peaceful. Hotel was very quiet, easy check-in but had no late check out or no free shuttle to the airport. Nice place, depending on your Vegas activities planned could be considered a bit out of the way with no grocery store within walking distance. Enjoy!

reviews.title: Free Upgrade to Penthouse!
reviews.text: This is our second time booking Palms Place for our yearly Vegas trip, in view of the spacious suite, convenient in-room facilities (kitchenette was a plus) and amazing nightview from the hotel room. Thanks to late check-in (1230am), the suites were overbooked. So we were offered complimentary upgrade to penthouse at Fantasy Tower (Palms Casino Hotel)! Never expect a high-roller style during our vacation in Vegas! What a pleasant surprise!! Will definitely book again when we come back to Vegas.

reviews.title: Excellent place.
reviews.text: We started on the wrong foot, our room was not ready when we got there, it took it to 2 hours to clean it so we waited 2 hour to check in. We got some complimentary drinks, not bad. The whole hotel/resort/spa/restaurants, etc is amazing. The pool is clean and the drink where superb, they have the best craft beers. The casino is super chick and clean. The whole experience was worth the vacation. The steak house is one of the best restaurant we visited in Vegas. Our view from the 53 floor was unbelievable.

reviews.title: Quality of the units varies because…
reviews.text: It´s worth to know that the most of the units are privately owned and they are rented out while owners don´t use them. That explains why the quality of units varies. Stayed twice in Palms Place: in the first time the studio-suite was perfect and clean, but in the second time unfortunately the studio-suite was under maintained and some issues like the shower knob of the rainforest shower head was about to fall off and the broken lamp in living area would have needed attention to be fixed. Also floor wasn´t mopped so it was dirty.Studio-suite had floor-to-ceiling windows with nice view to Strip. The balcony had permanently locked sliding door but no complaint because it´s a safety issue. It was spacious and had a small kitchenette area with fridge, microwave and coffee maker with limited number of coffee. There was also dishwasher but it was placed under the table. Obviously it wasn´t meant to be used, but on the other hand, there were available only 2 coffee mugs and nothing else, so no need for dishwasher. Bed was comfortable and bed linen of good quality.. Bathroom was spacious and had large walk in rainbow shower. Strong and stable WiFi.Palms Place has a Cardio center which is well maintained and well equipped. Open 6a-7p. Didn´t try Spa. There´s pool and lifeguard on duty. Pool is located on the 6th floor so it can be windy. Sunbeds are of good quality and cabanas are available. There´s a pool bar and Café 6 which serves pool snacks. No need to go to Café 6 for an order, snacks are waited on the pool. Palms Hotel offers a daily complimentary shuttle every 30-min to/from Caesars Palace from 11a to 8p. Available also for the guest of Palms Place. A local bus stop is located in front of Palms Hotel and Casino and it´s 4 stops to the corner of Strip and Caesars Palace. Palms Place is just off the strip but it's close enough to walk to/from Strip if you want to exercise (25 mins).Palms Place is connected to the Palms Hotel and Casino and there´s a covered walkway to Palms (5 min). There are the casino, fine dining restaurants, Eatery corner and buffet for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Ghost Bar is located on the 55th floor for drinks. On casino level there are also the Imax theatre and Pearl Theatre.To summarize: based on the first overnight stay in studio-suite, Palms Place is worth of 4/5 but unfortunately the second studio-suite deserves only 3/5.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: We staying on the 18th floor & had amazing views of The Strip. All the staff we very friendly & helpful & took time to explain how the place is set out. It is 10 mins from The Strip but there is a free shuttle bus every half an hour (11am -8pm) that takes you to Caesar Palace. The apartment was very clean & comfortable & spacious & very comfy beds. If we came back to Vegas we would stay again.

reviews.title: Greaat Hotel has Fallen Some IMO
reviews.text: Somewhat disappointed in my stay given I've stayed here beforeon more than one occasion when the Maloof family owned the hotel.  I prefer this hotel given:  no kids, no casino, no smoking, great rooms, great views, great vibe -- and it is connected to the Palms with great restaurants.  Upon checking into my room, however, I found a clump of ladies hair covering the shower drain.  I found a pair of men's athletic shorts sitting on the floor underneath the desk chair.  I visited the front desk and asked them to have house keeping management come to my room.  The housekeeping manager did show about 35 min later, was very nice, verified the hair in the drain, removed the shorts and apologized.  I did not receive any apology at the front desk upon check out -- customary IMO for a high end hotel when you bring something to the attention of the front desk, no comp consideration either.  I also note that in my room #10 309, the shower knob for the rain forest shower head is about to fall off.  Bottom line for me:  I think Station Casinos need up their service model and quality and improve the house keeping and room maintenance functions.

reviews.title: Quiet, clean, modern
reviews.text: Rooms: clean, modern, spacious, TV in the room and bathroom (but the stations were terrible), kitchenette, balcony (but it was locked), free wifi (surprisingly fast), one of the biggest hotel rooms for the money, price was very fair, view looking towards the strip. Location: Off the strip. Not too far by car. Ample free parking.  Would try walking it though.  The grounds are huge and the hotel is far enough from the casino that you can't hear a thing. Staff: helpful. The lobby looks like a condo.  The desk is tucked in the back corner with the elevator at the front of the lobby.  Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Would not stay here again considering all the options...
reviews.text: Positive: Extremely comfy beds and pillows, free "gift" to sign up with their casino, awesome buffet for the price, awesome bathrooms, the will hold your luggage for you all day if need be, and finally the spa was excellent! Negatives: The party pool had restrictions (what time you had to be there, wristbands), they had a resort fee (which gives you NOTHING), they don't really have balconies because they are locked and you can't use them! confusing elevators, EVERYTHING WAS EXTREMELY OVERPRICED, we needed a band-aid and the front desk is not stocked with a first aid kit (WOW!) Note: they are not on the strip, they place a hold on credit cards (funds aren't available), resort fee of about $35/ day, nothing complimentary except some terrible coffee with only powdered creamer.

reviews.title: Plush Palms Place
reviews.text: From the minute we walked in and received great service from Jordan we were happy to choose this over the M Resort this time!  After check in walked over to the elevators for Palms Place and they have them specific to the floors that you are on so the elevator is super fast and easy.   Palms Place was much closer to the downtown/strip area so we had more options on where to go.  It was so easy to catch an uber right out side to take us anywhere we needed!  We also had a car so when we wanted to travel outside the area we could explore Pahrump, Summerlin, Henderson, Boulder City.   The hotel also provides a  free shuttle from the casino to Caesars.  Only negative on that would be the 8pm return time.  We really liked being able to have coffee in our room each day and it was so easy to turn the light on or off for housekeeping if we needed it.  Our room was on the 50th floor so we had a beautiful view of the mountains which is exactly what we requested.  Room was quiet and away from the casino so we could just chill.  Our room was clean- it did have a little wear and tear but normal for all hotel rooms.  Some people just don't take the time to care if they abuse the room.  We ate at Nove bar area one night at their happy hour.  Since we are foodies, it was so nice to meet the bartender who was a foodie like us and gave us more tips on where to go in the city and we gave her ours.  Went up to ghost bar and took in the view and had some drinks.  Everyone was super friendly and nice from the bouncer, cocktail waitress, bartender. We also had a drink thanks to the hotel for providing us the 2 for 1 at Rojo Lounge.  The bartender was also very friendly and a foodie as well.   We are looking forward to booking our next trip back to Palms Place plushness with it's stainless steel kitchens, ample closet space and shelving, coffee pot, microwave, refrigerator, safe, large walk in shower,  comfortable bed you can't go wrong!  Valet was also super fast and the man that brought our luggage to our room was happy to ask us if we needed anything else or if  we needed to know anything about the hotel and answer questions. Thank you all for the great time at Palms Place plushness!  Your the best!

reviews.title: Mini vacagtion
reviews.text: Overall the hotel was fine.  The only thing I would rate low is that the furniture needs to be updated.  There were many chips on the dresser/wall unit, and tears on the chair.  We only used the coffeemaker in the kitchen, but there was a stove/refrigerator/microwave if we need to use it.  Overall good stay, quiet and staff was friendly enough.

reviews.title: great place to stay
reviews.text: very smart modern hotel. we booked a basic suite which far exceeded our expectations. room was large with good sized bathroom & lounge area. palms place is off the strip so provides a welcome oasis to Las Vegas though provides a regular shuttle so you can be in the centre of the action in no time at all

reviews.title: Deceptive & disappointing
reviews.text: I arrived at 2:00 patiently waited until 2:50 before approaching the desk. Greetings and an exchange of pleasantries was followed by me asking Muhammad if my room was ready. His reply was "I can help you with that in a moment." Muhammad proceeded with protocol, and AFTER taking my money, he let me know the room was not ready. I explained this is my first time traveling after suffering a TBI, and it's imperative for me to access my room upon check in at 3:00. I expected at least an ineffectual apology, but Muhammad simply stated he "isn't housekeeping" ...and wasn't sure when the room (he deceptively took payment for) would be ready. I called my husband and he is calling other hotels to see if I can get in somewhere right away.In the South they use an expression that I had not appreciated until now. I can't post it because I am a lady. Honest to goodness I wish I could. After 3:00 I asked about speaking to Shelby or anyone else in management. I have a legitimate disability and am neither receiving considerations nor accommodations for a condition recognized by the SSA. The worst part is I am not receiving the ROOM I paid for.Muhammed stated there was absolutely, positively no one else to speak to.

reviews.title: This place needs some help
reviews.text: I have stayed here many times, this way my favorite spot for years.  After a 4-5 year hiatus I decided to stay here again.  WoW ! things have sure changed.  Property is tired & worn, pool area dirty, seemed understaffed and restaurant has completely  changed.  Room- I upgraded to the one bedroom room suite, I still love the layout and probably the biggest room in Vegas for the price.  These offer full kitchens but we only had one rocks glass & one coffee mug. No dishes , silverware, wine glasses or cooking pans like in years before. Visited the pool on one day and was amazed at what I observed.  Entire area pretty dirty and I was there early so this trash had been left over.  After 10 minutes I noticed the lack of bartender/waitstaff.  I asked the lifeguard where they were.  He told me they were “eating”.  After 25 minutes they finally showed up.  These two ladies had absolutely zero interest in being at work.  Neither were waitressing , both standing behind bar texting!  In fact the first time I ordered was told to hold on as she finished her text.  The entire time my wife & I visited the pool we were never waited on.  We ended the day with a $100+ tab and each time had to got to the bar for an order where we were always greeted with “are you ready for your bill?”  These two were perfect examples of lazy millennials and offer absolutely nothing to this resort.  Such a shame because this pool use to be a great spot.  Another observation I had was now there is zero security, none on the skytube late at night and never anyone at the desk before heading to rooms.  Probably the most upsetting was on our last day we noticed a tampon wrapper on the floor in the bathroom behind the toilet, it had gone unnoticed because of the lack of working lighting.  This did not give us confidence that our room had been properly cleaned, like in a long time.  We went to check out and complain but the line was out of control with many visibly upset guests.  I opted to just check out in the room as we needed to get to the airport.  I do not understand the $33 a day resort fee, seems a little high for really nothing.  I hope this property gets a well deserved shot in the arm!

reviews.title: Life is Beautiful
reviews.text: Stayed at the Palms for life is beautiful.  It is a little inconvenient to get to everything from with the highway divide and traffic.  I chose to stay here because I had in the past. It is definitely not happening like it was 5-10 years ago.  Pros, it is off the craziness of the strip but still close.  They have a food court that includes affordable choices like McDonalds.  They also have a movie theater in case you need a break from gambling or drinking. Cons, I checked in and I found dirty towels in my room.  Pro-went down stairs and they offered to change my room immediately or wave the resort fee.  Cons- the concierge was terrible at the Place.  We missed getting concert tickets to a show because she was talking to somebody about planning their wife's bday next week on the phone while a guest me was standing in front of her for 30 minutes. Ironic part is it was my birthday that day.  We missed online ticket print off by ten minutes and tickets then doubled. Tried to go to the front desk who had no one and they referred us back to her. This was 10 am.  For the prices Vegas charges, I expected more professionalism. This is basic hotel and restaurant management skills.

reviews.title: Fantastic.
reviews.text: I’ve stayed here twice now and I think this is one of my favourite hotels in the World.  I really can’t think of a more appropriate adjective for this place than fantastic.I stayed in a 52nd floor suite, on the north east corner, and the view was just about the best one I have ever had in an hotel and, for that matter, it was one of the best views I’ve had from from anywhere.  One could probably spend a fortnight just sitting on that balcony.  It was utterly memorable.The level of facilities and comfort in this hotel is second to none.  Bearing in mind the price of this place, I would give it six or seven stars if I could.Wonderful.And... I love the fact that you can self park yards from the front door.  Then you don’t have to queue for valet parking or walk what seems like miles, through acres of slot machines, to get to the lobby of the hotel - as you have to in some nearby hotel complexes.

reviews.title: Nice property not great
reviews.text: Rooms are large and have nice amenities but not everything is well-placed.  The bathroom has a lovely shower set up but the tub is beyond the shower.  The lighted make-up mirror is too low and there is a small tv in the bathroom that does not work with the remote.  Towels are a little rough.Service overall is mediocre. The front-desk clear was flustered at check-in and check-out.  There were not enough people at the desk; long line and unhappy, waiting customers.The spa was very nice, hammam is really nice. Swimming pool was small but well-situated.  This is a moderately-priced property-keep your expectations low and you will be perfectly happy to use this as your home-base while having fun in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Conference
reviews.text: For the price, is not worth it! Not many amenities, needs to pay $25.00 per person to use the sauna, after been already charge a $25.00 resort fee, and $289.00 plus taxes for one night. Pool area very, very small, rooms are big enough but not well kept maintenance. Not recommend

reviews.title: The Right Place
reviews.text: Condo tower is part of the Palms complex which is off-strip but still close enough to the action without all the madness.  Gorgeous room with a fantastic view.  Concierge service was very helpful.  Daily shuttle to Caesars Palace,  multiplex cinema with food court next door, and a bus stop nearby.

reviews.title: Room charge!
reviews.text: Can someone please respond to my email regarding why I have been charged on three separate occassions fees? My balance before check out was $499 of which all was wiped off because of our comps and we was left to pay a bill of $75 due to tips - which I don't mind. But now?
